70wgpu::Sampler createLinearSampler(wgpu::Device &dev) {
71 WGPUSamplerDescriptor d{};
72 d.label = sv("eve_linear");
73 d.addressModeU = WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
74 d.addressModeV = WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
75 d.addressModeW = WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
76 d.magFilter = WGPUFilterMode_Linear;

80 d.lodMaxClamp = 1000.f;
81 d.maxAnisotropy = 1;
82 return dev.CreateSampler(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::SamplerDescriptor*>(&d));
83}

108void Graphics::initHeadless(int width, int height) {
109 if (deviceInitDone) {
110 if (headless_) {
111 setViewportSize(width, height, width, height);
112 return;
113 }
114 throw Exception("Graphics::initHeadless: already initialized with a window");
115 }
116 if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) throw Exception("Graphics::initHeadless: invalid size");
117
118 auto inst = InitFlow::createInstance();
119 auto adp = InitFlow::requestAdapter(std::move(inst), surface);
120 auto dev = InitFlow::requestDevice(std::move(adp));
121
122 instance = std::move(dev.instance);
123 adapter = std::move(dev.adapter);
124 device = std::move(dev.device);
125 queue = std::move(dev.queue);
126 caps = std::move(dev.caps);
127 surfaceFormat = WGPUTextureFormat_BGRA8Unorm;
128
129 createPipelineResources();
130 createShadowResources();
131 createDefaultTextures();
132 setViewportSize(width, height, width, height);
133 createSceneColorResources(width, height);
134 headless_ = true;
135 initialized = true;
136 deviceInitDone = true;
137}

139void Graphics::initWithWindow(void *nativeWindow) {
140 sdlWindow = nativeWindow;
141 if (deviceInitDone) return;
142
143 auto inst = InitFlow::createInstance();
144 auto adp = InitFlow::requestAdapter(std::move(inst), surface);
145 auto dev = InitFlow::requestDevice(std::move(adp));
146
147 instance = std::move(dev.instance);
148 adapter = std::move(dev.adapter);
149 device = std::move(dev.device);
150 queue = std::move(dev.queue);
151 caps = std::move(dev.caps);
152
153 // ---- Surface ----
154 WGPUSurfaceDescriptor surfDesc{};
155 surfDesc.label = sv("eve_surface");
156#if defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__)
157 WGPUEmscriptenSurfaceSourceCanvasHTMLSelector canvasSel{};
158 canvasSel.chain.sType = WGPUSType_EmscriptenSurfaceSourceCanvasHTMLSelector;
159 canvasSel.selector = sv("#canvas");
160 surfDesc.nextInChain = &canvasSel.chain;
161 surface = instance.CreateSurface(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::SurfaceDescriptor*>(&surfDesc));
162 surfaceFormat = WGPUTextureFormat_BGRA8Unorm;
163#else
164 wgpu::SurfaceDescriptor nativeSurfDesc{};
165 nativeSurfDesc.label = "eve_surface";
166 SDL_SysWMinfo wminfo;
167 SDL_VERSION(&wminfo.version);
168 if (!SDL_GetWindowWMInfo(static_cast<SDL_Window *>(sdlWindow), &wminfo))
169 throw Exception("WebGPU: SDL_GetWindowWMInfo failed: %s", SDL_GetError());
170#if defined(_WIN32)
171 wgpu::SurfaceSourceWindowsHWND winChain{};
172 winChain.hwnd = wminfo.info.win.window;
173 winChain.hinstance = GetModuleHandle(nullptr);
174 nativeSurfDesc.nextInChain = &winChain;
175 surface = instance.CreateSurface(&nativeSurfDesc);
176#elif defined(__linux__)
177 if (wminfo.subsystem == SDL_SYSWM_X11) {
178 wgpu::SurfaceSourceXlibWindow x11Chain{};
179 x11Chain.display = wminfo.info.x11.display;
180 x11Chain.window = wminfo.info.x11.window;
181 nativeSurfDesc.nextInChain = &x11Chain;
182 surface = instance.CreateSurface(&nativeSurfDesc);
183#if defined(SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER_WAYLAND)
184 } else if (wminfo.subsystem == SDL_SYSWM_WAYLAND) {
185 wgpu::SurfaceSourceWaylandSurface wlChain{};
186 wlChain.display = wminfo.info.wl.display;
187 wlChain.surface = wminfo.info.wl.surface;
188 nativeSurfDesc.nextInChain = &wlChain;
189 surface = instance.CreateSurface(&nativeSurfDesc);
190#endif
191 } else {
192 throw Exception("WebGPU: unsupported SDL window subsystem on Linux");
193 }
194#elif defined(__APPLE__)
195 // SDL exposes an NSWindow, while Dawn requires its content view's
196 // CAMetalLayer. Runtime messaging keeps this source portable C++.
197 using SendId = id (*)(id, SEL);
198 using SendVoidId = void (*)(id, SEL, id);
199 using SendVoidBool = void (*)(id, SEL, BOOL);
200 using SendIsKind = BOOL (*)(id, SEL, Class);
201 const auto sendId = reinterpret_cast<SendId>(objc_msgSend);
202 const auto sendVoidId = reinterpret_cast<SendVoidId>(objc_msgSend);
203 const auto sendVoidBool = reinterpret_cast<SendVoidBool>(objc_msgSend);
204 const auto sendIsKind = reinterpret_cast<SendIsKind>(objc_msgSend);
205 id window = reinterpret_cast<id>(wminfo.info.cocoa.window);
206 id view = sendId(window, sel_registerName("contentView"));
207 if (view == nil) throw Exception("WebGPU: SDL Cocoa window has no content view");
208 sendVoidBool(view, sel_registerName("setWantsLayer:"), YES);
209 id layer = sendId(view, sel_registerName("layer"));
210 Class metalLayerClass = objc_getClass("CAMetalLayer");
211 if (metalLayerClass == Nil) throw Exception("WebGPU: CAMetalLayer class unavailable");
212 if (layer == nil || !sendIsKind(layer, sel_registerName("isKindOfClass:"), metalLayerClass)) {
213 layer = sendId(reinterpret_cast<id>(metalLayerClass), sel_registerName("layer"));
214 sendVoidId(view, sel_registerName("setLayer:"), layer);
215 }
216 if (layer == nil) throw Exception("WebGPU: failed to create CAMetalLayer");
217 WGPUSurfaceSourceMetalLayer metalChain{};
218 metalChain.chain.sType = WGPUSType_SurfaceSourceMetalLayer;
219 metalChain.layer = layer;
220 surfDesc.nextInChain = &metalChain.chain;
221 surface = instance.CreateSurface(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::SurfaceDescriptor*>(&surfDesc));
222#else
223 throw Exception("WebGPU: unsupported native platform for surface creation");
224#endif
225 if (!surface) throw Exception("WebGPU: surface creation failed");
226 // Preferred surface format comes from wgpuSurfaceGetCapabilities in the
227 // current ABI (Surface::GetPreferredFormat was removed).
228 WGPUSurfaceCapabilities caps{};
229 if (wgpuSurfaceGetCapabilities(surface.Get(), adapter.Get(), &caps) == WGPUStatus_Success &&
230 caps.formatCount > 0) {
231 // Match Vulkan's display-space convention: the scene tone-map pass
232 // writes sRGB-encoded values to UNORM, then UI is composited without
233 // an additional hardware transfer function. Fall back only when the
234 // platform does not expose either common UNORM surface format.
235 surfaceFormat = caps.formats[0];
236 for (size_t i = 0; i < caps.formatCount; ++i) {
237 if (caps.formats[i] == WGPUTextureFormat_BGRA8Unorm) {
238 surfaceFormat = caps.formats[i];
239 break;
240 }
241 if (caps.formats[i] == WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm) {
242 surfaceFormat = caps.formats[i];
243 }
244 }
245 }
246 wgpuSurfaceCapabilitiesFreeMembers(caps);
247#endif
248
249 swapchainConfigured = false;
250 // Bind group layouts / pipelines must exist before the default textures
251 // (texture bind groups reference the 2D / mesh3d layouts), and the shadow
252 // depth array must exist before mesh bind groups are built at flush time.
253 createPipelineResources();
254 createShadowResources();
255 createDefaultTextures();
256 initialized = true;
257 deviceInitDone = true;
258}

266void Graphics::setViewportSize(int width, int height, int pixelwidth, int pixelheight) {
267 // Mirror the Vulkan backend: keep the base-class viewport members in sync
268 // so getWidth()/getPixelWidth() (used by RenderSystem3D for the GBuffer
269 // size) return the real dimensions instead of 0.
270 this->width = width;
271 this->height = height;
272 this->pixelWidth = pixelwidth;
273 this->pixelHeight = pixelheight;
274 logicalW = width;
275 logicalH = height;
276 pixelW = pixelwidth;
277 pixelH = pixelheight;
278 if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;
279 if (initialized) configureSurface(width, height);
280}
281
282void Graphics::configureSurface(int width, int height) {
283 if (!surface || !device || width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;
284 WGPUSurfaceConfiguration cfg{};
285 cfg.nextInChain = nullptr;
286 cfg.device = device.Get();
287 cfg.width = static_cast<uint32_t>(width);
288 cfg.height = static_cast<uint32_t>(height);
289 cfg.format = surfaceFormat;
290 cfg.usage = WGPUTextureUsage_RenderAttachment;
291 cfg.viewFormatCount = 0;
292 cfg.viewFormats = nullptr;
293 // emdawnwebgpu only accepts Fifo / Undefined present modes.
294 cfg.presentMode = WGPUPresentMode_Fifo;
295 // Auto (0) maps to an empty slot in emdawnwebgpu's JS CompositeAlphaMode
296 // table �?`alphaMode: undefined`, which some browsers reject. Use Opaque,
297 // which maps to the JS value 'opaque' used by the working replica.
298 cfg.alphaMode = WGPUCompositeAlphaMode_Opaque;
299 surface.Configure(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration*>(&cfg));
300 swapchainConfigured = true;
301 // Recreate the offscreen targets at the new size.
302 int w = pixelW > 0 ? pixelW : width;
303 int h = pixelH > 0 ? pixelH : height;
304 if (w > 0 && h > 0) {
305 createSceneColorResources(w, h);
306 createShadowResources();
307 }
308}
309
310void Graphics::rebuildSwapchainIfNeeded() {
311 if (!swapchainConfigured && surface && logicalW > 0 && logicalH > 0) {
312 configureSurface(logicalW, logicalH);
313 }
314}

320void Graphics::createDefaultTextures() {
321 uint8_t white[4] = {255, 255, 255, 255};
322 whiteTexture = static_cast<GpuTexture *>(newTexture(1, 1, white, false, false)->gpuHandle);
323
324 // Flat normal (0.5,0.5,1) in RGBA8 �?sampled as (0,0,1) normal.
325 uint8_t flatNrm[4] = {128, 128, 255, 255};
326 flatNormalTexture = static_cast<GpuTexture *>(newTexture(1, 1, flatNrm, false, false)->gpuHandle);
327 flatNormalTexture3D = flatNormalTexture;
328
329 uint8_t flatH[4] = {0, 0, 0, 255};
330 flatHeightTexture3D = static_cast<GpuTexture *>(newTexture(1, 1, flatH, false, false)->gpuHandle);
331
332 // 1x1 depth placeholder for the mesh3d scene-depth binding (9). Only X-ray
333 // shaders sample it; every other mesh draw binds this unused depth view.
334 {
335 auto *gpu = new GpuTexture();
336 WGPUTextureDescriptor td{};
337 td.label = sv("eve_flat_depth");
338 td.dimension = WGPUTextureDimension_2D;
339 td.size = {1, 1, 1};
340 td.sampleCount = 1;
341 td.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
342 td.mipLevelCount = 1;
343 td.usage = WGPUTextureUsage_TextureBinding;
344 gpu->texture = device.CreateTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor*>(&td));
345 WGPUTextureViewDescriptor vd{};
346 vd.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
347 vd.dimension = WGPUTextureViewDimension_2D;
348 vd.baseMipLevel = 0;
349 vd.mipLevelCount = 1;
350 vd.baseArrayLayer = 0;
351 vd.arrayLayerCount = 1;
352 gpu->view = gpu->texture.CreateView(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor*>(&vd));
353 gpu->width = 1;
354 gpu->height = 1;
355 flatDepthTexture3D = gpu;
356 }
357
358 // 1x1x3 depth-array placeholder for the mesh3d shadow bindings (5/8).
359 // sampleShadowPCF() early-outs (bias.y < 0.5) when shadows are disabled,
360 // so the texture is never actually sampled.
361 {
362 auto *gpu = new GpuTexture();
363 WGPUTextureDescriptor td{};
364 td.label = sv("eve_default_shadow_depth");
365 td.dimension = WGPUTextureDimension_2D;
366 td.size = {1, 1, 3};
367 td.sampleCount = 1;
368 td.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
369 td.mipLevelCount = 1;
370 td.usage = WGPUTextureUsage_TextureBinding;
371 gpu->texture = device.CreateTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor*>(&td));
372 WGPUTextureViewDescriptor vd{};
373 vd.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
374 vd.dimension = WGPUTextureViewDimension_2DArray;
375 vd.baseMipLevel = 0;
376 vd.mipLevelCount = 1;
377 vd.baseArrayLayer = 0;
378 vd.arrayLayerCount = 3;
379 gpu->view = gpu->texture.CreateView(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor*>(&vd));
380 WGPUSamplerDescriptor sd{};
381 sd.label = sv("eve_default_shadow_sampler");
382 sd.addressModeU = WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
383 sd.addressModeV = WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
384 sd.addressModeW = WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
385 sd.magFilter = WGPUFilterMode_Linear;
386 sd.minFilter = WGPUFilterMode_Linear;
387 sd.mipmapFilter = WGPUMipmapFilterMode_Nearest;
388 sd.compare = WGPUCompareFunction_LessEqual;
389 sd.maxAnisotropy = 1.f;
390 gpu->sampler = device.CreateSampler(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::SamplerDescriptor*>(&sd));
391 defaultShadowTex = gpu;
392 }
393
394 // Default env cubemap is black so an unset environment (RenderSystem3D
395 // still passes envIntensity=1.0 by default) does not wash the scene
396 // toward white. Only an explicitly set envMap contributes IBL.
397 uint8_t cubeFace[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
398 uint8_t cubeData[24];
399 for (int f = 0; f < 6; ++f) std::memcpy(cubeData + f * 4, cubeFace, 4);
400 defaultEnvCubemap =
401 static_cast<GpuTexture *>(newCubemap(1, cubeData)->gpuHandle);
402
403 // Shared filtering sampler for WGSL bindings declared as plain `sampler`.
404 TextureSampler def;
405 mainSampler = makeSampler(def, 1);
406
407 const uint8_t transparent[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
408 const uint8_t decalNormal[4] = {128, 128, 255, 0};
409 const uint8_t decalParams[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
410 decalFlatAlbedo = newTexture(1, 1, transparent);
411 decalFlatNormal = newTexture(1, 1, decalNormal);
412 decalFlatParams = newTexture(1, 1, decalParams);

419void Graphics::createPipelineResources() {
420 // Only layouts are required during initialization. Native Dawn compiles
421 // render pipelines synchronously, so eagerly materializing every blend,
422 // depth, cull, target and MSAA variant made each isolated CTest spend
423 // roughly a minute compiling pipelines it never used.
424 create2DPipelines();
425 createMesh3DPipelines();
426}

429// Bind group layouts

431
432wgpu::BindGroupLayout Graphics::make2DBindGroupLayout() {
433 BindGroupLayoutBuilder b;
434 // 0: color texture
435 b.texture(0, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
436 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
437 // 1: depth texture
438 b.texture(1, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
439 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
440 // 2: color sampler
441 b.sampler(2, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
442 // 3: depth sampler
443 b.sampler(3, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
444 // 4: Externals UBO (push-constant replacement, dynamic offset). Sized for
445 // the largest consumer: custom 2D shaders (128 B) and lit2D (Lighting2DUBO).
446 b.buffer(4, wgpu::ShaderStage::Vertex | wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment,
447 wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform, true,
448 std::max<uint32_t>(Shader::kPushConstantBytes, uint32_t(sizeof(Lighting2DUBO))));
449 b.texture(5, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
450 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
451 b.sampler(6, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
452 b.texture(7, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
453 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
454 b.sampler(8, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
455 b.texture(9, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
456 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
457 b.sampler(10, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
458 return b.build(device, "eve_2d");
459}
460
461wgpu::BindGroupLayout Graphics::makeMesh3DBindGroupLayout() {
462 BindGroupLayoutBuilder b;
463 // 0: Frame UBO (dynamic)
464 b.buffer(0, wgpu::ShaderStage::Vertex | wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment,
465 wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform, true, sizeof(Mesh3DUBO));
466 // 1: albedo
467 b.texture(1, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
468 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
469 // 2: normal
470 b.texture(2, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
471 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
472 // 3: env cubemap
473 b.texture(3, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
474 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::Cube);
475 // 4: Shadow UBO (dynamic)
476 b.buffer(4, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform, true,
477 sizeof(ShadowUBO));
478 // 5: shadow depth array
479 b.texture(5, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
480 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2DArray);
481 // 6: height
482 b.texture(6, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
483 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
484 // 7: shared filtering sampler (WGSL `mainSamp`)
485 b.sampler(7, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
486 // 8: shadow comparison sampler
487 b.sampler(8, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Comparison);
488 // 9: scene depth (G-buffer hwDepth; X-ray shaders sample it). Depth view,
489 // sampled via textureSampleLevel with the shared mainSamp (binding 7).
490 b.texture(9, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
491 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
492 // 10: SSAO occlusion texture (white when AO is disabled)
493 b.texture(10, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
494 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
495 // 11: shared AO sampler
496 b.sampler(11, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
497 for (uint32_t i = 12; i <= 14; ++i) {
498 b.texture(i, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
499 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
500 }
501 // Custom mesh shaders may use their external parameters for vertex
502 // deformation as well as fragment shading (for example grass billboards).
503 b.buffer(15, wgpu::ShaderStage::Vertex | wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment,
504 wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform, true, Shader::kPushConstantBytes);
505 b.texture(16, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
506 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::Cube);
507 b.texture(17, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
508 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::Cube);
509 b.texture(18, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
510 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
511 b.sampler(19, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
512 return b.build(device, "eve_mesh3d");
513}

525wgpu::BindGroupLayout Graphics::makeGbufferBindGroupLayout() {
526 BindGroupLayoutBuilder b;
527 // 0: pass and skinning UBO (dynamic)
528 b.buffer(0, wgpu::ShaderStage::Vertex | wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment,
529 wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform, true, sizeof(SkinPassUBO));
530 // 1: albedo
531 b.texture(1, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
532 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
533 // 2: sampler
534 b.sampler(2, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
535 return b.build(device, "eve_gbuffer");
536}

538wgpu::BindGroupLayout Graphics::makeDecalBindGroupLayout() {
539 BindGroupLayoutBuilder b;
540 b.buffer(0, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform, true, 240);
541 for (uint32_t i = 1; i <= 3; ++i) {
542 b.texture(i, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
543 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
544 }
545 b.texture(4, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
546 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
547 b.texture(5, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
548 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
549 b.sampler(6, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
550 return b.build(device, "eve_decal");

581wgpu::BindGroupLayout Graphics::makeMesh3DClusteredBindGroupLayout() {
582 BindGroupLayoutBuilder b;
583 // 0: Frame UBO (dynamic; clustered layout)
584 b.buffer(0, wgpu::ShaderStage::Vertex | wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment,
585 wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform, true, sizeof(Mesh3DClusteredUBO));
586 // 1: albedo
587 b.texture(1, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
588 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
589 // 2: normal map
590 b.texture(2, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
591 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
592 // 3: env cubemap
593 b.texture(3, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
594 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::Cube);
595 // 4: shadow UBO (dynamic)
596 b.buffer(4, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform, true,
597 sizeof(ShadowUBO));
598 // 5: shadow depth array
599 b.texture(5, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
600 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2DArray);
601 // 6: height/parallax (unused fallback)
602 b.texture(6, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
603 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
604 // 7: shared filtering sampler
605 b.sampler(7, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
606 // 8: shadow comparison sampler
607 b.sampler(8, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Comparison);
608 // 9: scene depth (G-buffer hwDepth; sampled by X-ray variants)
609 b.texture(9, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
610 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
611 // 10..12: clustered-forward SSBOs
612 b.buffer(10, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::BufferBindingType::ReadOnlyStorage, false,
613 sizeof(ClusteredLightGpu));
614 b.buffer(11, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::BufferBindingType::ReadOnlyStorage, false,
615 sizeof(ClusterTableEntry));
616 b.buffer(12, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::BufferBindingType::ReadOnlyStorage, false,
617 sizeof(uint32_t));
618 // 13/14: SSAO occlusion texture + sampler
619 b.texture(13, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
620 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
621 b.sampler(14, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
622 for (uint32_t i = 15; i <= 17; ++i) {
623 b.texture(i, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
624 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
625 }
626
627 b.texture(18, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
628 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::Cube);
629 b.texture(19, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float,
630 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::Cube);
631 return b.build(device, "eve_mesh3d_clustered");
632}

678namespace {
679
680// Returns a RAII-held module: the caller must keep it alive across
681// CreateRenderPipeline. Returning a raw WGPUShaderModule would let the
682// temporary wgpu::ShaderModule destructor Release() the handle, dropping it
683// from emdawnwebgpu's jsObjects before the pipeline can reference it.
684wgpu::ShaderModule makeWgslModule(wgpu::Device &dev, const char *wgsl) {
685 wgpu::ShaderSourceWGSL wgslDesc{};
686 wgslDesc.code = wgsl;
687 wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor desc{};
688 desc.nextInChain = &wgslDesc;
689 return dev.CreateShaderModule(&desc);
690}
691
692// Builds a WGSL shader-module descriptor (the chained WGPUShaderSourceWGSL is
693// static so its chain pointer stays valid). The returned descriptor is a value
694// that must outlive the CreateShaderModule call.
695WGPUShaderModuleDescriptor mdDesc(const std::string &code) {
696 static WGPUShaderSourceWGSL wd{};
697 wd.chain.sType = WGPUSType_ShaderSourceWGSL;
698 wd.code = sv(code.c_str());
699 WGPUShaderModuleDescriptor md{};
700 md.nextInChain = &wd.chain;
701 return md;
702}
703
704void fillVertexLayout(WGPUVertexBufferLayout &layout, uint64_t stride,
705 const WGPUVertexAttribute *attrs, uint32_t attrCount) {
706 layout.arrayStride = stride;
707 layout.stepMode = WGPUVertexStepMode_Vertex;
708 layout.attributeCount = attrCount;
709 layout.attributes = attrs;
710}
711
712WGPUBlendState alphaBlend() {
713 WGPUBlendState b{};
714 b.color.srcFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_SrcAlpha;
715 b.color.dstFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_OneMinusSrcAlpha;
716 b.color.operation = WGPUBlendOperation_Add;
717 b.alpha.srcFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_One;
718 b.alpha.dstFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_OneMinusSrcAlpha;
719 b.alpha.operation = WGPUBlendOperation_Add;
720 return b;
721}
722
723WGPUBlendState noBlend() {
724 WGPUBlendState b{};
725 b.color.srcFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_One;
726 b.color.dstFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_Zero;
727 b.color.operation = WGPUBlendOperation_Add;
728 b.alpha.srcFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_One;
729 b.alpha.dstFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_Zero;
730 b.alpha.operation = WGPUBlendOperation_Add;
731 return b;
732}
733
734WGPUBlendState additiveBlend() {
735 WGPUBlendState b{};
736 b.color.srcFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_SrcAlpha;
737 b.color.dstFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_One;
738 b.color.operation = WGPUBlendOperation_Add;
739 b.alpha.srcFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_One;
740 b.alpha.dstFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_One;
741 b.alpha.operation = WGPUBlendOperation_Add;
742 return b;
743}
744
745WGPUBlendState premultipliedBlend() {
746 WGPUBlendState b = alphaBlend();
747 b.color.srcFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_One;
748 return b;
749}
750
751WGPUBlendState multiplyBlend() {
752 WGPUBlendState b = alphaBlend();
753 b.color.srcFactor = WGPUBlendFactor_Dst;
754 return b;
755}
756
757size_t meshPipelineIndex(BlendMode blend, bool depthWrite, bool doubleSided) {
758 return size_t(blend) * 4u + (depthWrite ? 2u : 0u) + (doubleSided ? 1u : 0u);
759}
760
761WGPUBlendState blendState(BlendMode mode) {
762 switch (mode) {
763 case BlendMode::Additive:
764 return additiveBlend();
765 case BlendMode::Premultiplied:
766 return premultipliedBlend();
767 case BlendMode::Multiply:
768 return multiplyBlend();
769 case BlendMode::Opaque:
770 return noBlend();
771 case BlendMode::Alpha:
772 default:
773 return alphaBlend();
774 }
775}

781wgpu::RenderPipeline make2DColorPipeline(wgpu::Device &dev, WGPUTextureFormat format,
782 BlendMode mode) {
783 wgpu::VertexAttribute attrs[2] = {};
784 attrs[0].format = wgpu::VertexFormat::Float32x2;
785 attrs[0].offset = 0;
786 attrs[0].shaderLocation = 0;
787 attrs[1].format = wgpu::VertexFormat::Float32x4;
788 attrs[1].offset = 8;
789 attrs[1].shaderLocation = 1;
790
791 PipelineBuilder b;
792 // The solid-color shader declares no bindings, so it must use an empty
793 // (auto-derived) pipeline layout. Reusing the textured 2D layout here would
794 // require a bind group for every solid draw.
795 b.vertexLayout(24, wgpu::VertexStepMode::Vertex, attrs, 2);
796 b.shader(makeWgslModule(dev, kColorVertWgsl), "vs_main", makeWgslModule(dev, kColorFragWgsl),
797 "fs_main");
798 b.colorTarget(format, mode);
799 // The WGSL vertex shader mirrors clip Y to match Vulkan, which flips
800 // object-space CCW winding in framebuffer space.
801 b.frontFace(wgpu::FrontFace::CW);
802 b.cull(wgpu::CullMode::Back);
803 return b.build(dev);
804}
805
806wgpu::RenderPipeline make2DTexturedPipeline(wgpu::Device &dev, wgpu::PipelineLayout layout,
807 WGPUTextureFormat format, BlendMode mode,
808 bool toneMapScene = false) {
809 WGPUVertexAttribute attrs[3] = {};
810 attrs[0].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x2;
811 attrs[0].offset = 0;
812 attrs[0].shaderLocation = 0;
813 attrs[1].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x4;
814 attrs[1].offset = 8;
815 attrs[1].shaderLocation = 1;
816 attrs[2].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x2;
817 attrs[2].offset = 24;
818 attrs[2].shaderLocation = 2;
819 WGPUVertexBufferLayout vb{};
820 fillVertexLayout(vb, 32, attrs, 3);
821
822 WGPUColorTargetState target{};
823 target.format = format;
824 target.writeMask = WGPUColorWriteMask_All;
825 WGPUBlendState bs = alphaBlend();
826 if (mode == BlendMode::Additive)
827 bs = additiveBlend();
828 else if (mode == BlendMode::Premultiplied)
829 bs = premultipliedBlend();
830 else if (mode == BlendMode::Multiply)
831 bs = multiplyBlend();
832 else if (mode == BlendMode::Opaque)
833 bs = noBlend();
834 if (mode != BlendMode::Opaque) target.blend = &bs;
835
836 WGPURenderPipelineDescriptor pd{};
837 pd.label = sv("eve_textured2d");
838 pd.layout = layout.Get();
839 wgpu::ShaderModule vertModule = makeWgslModule(dev, kTexturedVertWgsl);
840 static constexpr const char *kSceneTonemapFragWgsl = R"wgsl(
841struct FSIn {
842 @location(0) color: vec4f,
843 @location(1) uv: vec2f,
844};
845@group(0) @binding(0) var colorTex: texture_2d<f32>;
846@group(0) @binding(2) var colorSampler: sampler;
847@group(0) @binding(1) var rawSceneTex: texture_2d<f32>;
848@group(0) @binding(3) var rawSceneSampler: sampler;
849fn acesFitted(c0: vec3f) -> vec3f {
850 let c = max(c0, vec3f(0.0));
851 return clamp((c * (2.51 * c + vec3f(0.03))) /
852 (c * (2.43 * c + vec3f(0.59)) + vec3f(0.14)),
853 vec3f(0.0), vec3f(1.0));
854}
855fn linearToSrgb(c: vec3f) -> vec3f {
856 let low = c * 12.92;
857 let high = 1.055 * pow(max(c, vec3f(0.0)), vec3f(1.0 / 2.4)) - vec3f(0.055);
858 return select(low, high, c > vec3f(0.0031308));
859}
860fn automaticExposure(packedLimits: f32, raw: bool) -> f32 {
861 var logLuminance: array<f32, 16>;
862 var sampleIndex = 0;
863 for (var y = 0; y < 4; y = y + 1) {
864 for (var x = 0; x < 4; x = x + 1) {
865 let uv = (vec2f(f32(x), f32(y)) + vec2f(0.5)) * 0.25;
866 var sampleColor = textureSampleLevel(colorTex, colorSampler, uv, 0.0).rgb;
867 if (raw) {
868 sampleColor = textureSampleLevel(rawSceneTex, rawSceneSampler, uv, 0.0).rgb;
869 }
870 sampleColor = max(sampleColor, vec3f(0.0));
871 let luminance = dot(sampleColor, vec3f(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
872 logLuminance[sampleIndex] = log2(clamp(luminance, 0.0001, 65504.0));
873 sampleIndex += 1;
874 }
875 }
876 for (var i = 1; i < 16; i = i + 1) {
877 let value = logLuminance[i];
878 var j = i - 1;
879 while (j >= 0 && logLuminance[j] > value) {
880 logLuminance[j + 1] = logLuminance[j];
881 j -= 1;
882 }
883 logLuminance[j + 1] = value;
884 }
885 var trimmedLogSum = 0.0;
886 for (var i = 2; i < 14; i = i + 1) {
887 trimmedLogSum += logLuminance[i];
888 }
889 let geometricMean = exp2(trimmedLogSum * (1.0 / 12.0));
890 let packed = round(packedLimits);
891 let minEV = (packed - floor(packed * (1.0 / 256.0)) * 256.0) *
892 (1.0 / 8.0) - 16.0;
893 let maxEV = floor(packed * (1.0 / 256.0)) * (1.0 / 8.0) - 16.0;
894 return clamp(0.18 / max(geometricMean, 0.0001), exp2(minEV), exp2(maxEV));
895}
896fn bloomPrefilter(color: vec3f, threshold: f32) -> vec3f {
897 let brightness = max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
898 let knee = max(threshold * 0.1, 0.01);
899 let soft = clamp((brightness - threshold + knee) / (2.0 * knee), 0.0, 1.0);
900 let contribution = max(brightness - threshold, soft * soft * knee);
901 return color * (contribution / max(brightness, 0.0001));
902}
903fn sampleBloom(uv: vec2f, threshold: f32) -> vec3f {
904 let texel = 1.0 / vec2f(textureDimensions(colorTex));
905 var bloom = bloomPrefilter(textureSampleLevel(colorTex, colorSampler, uv, 0.0).rgb,
906 threshold) * 0.2;
907 let offsets = array<vec2f, 12>(
908 vec2f(2.00, 0.00), vec2f(-1.47, 1.35), vec2f(0.17, -1.99), vec2f(1.22, 1.58),
909 vec2f(4.22, -2.68), vec2f(-4.92, -0.87), vec2f(3.04, 3.97), vec2f(-0.44, -4.98),
910 vec2f(-5.28, 7.28), vec2f(8.89, -1.41), vec2f(-7.82, -4.46), vec2f(2.07, 8.76));
911 let weights = array<f32, 12>(
912 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10,
913 0.06, 0.06, 0.06, 0.06,
914 0.04, 0.04, 0.04, 0.04);
915 for (var q = 0; q < 12; q = q + 1) {
916 bloom += bloomPrefilter(textureSampleLevel(colorTex, colorSampler,
917 uv + offsets[q] * texel, 0.0).rgb, threshold) * weights[q];
918 }
919 return bloom;
920}
921@fragment
922fn fs_main(in: FSIn) -> @location(0) vec4f {
923 let hdr = textureSample(colorTex, colorSampler, in.uv);
924 let exposure = 1.0; // Applied once by the dedicated HDR pre-exposure pass.
925 let encodeSrgb = in.color.a >= 65536.0;
926 let bloomPacked = round(in.color.a) - floor(round(in.color.a) * (1.0 / 65536.0)) * 65536.0;
927 let bloomIntensity = (bloomPacked - floor(bloomPacked * (1.0 / 256.0)) * 256.0) *
928 (1.0 / 32.0);
929 let bloomThreshold = floor(bloomPacked * (1.0 / 256.0)) * (1.0 / 16.0);
930 var bloom = vec3f(0.0);
931 if (bloomIntensity > 0.0) {
932 bloom = sampleBloom(in.uv, bloomThreshold);
933 }
934 var displayColor = acesFitted((hdr.rgb + bloom * bloomIntensity) * exposure);
935 if (encodeSrgb) {
936 displayColor = linearToSrgb(displayColor);
937 }
938 return vec4f(displayColor, hdr.a);
939}
940)wgsl";
941 wgpu::ShaderModule fragModule =
942 makeWgslModule(dev, toneMapScene ? kSceneTonemapFragWgsl : kTexturedFragWgsl);
943 pd.vertex.module = vertModule.Get();
944 pd.vertex.entryPoint = sv("vs_main");
945 pd.vertex.bufferCount = 1;
946 pd.vertex.buffers = &vb;
947 WGPUFragmentState fs{};
948 fs.module = fragModule.Get();
949 fs.entryPoint = sv("fs_main");
950 fs.targetCount = 1;
951 fs.targets = &target;
952 pd.fragment = &fs;
953 pd.primitive.topology = WGPUPrimitiveTopology_TriangleList;
954 pd.primitive.frontFace = WGPUFrontFace_CCW;
955 pd.primitive.cullMode = WGPUCullMode_None;
956 pd.primitive.stripIndexFormat = WGPUIndexFormat_Undefined;
957 pd.depthStencil = nullptr;
958 pd.multisample.count = 1;
959 // Zero-init would leave mask=0, which discards every fragment
960 // (sampleMask=0). The WebGPU default is 0xFFFFFFFF (all samples).
961 pd.multisample.mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
962 return dev.CreateRenderPipeline(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor*>(&pd));
963}
964
965wgpu::RenderPipeline make2DLitPipeline(wgpu::Device &dev, wgpu::PipelineLayout layout,
966 WGPUTextureFormat format, bool blend) {
967 wgpu::VertexAttribute attrs[3] = {};
968 attrs[0].format = wgpu::VertexFormat::Float32x2;
969 attrs[0].offset = 0;
970 attrs[0].shaderLocation = 0;
971 attrs[1].format = wgpu::VertexFormat::Float32x4;
972 attrs[1].offset = 8;
973 attrs[1].shaderLocation = 1;
974 attrs[2].format = wgpu::VertexFormat::Float32x2;
975 attrs[2].offset = 24;
976 attrs[2].shaderLocation = 2;
977
978 PipelineBuilder b;
979 b.vertexLayout(32, wgpu::VertexStepMode::Vertex, attrs, 3);
980 b.shader(makeWgslModule(dev, kLit2DVertWgsl), "vs_main", makeWgslModule(dev, kLit2DFragWgsl),
981 "fs_main");
982 b.layout(layout);
983 // Lit pipeline always uses alpha blending; `blend` currently true in all
984 // call sites, so map to Alpha (or Opaque when disabled).
985 b.colorTarget(format, blend ? BlendMode::Alpha : BlendMode::Opaque);
986 return b.build(dev);
987}

991void Graphics::create2DPipelines() {
992 tex2DSetLayout = make2DBindGroupLayout();
993 tex2DPipelineLayout = make2DPipelineLayout();
994
995 colorPipeline = make2DColorPipeline(device, surfaceFormat, BlendMode::Alpha);
996 texturedPipeline = make2DTexturedPipeline(device, tex2DPipelineLayout, surfaceFormat,
997 BlendMode::Alpha);
998 colorAdditivePipeline = make2DColorPipeline(device, surfaceFormat, BlendMode::Additive);
999 texturedAdditivePipeline = make2DTexturedPipeline(device, tex2DPipelineLayout, surfaceFormat,
1000 BlendMode::Additive);
1001 colorPremultipliedPipeline =
1002 make2DColorPipeline(device, surfaceFormat, BlendMode::Premultiplied);
1003 texturedPremultipliedPipeline = make2DTexturedPipeline(
1004 device, tex2DPipelineLayout, surfaceFormat, BlendMode::Premultiplied);
1005 colorMultiplyPipeline = make2DColorPipeline(device, surfaceFormat, BlendMode::Multiply);
1006 texturedMultiplyPipeline = make2DTexturedPipeline(
1007 device, tex2DPipelineLayout, surfaceFormat, BlendMode::Multiply);
1008 colorOpaquePipeline = make2DColorPipeline(device, surfaceFormat, BlendMode::Opaque);
1009 texturedOpaquePipeline = make2DTexturedPipeline(device, tex2DPipelineLayout, surfaceFormat,
1010 BlendMode::Opaque);
1011 sceneTonemapPipeline = make2DTexturedPipeline(device, tex2DPipelineLayout, surfaceFormat,
1012 BlendMode::Opaque, true);
1013 lit2dPipeline = make2DLitPipeline(device, tex2DPipelineLayout, surfaceFormat, true);
1014
1015 offscreenColorPipeline = make2DColorPipeline(device, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm,
1016 BlendMode::Alpha);
1017 offscreenTexturedPipeline = make2DTexturedPipeline(device, tex2DPipelineLayout,
1018 WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm,
1019 BlendMode::Alpha);
1020 offscreenColorAdditivePipeline = make2DColorPipeline(device, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm,
1021 BlendMode::Additive);
1022 offscreenTexturedAdditivePipeline =
1023 make2DTexturedPipeline(device, tex2DPipelineLayout, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm,
1024 BlendMode::Additive);
1025 offscreenColorPremultipliedPipeline = make2DColorPipeline(
1026 device, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm, BlendMode::Premultiplied);
1027 offscreenTexturedPremultipliedPipeline = make2DTexturedPipeline(
1028 device, tex2DPipelineLayout, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm,
1029 BlendMode::Premultiplied);
1030 offscreenColorMultiplyPipeline = make2DColorPipeline(
1031 device, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm, BlendMode::Multiply);
1032 offscreenTexturedMultiplyPipeline = make2DTexturedPipeline(
1033 device, tex2DPipelineLayout, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm, BlendMode::Multiply);
1034 offscreenColorOpaquePipeline = make2DColorPipeline(device, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm,
1035 BlendMode::Opaque);
1036 offscreenTexturedOpaquePipeline =
1037 make2DTexturedPipeline(device, tex2DPipelineLayout, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm,
1038 BlendMode::Opaque);
1039 hdrOffscreenTexturedPipeline =
1040 make2DTexturedPipeline(device, tex2DPipelineLayout, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float,
1041 BlendMode::Alpha);
1042 hdrOffscreenTexturedOpaquePipeline =
1043 make2DTexturedPipeline(device, tex2DPipelineLayout, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float,
1044 BlendMode::Opaque);
1045 offscreenLitPipeline = make2DLitPipeline(device, tex2DPipelineLayout,
1046 WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm, true);
1047}

1049wgpu::RenderPipeline Graphics::get2DColorPipeline(BlendMode blend, bool offscreen) {
1050 switch (blend) {
1051 case BlendMode::Additive:
1052 return offscreen ? offscreenColorAdditivePipeline : colorAdditivePipeline;
1053 case BlendMode::Premultiplied:
1054 return offscreen ? offscreenColorPremultipliedPipeline : colorPremultipliedPipeline;
1055 case BlendMode::Multiply:
1056 return offscreen ? offscreenColorMultiplyPipeline : colorMultiplyPipeline;
1057 case BlendMode::Opaque:
1058 return offscreen ? offscreenColorOpaquePipeline : colorOpaquePipeline;
1059 case BlendMode::Alpha:
1060 default:
1061 return offscreen ? offscreenColorPipeline : colorPipeline;
1062 }
1063}
1064
1065wgpu::RenderPipeline Graphics::get2DTexturedPipeline(BlendMode blend, bool offscreen) {
1066 switch (blend) {
1067 case BlendMode::Additive:
1068 return offscreen ? offscreenTexturedAdditivePipeline : texturedAdditivePipeline;
1069 case BlendMode::Premultiplied:
1070 return offscreen ? offscreenTexturedPremultipliedPipeline
1071 : texturedPremultipliedPipeline;
1072 case BlendMode::Multiply:
1073 return offscreen ? offscreenTexturedMultiplyPipeline : texturedMultiplyPipeline;
1074 case BlendMode::Opaque:
1075 return offscreen ? offscreenTexturedOpaquePipeline : texturedOpaquePipeline;
1076 case BlendMode::Alpha:
1077 default:
1078 return offscreen ? offscreenTexturedPipeline : texturedPipeline;
1079 }
1080}

1082wgpu::RenderPipeline Graphics::get2DLitPipeline(bool offscreen) {
1083 return offscreen ? offscreenLitPipeline : lit2dPipeline;

1093wgpu::RenderPipeline Graphics::getMesh3DPipeline(BlendMode blend, bool depthWrite,
1094 bool doubleSided, bool canvasTarget) {
1095 const size_t index = meshPipelineIndex(blend, depthWrite, doubleSided);
1096 wgpu::RenderPipeline &pipeline =
1097 canvasTarget ? mesh3dCanvasPipelines[index] : mesh3dPipelines[index];
1098 if (pipeline) return pipeline;
1099
1100 WGPUVertexAttribute attrs[5] = {};
1101 fillMeshAttributes(attrs);
1102 WGPUVertexBufferLayout vb{};
1103 fillVertexLayout(vb, sizeof(MeshVertex), attrs, 5);
1104
1105 WGPUDepthStencilState ds{};
1106 ds.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
1107 ds.depthWriteEnabled = depthWrite ? WGPUOptionalBool_True : WGPUOptionalBool_False;
1108 ds.depthCompare = WGPUCompareFunction_Less;
1109
1110 WGPUBlendState blendDesc = blendState(blend);
1111 WGPUColorTargetState target{};
1112 target.format = sceneColorFormat;
1113 target.blend = blend == BlendMode::Opaque ? nullptr : &blendDesc;
1114 target.writeMask = WGPUColorWriteMask_All;
1115
1116 wgpu::ShaderModule vertModule = makeWgslModule(device, kMesh3DVertWgsl);
1117 wgpu::ShaderModule fragModule = makeWgslModule(device, kMesh3DFragWgsl);
1118 WGPUFragmentState fs{};
1119 fs.module = fragModule.Get();
1120 fs.entryPoint = sv("fs_main");
1121 fs.targetCount = 1;
1122 fs.targets = &target;
1123
1124 WGPURenderPipelineDescriptor pd{};
1125 pd.label = canvasTarget ? sv("eve_mesh3d_canvas_surface") : sv("eve_mesh3d_surface");
1126 pd.layout = mesh3dPipelineLayout.Get();
1127 pd.vertex.module = vertModule.Get();
1128 pd.vertex.entryPoint = sv("vs_main");
1129 pd.vertex.bufferCount = 1;
1130 pd.vertex.buffers = &vb;
1131 pd.fragment = &fs;
1132 pd.primitive.topology = WGPUPrimitiveTopology_TriangleList;
1133 pd.primitive.frontFace = WGPUFrontFace_CCW;
1134 pd.primitive.cullMode = doubleSided ? WGPUCullMode_None : WGPUCullMode_Back;
1135 pd.primitive.stripIndexFormat = WGPUIndexFormat_Undefined;
1136 pd.depthStencil = &ds;
1137 pd.multisample.count = canvasTarget ? 1 : sceneColorSamples;
1138 pd.multisample.mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
1139 pipeline = device.CreateRenderPipeline(
1140 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor *>(&pd));
1141
1142 if (!canvasTarget && blend == BlendMode::Opaque && depthWrite && !doubleSided)
1143 mesh3dPipeline = pipeline;
1144 if (!canvasTarget && blend == BlendMode::Alpha && !depthWrite && !doubleSided)
1145 mesh3dTransparentPipeline = pipeline;
1146 if (canvasTarget && blend == BlendMode::Opaque && depthWrite && !doubleSided)
1147 mesh3dCanvasPipeline = pipeline;
1148 return pipeline;
1149}
1150
1151wgpu::RenderPipeline Graphics::getPrimitive3DPipeline(PrimitiveDepthMode depth, BlendMode blend, PrimitiveCullMode cull,
1152 WGPUTextureFormat format, uint32_t sampleCount) {
1153 const uint64_t key = static_cast<uint64_t>(depth) | (static_cast<uint64_t>(blend) << 2u) |
1154 (static_cast<uint64_t>(cull) << 5u) | (static_cast<uint64_t>(uint32_t(format)) << 8u) |
1155 (static_cast<uint64_t>(sampleCount) << 40u);
1156 if (auto found = primitive3DPipelines.find(key); found != primitive3DPipelines.end()) return found->second;
1157
1158 static constexpr const char *kPrimitiveVert = R"wgsl(
1159struct VSIn { @location(0) clipPosition: vec4f, @location(1) color: vec4f };
1160struct VSOut { @builtin(position) position: vec4f, @location(0) color: vec4f };
1161@vertex fn vs_main(input: VSIn) -> VSOut {
1162 var output: VSOut;
1163 output.position = input.clipPosition;
1164 output.color = input.color;
1165 return output;
1166}
1167)wgsl";
1168 static constexpr const char *kPrimitiveFrag = R"wgsl(
1169@fragment fn fs_main(@location(0) color: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { return color; }
1170)wgsl";
1171 wgpu::VertexAttribute attributes[2]{};
1172 attributes[0].format = wgpu::VertexFormat::Float32x4;
1173 attributes[0].offset = offsetof(Primitive3DVertex, clipPosition);
1174 attributes[0].shaderLocation = 0;
1175 attributes[1].format = wgpu::VertexFormat::Float32x4;
1176 attributes[1].offset = offsetof(Primitive3DVertex, color);
1177 attributes[1].shaderLocation = 1;
1178 PipelineBuilder builder;
1179 builder.label("eve_primitive3d")
1180 .vertexLayout(sizeof(Primitive3DVertex), wgpu::VertexStepMode::Vertex, attributes, 2)
1181 .shader(makeWgslModule(device, kPrimitiveVert), "vs_main", makeWgslModule(device, kPrimitiveFrag), "fs_main")
1182 .colorTarget(format, blend)
1183 .depth(WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float,
1184 depth == PrimitiveDepthMode::Ignore ? static_cast<wgpu::CompareFunction>(WGPUCompareFunction_Always)
1185 : wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual,
1186 depth == PrimitiveDepthMode::TestAndWrite)
1187 .sampleCount(sampleCount)
1188 .frontFace(wgpu::FrontFace::CCW)
1189 .cull(cull == PrimitiveCullMode::Back
1190 ? wgpu::CullMode::Back
1191 : (cull == PrimitiveCullMode::Front ? wgpu::CullMode::Front
1192 : static_cast<wgpu::CullMode>(WGPUCullMode_None)));
1193 wgpu::RenderPipeline pipeline = builder.build(device);
1194 primitive3DPipelines.emplace(key, pipeline);
1195 return pipeline;
1196}

1198void Graphics::createMesh3DClusteredPipeline() {
1199 mesh3dClusteredSetLayout = makeMesh3DClusteredBindGroupLayout();
1200 mesh3dClusteredPipelineLayout = makeMesh3DClusteredPipelineLayout();
1201
1202 WGPUVertexAttribute attrs[5] = {};
1203 fillMeshAttributes(attrs);
1204 attrs[0].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x3; // pos
1205 attrs[0].offset = 0;
1206 attrs[0].shaderLocation = 0;
1207 attrs[1].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x3; // normal
1208 attrs[1].offset = 12;
1209 attrs[1].shaderLocation = 1;
1210 attrs[2].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x2; // uv
1211 attrs[2].offset = 24;
1212 attrs[2].shaderLocation = 2;
1213 WGPUVertexBufferLayout vb{};
1214 fillVertexLayout(vb, sizeof(MeshVertex), attrs, 5);
1215
1216 WGPUDepthStencilState ds{};
1217 ds.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
1218 ds.depthWriteEnabled = WGPUOptionalBool_True;
1219 ds.depthCompare = WGPUCompareFunction_Less;
1220 ds.stencilReadMask = 0;
1221 ds.stencilWriteMask = 0;
1222
1223 WGPUColorTargetState target{};
1224 target.format = sceneColorFormat;
1225 target.blend = nullptr;
1226 target.writeMask = WGPUColorWriteMask_All;
1227
1228 WGPURenderPipelineDescriptor pd{};
1229 pd.label = sv("eve_mesh3d_clustered");
1230 pd.layout = mesh3dClusteredPipelineLayout.Get();
1231 wgpu::ShaderModule vertModule = makeWgslModule(device, kMesh3DClusteredVertWgsl);
1232 wgpu::ShaderModule fragModule = makeWgslModule(device, kMesh3DClusteredFragWgsl);
1233 pd.vertex.module = vertModule.Get();
1234 pd.vertex.entryPoint = sv("vs_main");
1235 pd.vertex.bufferCount = 1;
1236 pd.vertex.buffers = &vb;
1237 WGPUFragmentState fs{};
1238 fs.module = fragModule.Get();
1239 fs.entryPoint = sv("fs_main");
1240 fs.targetCount = 1;
1241 fs.targets = &target;
1242 pd.fragment = &fs;
1243 pd.primitive.topology = WGPUPrimitiveTopology_TriangleList;
1244 pd.primitive.frontFace = WGPUFrontFace_CCW;
1245 pd.primitive.cullMode = WGPUCullMode_Back;
1246 pd.primitive.stripIndexFormat = WGPUIndexFormat_Undefined;
1247 pd.depthStencil = &ds;
1248 pd.multisample.count = sceneColorSamples;
1249 pd.multisample.mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
1250 mesh3dClusteredPipeline =
1251 device.CreateRenderPipeline(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor*>(&pd));
1252}

1254void Graphics::createShadowPipelines() {
1255 shadowSetLayout = makeShadowBindGroupLayout();
1256 shadowPipelineLayout = makeShadowPipelineLayout();
1257
1258 WGPUVertexAttribute attrs[5] = {};
1259 fillMeshAttributes(attrs);
1260 attrs[0].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x3;
1261 attrs[0].offset = 0;
1262 attrs[0].shaderLocation = 0;
1263 attrs[1].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x3;
1264 attrs[1].offset = 12;
1265 attrs[1].shaderLocation = 1;
1266 attrs[2].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x2;
1267 attrs[2].offset = 24;
1268 attrs[2].shaderLocation = 2;
1269 WGPUVertexBufferLayout vb{};
1270 fillVertexLayout(vb, sizeof(MeshVertex), attrs, 5);
1271
1272 WGPUDepthStencilState ds{};
1273 ds.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
1274 ds.depthWriteEnabled = WGPUOptionalBool_True;
1275 ds.depthCompare = WGPUCompareFunction_Less;
1276 ds.stencilReadMask = 0;
1277 ds.stencilWriteMask = 0;
1278
1279 WGPURenderPipelineDescriptor pd{};
1280 pd.label = sv("eve_shadow");
1281 pd.layout = shadowPipelineLayout.Get();
1282 wgpu::ShaderModule vertModule = makeWgslModule(device, kMesh3DShadowVertWgsl);
1283 pd.vertex.module = vertModule.Get();
1284 pd.vertex.entryPoint = sv("vs_main");
1285 pd.vertex.bufferCount = 1;
1286 pd.vertex.buffers = &vb;
1287 pd.fragment = nullptr;
1288 pd.primitive.topology = WGPUPrimitiveTopology_TriangleList;
1289 pd.primitive.frontFace = WGPUFrontFace_CCW;
1290 pd.primitive.cullMode = WGPUCullMode_None;
1291 pd.primitive.stripIndexFormat = WGPUIndexFormat_Undefined;
1292 pd.depthStencil = &ds;
1293 pd.multisample.count = 1;
1294 // Zero-init would leave mask=0, which discards every fragment

1298
1299 wgpu::ShaderModule alphaVertModule = makeWgslModule(device, kMesh3DShadowAlphaVertWgsl);
1300 wgpu::ShaderModule alphaFragModule = makeWgslModule(device, kMesh3DShadowAlphaFragWgsl);

1321 attrs[0].shaderLocation = 0;
1322 attrs[1].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x3;

1360 pd.primitive.topology = WGPUPrimitiveTopology_TriangleList;
1361 pd.primitive.frontFace = WGPUFrontFace_CCW;
1362 pd.primitive.cullMode = WGPUCullMode_None;
1363 pd.primitive.stripIndexFormat = WGPUIndexFormat_Undefined;

1365 pd.multisample.count = 1;

1368 pd.multisample.mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
1369 mesh3dGbufferPipeline = device.CreateRenderPipeline(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor*>(&pd));
1370

1372 pd.label = sv("eve_gbuffer_alpha");

1378void Graphics::createDecalPipeline() {
1379 decalSetLayout = makeDecalBindGroupLayout();
1380 decalPipelineLayout = makeDecalPipelineLayout();
1381 wgpu::ShaderModule vert = makeWgslModule(device, kDecalVertWgsl);
1382 wgpu::ShaderModule frag = makeWgslModule(device, kDecalFragWgsl);
1383 WGPUBlendState blend = alphaBlend();
1384 WGPUColorTargetState targets[3]{};
1385 for (auto &target : targets) {
1386 target.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm;
1387 target.blend = &blend;
1388 target.writeMask = WGPUColorWriteMask_All;
1389 }
1390 WGPUFragmentState fs{};
1391 fs.module = frag.Get();
1392 fs.entryPoint = sv("fs_main");
1393 fs.targetCount = 3;
1394 fs.targets = targets;
1395 WGPURenderPipelineDescriptor pd{};
1396 pd.label = sv("eve_decal");
1397 pd.layout = decalPipelineLayout.Get();
1398 pd.vertex.module = vert.Get();
1399 pd.vertex.entryPoint = sv("vs_main");
1400 pd.fragment = &fs;
1401 pd.primitive.topology = WGPUPrimitiveTopology_TriangleList;
1402 // kMesh3DVertWgsl mirrors clip-space Y, so object-space CCW becomes
1403 // clockwise in framebuffer space (the Vulkan pipeline uses Clockwise).
1404 pd.primitive.frontFace = WGPUFrontFace_CW;
1405 pd.primitive.cullMode = WGPUCullMode_None;
1406 pd.multisample.count = 1;
1407 pd.multisample.mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
1408 decalPipeline =
1409 device.CreateRenderPipeline(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor *>(&pd));
1410}

1412void Graphics::createVoxelPipelines() {
1413 voxelSetLayout = makeVoxelBindGroupLayout();
1414 voxelPipelineLayout = makeVoxelPipelineLayout();
1415
1416 WGPUVertexAttribute attrs[1] = {};
1417 attrs[0].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x2; // corner
1418 attrs[0].offset = 0;
1419 attrs[0].shaderLocation = 0;
1420 WGPUVertexBufferLayout cornerVb{};
1421 cornerVb.arrayStride = 8;
1422 cornerVb.stepMode = WGPUVertexStepMode_Vertex;
1423 cornerVb.attributeCount = 1;
1424 cornerVb.attributes = attrs;
1425
1426 WGPUVertexAttribute packedAttr{};
1427 packedAttr.format = WGPUVertexFormat_Uint32; // packed rect word
1428 packedAttr.offset = 0;
1429 packedAttr.shaderLocation = 1;
1430 WGPUVertexBufferLayout packedVb{};
1431 packedVb.arrayStride = 4;
1432 packedVb.stepMode = WGPUVertexStepMode_Instance;
1433 packedVb.attributeCount = 1;
1434 packedVb.attributes = &packedAttr;
1435
1436 WGPUVertexAttribute aoAttr{};
1437 aoAttr.format = WGPUVertexFormat_Uint32; // 2 bits per corner
1438 aoAttr.offset = 0;
1439 aoAttr.shaderLocation = 2;
1440 WGPUVertexBufferLayout aoVb{};
1441 aoVb.arrayStride = 4;
1442 aoVb.stepMode = WGPUVertexStepMode_Instance;
1443 aoVb.attributeCount = 1;
1444 aoVb.attributes = &aoAttr;
1445
1446 WGPUVertexBufferLayout vbs[3] = {cornerVb, packedVb, aoVb};
1447
1448 WGPUDepthStencilState ds{};
1449 ds.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
1450 ds.depthWriteEnabled = WGPUOptionalBool_True;
1451 ds.depthCompare = WGPUCompareFunction_Less;
1452 ds.stencilReadMask = 0;
1453 ds.stencilWriteMask = 0;
1454
1455 WGPUColorTargetState target{};
1456 target.format = sceneColorFormat;
1457 target.blend = nullptr;
1458 target.writeMask = WGPUColorWriteMask_All;
1459
1460 WGPURenderPipelineDescriptor pd{};
1461 pd.label = sv("eve_voxel");
1462 pd.layout = voxelPipelineLayout.Get();
1463 wgpu::ShaderModule vertModule = makeWgslModule(device, kVoxelRectVertWgsl);
1464 wgpu::ShaderModule fragModule = makeWgslModule(device, kVoxelRectFragWgsl);
1465 pd.vertex.module = vertModule.Get();
1466 pd.vertex.entryPoint = sv("vs_main");
1467 pd.vertex.bufferCount = 3;
1468 pd.vertex.buffers = vbs;
1469 WGPUFragmentState fs{};
1470 fs.module = fragModule.Get();
1471 fs.entryPoint = sv("fs_main");
1472 fs.targetCount = 1;
1473 fs.targets = &target;
1474 pd.fragment = &fs;
1475 pd.primitive.topology = WGPUPrimitiveTopology_TriangleList;
1476 pd.primitive.frontFace = WGPUFrontFace_CCW;
1477 pd.primitive.cullMode = WGPUCullMode_None;
1478 pd.primitive.stripIndexFormat = WGPUIndexFormat_Undefined;
1479 pd.depthStencil = &ds;
1480 pd.multisample.count = sceneColorSamples;
1481 // Zero-init would leave mask=0, which discards every fragment
1482 // (sampleMask=0). The WebGPU default is 0xFFFFFFFF (all samples).
1483 pd.multisample.mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
1484 voxelRectPipeline = device.CreateRenderPipeline(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor*>(&pd));
1485
1486 // Unit quad for instanced voxel faces (2 triangles, corner + packed uv slot).
1487 float quad[8] = {0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1};
1488 WGPUBufferDescriptor bd{};
1489 bd.label = sv("eve_voxel_quad");
1490 bd.size = sizeof(quad);
1491 bd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Vertex;
1492 bd.mappedAtCreation = false;
1493 voxelUnitQuadVerts = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&bd));
1494 queue.WriteBuffer(voxelUnitQuadVerts, 0, quad, sizeof(quad));
1495
1496 uint32_t indices[6] = {0, 1, 2, 2, 3, 0};
1497 WGPUBufferDescriptor ibd{};
1498 ibd.label = sv("eve_voxel_quad_idx");
1499 ibd.size = sizeof(indices);
1500 ibd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Index;
1501 ibd.mappedAtCreation = false;
1502 voxelUnitQuadIndices = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&ibd));
1503 queue.WriteBuffer(voxelUnitQuadIndices, 0, indices, sizeof(indices));
1504}

1509
1510void Graphics::ensureAOResources(int width, int height) {
1511 if (!device || width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;
1512 if (!aoSetLayout) {
1513 BindGroupLayoutBuilder b;
1514 b.buffer(0, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform, false, 32);
1515 b.texture(1, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
1516 wgpu::TextureViewDimension::e2D);
1517 b.sampler(2, wgpu::ShaderStage::Fragment, wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering);
1518 aoSetLayout = b.build(device, "eve_ao");
1519 WGPUBindGroupLayout layouts[1] = {aoSetLayout.Get()};
1520 WGPUPipelineLayoutDescriptor pl{};
1521 pl.label = sv("eve_ao_layout");
1522 pl.bindGroupLayoutCount = 1;
1523 pl.bindGroupLayouts = layouts;
1524 aoPipelineLayout =
1525 device.CreatePipelineLayout(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor*>(&pl));
1526
1527 WGPUVertexAttribute attrs[3]{};
1528 attrs[0].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x2;
1529 attrs[0].offset = 0;
1530 attrs[0].shaderLocation = 0;
1531 attrs[1].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x4;
1532 attrs[1].offset = 8;
1533 attrs[1].shaderLocation = 1;
1534 attrs[2].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x2;
1535 attrs[2].offset = 24;
1536 attrs[2].shaderLocation = 2;
1537 WGPUVertexBufferLayout vb{};
1538 fillVertexLayout(vb, 32, attrs, 3);
1539
1540 WGPUColorTargetState target{};
1541 target.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm;
1542 target.blend = nullptr;
1543 target.writeMask = WGPUColorWriteMask_All;
1544
1545 WGPURenderPipelineDescriptor pd{};
1546 pd.label = sv("eve_ssao");
1547 pd.layout = aoPipelineLayout.Get();
1548 wgpu::ShaderModule vertModule = makeWgslModule(device, kTexturedVertWgsl);
1549 wgpu::ShaderModule fragModule = makeWgslModule(device, kSSAOFragWgsl);
1550 pd.vertex.module = vertModule.Get();
1551 pd.vertex.entryPoint = sv("vs_main");
1552 pd.vertex.bufferCount = 1;
1553 pd.vertex.buffers = &vb;
1554 WGPUFragmentState fs{};
1555 fs.module = fragModule.Get();
1556 fs.entryPoint = sv("fs_main");
1557 fs.targetCount = 1;
1558 fs.targets = &target;
1559 pd.fragment = &fs;
1560 pd.primitive.topology = WGPUPrimitiveTopology_TriangleList;
1561 pd.primitive.frontFace = WGPUFrontFace_CCW;
1562 pd.primitive.cullMode = WGPUCullMode_None;
1563 pd.primitive.stripIndexFormat = WGPUIndexFormat_Undefined;
1564 pd.multisample.count = 1;
1565 pd.multisample.mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
1566 aoPipeline =
1567 device.CreateRenderPipeline(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor*>(&pd));
1568 }
1569 if (!aoUbo) {
1570 WGPUBufferDescriptor bd{};
1571 bd.label = sv("eve_ao_ubo");
1572 bd.size = 64;
1573 bd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Uniform;
1574 bd.mappedAtCreation = false;
1575 aoUbo = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&bd));
1576 }
1577 if (!aoTex[0]) {
1578 for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
1579 WGPUTextureDescriptor td{};
1580 td.label = sv("eve_ao");
1581 td.dimension = WGPUTextureDimension_2D;
1582 // Half-resolution AO: the bilinear upsample in the mesh pass blurs
1583 // the per-pixel sampling grain that otherwise reads as noise.
1584 td.size = {static_cast<uint32_t>((width + 1) / 2),
1585 static_cast<uint32_t>((height + 1) / 2), 1};
1586 td.sampleCount = 1;
1587 td.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm;
1588 td.mipLevelCount = 1;
1589 td.usage = WGPUTextureUsage_TextureBinding | WGPUTextureUsage_RenderAttachment;
1590 aoTex[i] = device.CreateTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor*>(&td));
1591 aoView[i] = aoTex[i].CreateView();
1592 }
1593 aoReady = true;
1594 // New AO binding �?rebuild cached mesh bind groups.
1595 clearMeshBindGroupCache();
1596 }
1597 if (!fullscreenQuadReady) {
1598 float verts[32] = {
1599 -1.f, -1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.f, 0.f,
1600 1.f, -1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.f,
1601 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f,
1602 -1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.f, 1.f,
1603 };
1604 uint32_t indices[6] = {0, 1, 2, 2, 3, 0};
1605 WGPUBufferDescriptor vbd{};
1606 vbd.label = sv("eve_fullscreen_vb");
1607 vbd.size = sizeof(verts);
1608 vbd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Vertex;
1609 fullscreenQuadVb = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&vbd));
1610 queue.WriteBuffer(fullscreenQuadVb, 0, verts, sizeof(verts));
1611 WGPUBufferDescriptor ibd{};
1612 ibd.label = sv("eve_fullscreen_ib");
1613 ibd.size = sizeof(indices);
1614 ibd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Index;
1615 fullscreenQuadIb = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&ibd));
1616 queue.WriteBuffer(fullscreenQuadIb, 0, indices, sizeof(indices));
1617 fullscreenQuadReady = true;
1618 }
1619}
1620
1621wgpu::BindGroup Graphics::makeAOBindGroup(wgpu::TextureView depthView) {
1622 WGPUBindGroupEntry entries[3]{};
1623 entries[0].binding = 0;
1624 entries[0].buffer = aoUbo.Get();
1625 entries[0].size = 32;
1626 entries[1].binding = 1;
1627 entries[1].textureView = depthView.Get();
1628 entries[2].binding = 2;
1629 entries[2].sampler = mainSampler.Get();
1630 WGPUBindGroupDescriptor desc{};
1631 desc.label = sv("eve_ao_group");
1632 desc.layout = aoSetLayout.Get();
1633 desc.entryCount = 3;
1634 desc.entries = entries;
1635 return device.CreateBindGroup(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor*>(&desc));
1636}

1642uint32_t Graphics::UboArena::alloc(uint64_t size, uint64_t alignment) {
1643 uint64_t aligned = (used + alignment - 1) / alignment * alignment;
1644 used = aligned + size;
1645 return static_cast<uint32_t>(aligned);
1646}

1648uint64_t Graphics::VertexArena::alloc(uint64_t bytes) {
1649 uint64_t at = used;
1650 used += bytes;

1652}

1654Graphics::UboArena &Graphics::currentUboArena() { return uboArenas[currentFrameSlot()]; }

1656
1657void Graphics::ensureUboArena(UboArena &arena, uint64_t bytes) {
1658 if (arena.buffer && arena.capacity >= bytes) return;
1659 uint64_t size = arena.capacity;
1660 while (size < bytes) size = size ? size * 2 : (64u << 10);
1661 WGPUBufferDescriptor bd{};
1662 bd.label = sv("eve_ubo_arena");
1663 bd.size = size;
1664 bd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Uniform;
1665 bd.mappedAtCreation = false;
1666 arena.buffer = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&bd));
1667 arena.capacity = size;
1668 arena.used = 0;
1669}
1670
1671void Graphics::ensureVertexArena(VertexArena &arena, uint64_t bytes) {
1672 if (arena.buffer && arena.capacity >= bytes) return;
1673 uint64_t size = arena.capacity;
1674 while (size < bytes) size = size ? size * 2 : (256u << 10);
1675 WGPUBufferDescriptor bd{};
1676 bd.label = sv("eve_vertex_arena");
1677 bd.size = size;
1678 bd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Vertex;
1679 bd.mappedAtCreation = false;
1680 arena.buffer = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&bd));
1681 arena.capacity = size;
1682 arena.used = 0;
1683}

1685// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1686// Sampler
1687// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1688
1689wgpu::Sampler Graphics::makeSampler(const TextureSampler &s, uint32_t mipLevels) const {
1690 WGPUSamplerDescriptor d{};
1691 d.label = sv("eve_sampler");
1692 d.addressModeU = s.repeatU ? WGPUAddressMode_Repeat : WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
1693 d.addressModeV = s.repeatV ? WGPUAddressMode_Repeat : WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
1694 d.addressModeW = s.repeatW ? WGPUAddressMode_Repeat : WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
1695 d.magFilter = s.mag == FilterMode::Nearest ? WGPUFilterMode_Nearest : WGPUFilterMode_Linear;
1696 d.minFilter = s.min == FilterMode::Nearest ? WGPUFilterMode_Nearest : WGPUFilterMode_Linear;
1697 if (s.mipmap == MipmapMode::Disabled || mipLevels <= 1) {
1698 d.mipmapFilter = WGPUMipmapFilterMode_Nearest;
1699 d.lodMinClamp = 0.f;
1700 d.lodMaxClamp = 0.f;
1701 } else {
1702 d.mipmapFilter =
1703 s.mipmap == MipmapMode::Nearest ? WGPUMipmapFilterMode_Nearest : WGPUMipmapFilterMode_Linear;
1704 d.lodMinClamp = s.minLod;
1705 d.lodMaxClamp = std::min(std::max(s.maxLod, 0.f), float(mipLevels - 1));
1706 if (d.lodMaxClamp < d.lodMinClamp) d.lodMaxClamp = d.lodMinClamp;
1707 }
1708 float aniso = s.maxAnisotropy > 1.f ? s.maxAnisotropy : 1.f;
1709 d.maxAnisotropy = std::min(std::max(aniso, 1.f), std::max(maxSamplerAnisotropy, 1.f));
1710 return device.CreateSampler(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::SamplerDescriptor*>(&d));
1711}
