1739
1740Texture *Graphics::newTexture(int width, int height, const uint8_t *rgba,
1741 const TextureCreateInfo &rawInfo) {
1742 if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) throw Exception("newTexture: invalid size %dx%d", width, height);
1743
1744 TextureCreateInfo info = rawInfo;
1745 if (info.generateMipmaps && info.sampler.mipmap == MipmapMode::Disabled)
1746 info.sampler.mipmap = MipmapMode::Linear;
1747 if (info.sampler.maxAnisotropy < 1.f) info.sampler.maxAnisotropy = 1.f;
1748
1749 auto gpu = std::make_unique<GpuTexture>();
1750 gpu->width = width;
1751 gpu->height = height;
1752 gpu->samplerState = info.sampler;
1753 gpu->mipLevels = info.generateMipmaps ? uint32_t(mipmapCountForSize(width, height)) : 1u;
1754
1755 WGPUTextureDescriptor td{};
1756 td.label = sv("eve_tex2d");
1757 td.dimension = WGPUTextureDimension_2D;
1758 td.size.width = static_cast<uint32_t>(width);
1759 td.size.height = static_cast<uint32_t>(height);
1760 td.size.depthOrArrayLayers = 1;
1761 td.sampleCount = 1;
1762 td.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm;
1763 td.mipLevelCount = gpu->mipLevels;
1764 td.usage = WGPUTextureUsage_TextureBinding | WGPUTextureUsage_CopyDst |
1765 WGPUTextureUsage_RenderAttachment;
1766 gpu->texture = device.CreateTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor*>(&td));
1767
1768 uploadTexturePixelsMips(gpu.get(), rgba, width, height);
1769
1770 WGPUTextureViewDescriptor vd{};
1771 vd.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm;
1772 vd.dimension = WGPUTextureViewDimension_2D;
1773 vd.baseMipLevel = 0;
1774 vd.mipLevelCount = gpu->mipLevels;
1775 vd.baseArrayLayer = 0;
1776 vd.arrayLayerCount = 1;
1777 gpu->view = gpu->texture.CreateView(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor*>(&vd));
1778 gpu->sampler = makeSampler(info.sampler, gpu->mipLevels);
1779
1780 auto *tex = new Texture();
1781 tex->width = width;
1782 tex->height = height;
1783 tex->mipmapCount = int(gpu->mipLevels);
1784 tex->sampler = info.sampler;
1785 tex->gpuHandle = gpu.get();
1786
1787 ownedGpuTextures.push_back(std::move(gpu));
1788 ownedTextures.push_back(std::unique_ptr<Texture>(tex));
1789 return tex;
1790}
1791
1792void Graphics::uploadTexturePixels(GpuTexture *gt, const uint8_t *rgba, int w, int h,
1793 const TextureCreateInfo &info) {
1794 (void)info;
1795 uploadTexturePixelsMips(gt, rgba, w, h);
1796}
1797
1798void Graphics::uploadTexturePixelsMips(GpuTexture *gt, const uint8_t *rgba, int w, int h) {
1799 if (!rgba) return;
1800 std::vector<uint8_t> current;
1801 WGPUTexelCopyBufferLayout layout{};
1802 layout.offset = 0;
1803 layout.bytesPerRow = static_cast<uint32_t>(w * 4);
1804 layout.rowsPerImage = static_cast<uint32_t>(h);
1805 WGPUExtent3D extent{static_cast<uint32_t>(w), static_cast<uint32_t>(h), 1};
1806
1807 for (uint32_t m = 0; m < gt->mipLevels; ++m) {
1808 WGPUTexelCopyTextureInfo dst{};
1809 dst.texture = gt->texture.Get();
1810 dst.mipLevel = m;
1811 dst.aspect = WGPUTextureAspect_All;
1812 queue.WriteTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo*>(&dst), rgba,
1813 static_cast<uint64_t>(w) * h * 4,
1814 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout*>(&layout),
1815 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::Extent3D*>(&extent));
1816 if (m + 1 < gt->mipLevels) {
1817 // Box-filter downsample into the CPU buffer for the next level.
1818 const int nextW = std::max(w / 2, 1);
1819 const int nextH = std::max(h / 2, 1);
1820 std::vector<uint8_t> next(size_t(nextW) * size_t(nextH) * 4u);
1821 for (int y = 0; y < nextH; ++y) {
1822 const int y0 = std::min(y * 2, h - 1);
1823 const int y1 = std::min(y0 + 1, h - 1);
1824 for (int x = 0; x < nextW; ++x) {
1825 const int x0 = std::min(x * 2, w - 1);
1826 const int x1 = std::min(x0 + 1, w - 1);
1827 for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {
1828 uint32_t acc = 0;
1829 acc += rgba[(size_t(y0) * w + x0) * 4u + c];
1830 acc += rgba[(size_t(y0) * w + x1) * 4u + c];
1831 acc += rgba[(size_t(y1) * w + x0) * 4u + c];
1832 acc += rgba[(size_t(y1) * w + x1) * 4u + c];
1833 next[(size_t(y) * nextW + x) * 4u + c] = uint8_t((acc + 2u) / 4u);
1834 }
1835 }
1836 }
1837 current = std::move(next);
1838 w = nextW;
1839 h = nextH;
1840 rgba = current.data();
1841 layout.bytesPerRow = static_cast<uint32_t>(w * 4);
1842 layout.rowsPerImage = static_cast<uint32_t>(h);
1843 extent = {static_cast<uint32_t>(w), static_cast<uint32_t>(h), 1};
1844 }
1845 }
1846}
1847
1848Texture *Graphics::newCubemap(int faceSize, const uint8_t *rgbaFaces) {
1849 TextureCreateInfo info;
1850 return newCubemap(faceSize, rgbaFaces, info);
1851}
1852
1853Texture *Graphics::newCubemap(int faceSize, const uint8_t *rgbaFaces,
1854 const TextureCreateInfo &rawInfo) {
1855 if (faceSize <= 0 || !rgbaFaces)
1856 throw Exception("newCubemap: invalid size or null data");
1857
1858 TextureCreateInfo info = rawInfo;
1859 if (info.generateMipmaps && info.sampler.mipmap == MipmapMode::Disabled)
1860 info.sampler.mipmap = MipmapMode::Linear;
1861 if (info.sampler.maxAnisotropy < 1.f) info.sampler.maxAnisotropy = 1.f;
1862
1863 auto gpu = std::make_unique<GpuTexture>();
1864 gpu->width = faceSize;
1865 gpu->height = faceSize;
1866 gpu->samplerState = info.sampler;
1867 gpu->isCube = true;
1868 gpu->mipLevels = info.generateMipmaps ? uint32_t(mipmapCountForSize(faceSize, faceSize)) : 1u;
1869
1870 WGPUTextureDescriptor td{};
1871 td.label = sv("eve_cubemap");
1872 td.dimension = WGPUTextureDimension_2D;
1873 td.size.width = static_cast<uint32_t>(faceSize);
1874 td.size.height = static_cast<uint32_t>(faceSize);
1875 td.size.depthOrArrayLayers = 6;
1876 td.sampleCount = 1;
1877 td.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm;
1878 td.mipLevelCount = gpu->mipLevels;
1879 td.usage = WGPUTextureUsage_TextureBinding | WGPUTextureUsage_CopyDst;
1880 gpu->texture = device.CreateTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor*>(&td));
1881
1882 const std::vector<uint8_t> mipChain =
1883 buildGgxCubemapMipChain(rgbaFaces, uint32_t(faceSize), gpu->mipLevels);
1884 size_t mipOffset = 0;
1885 int mipW = faceSize;
1886 int mipH = faceSize;
1887 for (uint32_t mip = 0; mip < gpu->mipLevels; ++mip) {
1888 const size_t mipFaceBytes = size_t(mipW) * mipH * 4u;
1889 for (int f = 0; f < 6; ++f) {
1890 const uint8_t *pixels = mipChain.data() + mipOffset + size_t(f) * mipFaceBytes;
1891 WGPUTexelCopyBufferLayout layout{};
1892 layout.offset = 0;
1893 layout.bytesPerRow = static_cast<uint32_t>(mipW * 4);
1894 layout.rowsPerImage = static_cast<uint32_t>(mipH);
1895 WGPUExtent3D extent{static_cast<uint32_t>(mipW), static_cast<uint32_t>(mipH), 1};
1896 WGPUTexelCopyTextureInfo dst{};
1897 dst.texture = gpu->texture.Get();
1898 dst.mipLevel = mip;
1899 dst.aspect = WGPUTextureAspect_All;
1900 dst.origin = {0, 0, static_cast<uint32_t>(f)};
1901 queue.WriteTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo*>(&dst), pixels,
1902 static_cast<uint64_t>(mipW) * mipH * 4,
1903 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout*>(&layout),
1904 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::Extent3D*>(&extent));
1905 }
1906 mipOffset += mipFaceBytes * 6u;
1907 mipW = std::max(mipW / 2, 1);
1908 mipH = std::max(mipH / 2, 1);
1909 }
1910
1911 WGPUTextureViewDescriptor vd{};
1912 vd.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm;
1913 vd.dimension = WGPUTextureViewDimension_Cube;
1914 vd.baseMipLevel = 0;
1915 vd.mipLevelCount = gpu->mipLevels;
1916 vd.baseArrayLayer = 0;
1917 vd.arrayLayerCount = 6;
1918 gpu->view = gpu->texture.CreateView(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor*>(&vd));
1919 gpu->sampler = makeSampler(info.sampler, gpu->mipLevels);
1920
1921 auto *tex = new Texture();
1922 tex->width = faceSize;
1923 tex->height = faceSize;
1924 tex->mipmapCount = int(gpu->mipLevels);
1925 tex->sampler = info.sampler;
1926 tex->gpuHandle = gpu.get();
1927
1928 ownedGpuTextures.push_back(std::move(gpu));
1929 ownedTextures.push_back(std::unique_ptr<Texture>(tex));
1930 return tex;
1931}
1932
1933Texture *Graphics::newHDRCubemap(int faceSize) {
1934 if (faceSize <= 0) throw Exception("newHDRCubemap: invalid face size");
1935 auto gpu = std::make_unique<GpuTexture>();
1936 gpu->width = faceSize;
1937 gpu->height = faceSize;
1938 gpu->isCube = true;
1939 gpu->isHDR = true;
1940 gpu->mipLevels = uint32_t(mipmapCountForSize(faceSize, faceSize));
1941 gpu->samplerState = TextureSampler::linear();
1942 gpu->samplerState.mipmap = MipmapMode::Linear;
1943
1944 WGPUTextureDescriptor td{};
1945 td.label = sv("eve_hdr_reflection_probe_staging");
1946 td.dimension = WGPUTextureDimension_2D;
1947 td.size = {static_cast<uint32_t>(faceSize), static_cast<uint32_t>(faceSize), 6};
1948 td.sampleCount = 1;
1949 td.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float;
1950 td.mipLevelCount = gpu->mipLevels;
1951 td.usage = WGPUTextureUsage_TextureBinding | WGPUTextureUsage_CopyDst |
1952 WGPUTextureUsage_CopySrc | WGPUTextureUsage_RenderAttachment;
1953 gpu->texture = device.CreateTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor *>(&td));
1954
1955 WGPUTextureViewDescriptor vd{};
1956 vd.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float;
1957 vd.dimension = WGPUTextureViewDimension_Cube;
1958 vd.baseMipLevel = 0;
1959 vd.mipLevelCount = gpu->mipLevels;
1960 vd.baseArrayLayer = 0;
1961 vd.arrayLayerCount = 6;
1962 gpu->view = gpu->texture.CreateView(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor *>(&vd));
1963 gpu->sampler = makeSampler(gpu->samplerState, gpu->mipLevels);
1964
1965 auto *texture = new Texture();
1966 texture->width = faceSize;
1967 texture->height = faceSize;
1968 texture->mipmapCount = int(gpu->mipLevels);
1969 texture->sampler = gpu->samplerState;
1970 texture->gpuHandle = gpu.get();
1971 ownedGpuTextures.push_back(std::move(gpu));
1972 ownedTextures.emplace_back(texture);
1973 return texture;
1974}
1975
1976bool Graphics::copyHDRCanvasToCubemapFace(Canvas *source, Texture *cubemap, int face) {
1977 auto *canvas = dynamic_cast<OffscreenCanvas *>(source);
1978 if (!canvas || !canvas->hdr || !cubemap || !cubemap->gpuHandle || face < 0 || face >= 6)
1979 return false;
1980 auto *target = static_cast<GpuTexture *>(cubemap->gpuHandle);
1981 if (!target->isCube || !target->isHDR || target->width != canvas->width ||
1982 target->height != canvas->height)
1983 return false;
1984
1985 wgpu::CommandEncoder encoder = device.CreateCommandEncoder();
1986 WGPUTexelCopyTextureInfo src{};
1987 src.texture = canvas->color.Get();
1988 src.mipLevel = 0;
1989 src.aspect = WGPUTextureAspect_All;
1990 src.origin = {0, 0, 0};
1991 WGPUTexelCopyTextureInfo dst{};
1992 dst.texture = target->texture.Get();
1993 dst.mipLevel = 0;
1994 dst.aspect = WGPUTextureAspect_All;
1995 dst.origin = {0, 0, static_cast<uint32_t>(face)};
1996 WGPUExtent3D extent{static_cast<uint32_t>(canvas->width),
1997 static_cast<uint32_t>(canvas->height), 1};
1998 encoder.CopyTextureToTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo *>(&src),
1999 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo *>(&dst),
2000 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::Extent3D *>(&extent));
2001 wgpu::CommandBuffer command = encoder.Finish();
2002 queue.Submit(1, &command);
2003 return true;
2004}
2005
2006bool Graphics::copyHDRCanvasesToCubemap(Canvas *const *sources, int faceCount,
2007 Texture *cubemap) {
2008 if (!sources || faceCount < 1 || faceCount > 6 || !cubemap || !cubemap->gpuHandle)
2009 return false;
2010 auto *target = static_cast<GpuTexture *>(cubemap->gpuHandle);
2011 if (!target->isCube || !target->isHDR) return false;
2012
2013 std::array<OffscreenCanvas *, 6> canvases{};
2014 for (int face = 0; face < faceCount; ++face) {
2015 auto *canvas = dynamic_cast<OffscreenCanvas *>(sources[face]);
2016 if (!canvas || !canvas->hdr || target->width != canvas->width ||
2017 target->height != canvas->height)
2018 return false;
2019 canvases[static_cast<size_t>(face)] = canvas;
2020 }
2021
2022 wgpu::CommandEncoder encoder = device.CreateCommandEncoder();
2023 for (int face = 0; face < faceCount; ++face) {
2024 const auto *canvas = canvases[static_cast<size_t>(face)];
2025 WGPUTexelCopyTextureInfo src{};
2026 src.texture = canvas->color.Get();
2027 src.mipLevel = 0;
2028 src.aspect = WGPUTextureAspect_All;
2029 src.origin = {0, 0, 0};
2030 WGPUTexelCopyTextureInfo dst{};
2031 dst.texture = target->texture.Get();
2032 dst.mipLevel = 0;
2033 dst.aspect = WGPUTextureAspect_All;
2034 dst.origin = {0, 0, static_cast<uint32_t>(face)};
2035 WGPUExtent3D extent{static_cast<uint32_t>(canvas->width),
2036 static_cast<uint32_t>(canvas->height), 1};
2037 encoder.CopyTextureToTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo *>(&src),
2038 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo *>(&dst),
2039 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::Extent3D *>(&extent));
2040 }
2041 wgpu::CommandBuffer command = encoder.Finish();
2042 queue.Submit(1, &command);
2043 return true;
2044}
2045
2046bool Graphics::filterHDRReflectionCubemap(Texture *cubemap, int sampleCount) {
2047 if (!cubemap || !cubemap->gpuHandle) return false;
2048 auto *target = static_cast<GpuTexture *>(cubemap->gpuHandle);
2049 if (!target->isCube || !target->isHDR || target->mipLevels < 2) return false;
2050 sampleCount = std::clamp(sampleCount, 8, 512);
2051 wgpuInstanceProcessEvents(instance.Get());
2052 OffscreenTimestampReadback *timestampSlot = nullptr;
2053 if (offscreenTimestampSupported && offscreenTimestampQuerySet &&
2054 offscreenTimestampResolveBuffer) {
2055 for (size_t candidate = 0; candidate < offscreenTimestampReadbacks.size(); ++candidate) {
2056 const size_t index =
2057 (offscreenTimestampReadbackCursor + candidate) % offscreenTimestampReadbacks.size();
2058 if (!offscreenTimestampReadbacks[index].pending) {
2059 timestampSlot = &offscreenTimestampReadbacks[index];
2060 offscreenTimestampReadbackCursor =
2061 (index + 1) % offscreenTimestampReadbacks.size();
2062 break;
2063 }
2064 }
2065 }
2066
2067 if (!reflectionProbeFilterPipeline) {
2068 WGPUBindGroupLayoutEntry entries[3]{};
2069 entries[0].binding = 0;
2070 entries[0].visibility = WGPUShaderStage_Fragment;
2071 entries[0].texture.sampleType = WGPUTextureSampleType_Float;
2072 entries[0].texture.viewDimension = WGPUTextureViewDimension_Cube;
2073 entries[1].binding = 1;
2074 entries[1].visibility = WGPUShaderStage_Fragment;
2075 entries[1].sampler.type = WGPUSamplerBindingType_Filtering;
2076 entries[2].binding = 2;
2077 entries[2].visibility = WGPUShaderStage_Fragment;
2078 entries[2].buffer.type = WGPUBufferBindingType_Uniform;
2079 entries[2].buffer.hasDynamicOffset = true;
2080 entries[2].buffer.minBindingSize = 16;
2081 WGPUBindGroupLayoutDescriptor bgl{};
2082 bgl.label = sv("eve_reflection_probe_filter_bgl");
2083 bgl.entryCount = 3;
2084 bgl.entries = entries;
2085 reflectionProbeFilterSetLayout = device.CreateBindGroupLayout(
2086 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor *>(&bgl));
2087 WGPUBindGroupLayout rawLayout = reflectionProbeFilterSetLayout.Get();
2088 WGPUPipelineLayoutDescriptor pld{};
2089 pld.label = sv("eve_reflection_probe_filter_layout");
2090 pld.bindGroupLayoutCount = 1;
2091 pld.bindGroupLayouts = &rawLayout;
2092 reflectionProbeFilterPipelineLayout = device.CreatePipelineLayout(
2093 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor *>(&pld));
2094
2095 wgpu::ShaderModule module = makeWgslModule(device, shaders::kReflectionProbeFilterWgsl);
2096 WGPUColorTargetState colorTarget{};
2097 colorTarget.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float;
2098 colorTarget.writeMask = WGPUColorWriteMask_All;
2099 WGPUFragmentState fragment{};
2100 fragment.module = module.Get();
2101 fragment.entryPoint = sv("fs_main");
2102 fragment.targetCount = 1;
2103 fragment.targets = &colorTarget;
2104 WGPURenderPipelineDescriptor pipeline{};
2105 pipeline.label = sv("eve_reflection_probe_filter");
2106 pipeline.layout = reflectionProbeFilterPipelineLayout.Get();
2107 pipeline.vertex.module = module.Get();
2108 pipeline.vertex.entryPoint = sv("vs_main");
2109 pipeline.fragment = &fragment;
2110 pipeline.primitive.topology = WGPUPrimitiveTopology_TriangleList;
2111 pipeline.primitive.frontFace = WGPUFrontFace_CCW;
2112 pipeline.primitive.cullMode = WGPUCullMode_None;
2113 pipeline.multisample.count = 1;
2114 pipeline.multisample.mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
2115 reflectionProbeFilterPipeline = device.CreateRenderPipeline(
2116 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor *>(&pipeline));
2117 }
2118
2119 const uint32_t passCount = (target->mipLevels - 1u) * 6u;
2120 WGPUBufferDescriptor bufferDesc{};
2121 bufferDesc.label = sv("eve_reflection_probe_filter_params");
2122 bufferDesc.size = uint64_t(passCount) * 256u;
2123 bufferDesc.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_Uniform | WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst;
2124 wgpu::Buffer paramsBuffer =
2125 device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor *>(&bufferDesc));
2126 WGPUTextureViewDescriptor sourceViewDesc{};
2127 sourceViewDesc.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float;
2128 sourceViewDesc.dimension = WGPUTextureViewDimension_Cube;
2129 sourceViewDesc.baseMipLevel = 0;
2130 sourceViewDesc.mipLevelCount = 1;
2131 sourceViewDesc.baseArrayLayer = 0;
2132 sourceViewDesc.arrayLayerCount = 6;
2133 wgpu::TextureView sourceView = target->texture.CreateView(
2134 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor *>(&sourceViewDesc));
2135 WGPUBindGroupEntry groupEntries[3]{};
2136 groupEntries[0].binding = 0;
2137 groupEntries[0].textureView = sourceView.Get();
2138 groupEntries[1].binding = 1;
2139 groupEntries[1].sampler = target->sampler.Get();
2140 groupEntries[2].binding = 2;
2141 groupEntries[2].buffer = paramsBuffer.Get();
2142 groupEntries[2].size = 16;
2143 WGPUBindGroupDescriptor groupDesc{};
2144 groupDesc.label = sv("eve_reflection_probe_filter_group");
2145 groupDesc.layout = reflectionProbeFilterSetLayout.Get();
2146 groupDesc.entryCount = 3;
2147 groupDesc.entries = groupEntries;
2148 wgpu::BindGroup group =
2149 device.CreateBindGroup(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor *>(&groupDesc));
2150
2151 wgpu::CommandEncoder encoder = device.CreateCommandEncoder();
2152 uint32_t passIndex = 0;
2153 for (uint32_t mip = 1; mip < target->mipLevels; ++mip) {
2154 const bool diffuse = mip + 1u == target->mipLevels;
2155 const float roughness = diffuse ? 1.f : float(mip) / float(target->mipLevels - 1u);
2156 for (uint32_t face = 0; face < 6; ++face, ++passIndex) {
2157 const float params[4] = {float(face), roughness, diffuse ? 1.f : 0.f,
2158 float(sampleCount)};
2159 queue.WriteBuffer(paramsBuffer, uint64_t(passIndex) * 256u, params, sizeof(params));
2160 WGPUTextureViewDescriptor viewDesc{};
2161 viewDesc.format = WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float;
2162 viewDesc.dimension = WGPUTextureViewDimension_2D;
2163 viewDesc.baseMipLevel = mip;
2164 viewDesc.mipLevelCount = 1;
2165 viewDesc.baseArrayLayer = face;
2166 viewDesc.arrayLayerCount = 1;
2167 wgpu::TextureView faceView = target->texture.CreateView(
2168 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor *>(&viewDesc));
2169 WGPURenderPassColorAttachment attachment{};
2170 attachment.view = faceView.Get();
2171 attachment.loadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
2172 attachment.storeOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
2173 WGPURenderPassDescriptor passDesc{};
2174 passDesc.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
2175 passDesc.colorAttachments = &attachment;
2176 WGPUPassTimestampWrites timestampWrites{};
2177 if (timestampSlot) {
2178 timestampWrites.querySet = offscreenTimestampQuerySet.Get();
2179 timestampWrites.beginningOfPassWriteIndex = passIndex == 0 ? 0 : UINT32_MAX;
2180 timestampWrites.endOfPassWriteIndex =
2181 passIndex + 1u == passCount ? 1 : UINT32_MAX;
2182 passDesc.timestampWrites = &timestampWrites;
2183 }
2184 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass = encoder.BeginRenderPass(
2185 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor *>(&passDesc));
2186 pass.SetPipeline(reflectionProbeFilterPipeline);
2187 const uint32_t offset = passIndex * 256u;
2188 pass.SetBindGroup(0, group, 1, &offset);
2189 pass.Draw(3);
2190 pass.End();
2191 }
2192 }
2193 if (timestampSlot) {
2194 encoder.ResolveQuerySet(offscreenTimestampQuerySet, 0, 2,
2195 offscreenTimestampResolveBuffer, 0);
2196 encoder.CopyBufferToBuffer(offscreenTimestampResolveBuffer, 0, timestampSlot->buffer, 0,
2197 sizeof(uint64_t) * 2);
2198 }
2199 wgpu::CommandBuffer command = encoder.Finish();
2200 queue.Submit(1, &command);
2201 if (timestampSlot) {
2202 timestampSlot->pending = true;
2203 WGPUBufferMapCallbackInfo callback{};
2204 callback.mode = WGPUCallbackMode_AllowProcessEvents;
2205 callback.callback = [](WGPUMapAsyncStatus status, WGPUStringView,
2206 void *userdata1, void *) {
2207 auto *slot = static_cast<OffscreenTimestampReadback *>(userdata1);
2208 if (status == WGPUMapAsyncStatus_Success && slot && slot->owner) {
2209 const auto *ticks = static_cast<const uint64_t *>(
2210 slot->buffer.GetConstMappedRange(0, sizeof(uint64_t) * 2));
2211 if (ticks && ticks[1] >= ticks[0]) {
2212 slot->owner->completedOffscreenTimestampMs.fetch_add(
2213 float(ticks[1] - ticks[0]) * 1.0e-6f);
2214 }
2215 slot->buffer.Unmap();
2216 }
2217 if (slot) slot->pending = false;
2218 };
2219 callback.userdata1 = timestampSlot;
2220 wgpuBufferMapAsync(timestampSlot->buffer.Get(), WGPUMapMode_Read, 0,
2221 sizeof(uint64_t) * 2, callback);
2222 }
2223 return true;
2224}

2236
2237Texture *Graphics::newTextureFromFile(const std::string &filename) {
2238 if (filename.empty()) throw Exception("newTextureFromFile: empty filename");
2239 if (!fileTextureSourceExists(filename))
2240 throw Exception("Could not load image file: %s", filename.c_str());
2241
2242 auto it = texturesByPath.find(filename);
2243 if (it != texturesByPath.end() && it->second) {
2244 requestFileImageDecode(filename);
2245 if (it->second->hasDeferredFilePixels()) return it->second;
2246 auto waited = eve::ResourceManager::getInstance().waitFor(filename);
2247 if (!waited.ok()) throw Exception("%s", waited.status().describe().c_str());
2248 auto *data = dynamic_cast<image::ImageData *>(&waited.value().get());
2249 if (!data ||
2250 !updateTexture(it->second, data->getWidth(), data->getHeight(),
2251 static_cast<const uint8_t *>(data->getData())))
2252 throw Exception("newTextureFromFile: reload failed '%s'", filename.c_str());
2253 return it->second;
2254 }
2255
2256 requestFileImageDecode(filename);
2257 auto tex = std::make_unique<Texture>();
2258 tex->markDeferredFilePixels(this);
2259 Texture *raw = tex.get();
2260 ownedTextures.push_back(std::move(tex));
2261 texturesByPath[filename] = raw;
2262 deferredFileTextures_.push_back({filename, raw});
2263 return raw;
2264}
2265
2266bool Graphics::uploadDeferredFileTexture(Texture *texture, image::ImageData *data) {
2267 if (!texture || !data) return false;
2268 if (texture->gpuHandle)
2269 return updateTexture(texture, data->getWidth(), data->getHeight(),
2270 static_cast<const uint8_t *>(data->getData()));
2271 Texture *fresh = newTexture(data);
2272 if (!fresh || !fresh->gpuHandle) return false;
2273 texture->gpuHandle = fresh->gpuHandle;
2274 texture->width = fresh->width;
2275 texture->height = fresh->height;
2276 texture->pixelWidth = fresh->pixelWidth;
2277 texture->pixelHeight = fresh->pixelHeight;
2278 texture->mipmapCount = fresh->mipmapCount;
2279 texture->sampler = fresh->sampler;
2280 fresh->gpuHandle = nullptr;
2281 auto texIt = std::find_if(ownedTextures.begin(), ownedTextures.end(),
2282 [&](const std::unique_ptr<Texture> &t) { return t.get() == fresh; });
2283 if (texIt == ownedTextures.end()) return false;
2284 (void)texIt->release();
2285 ownedTextures.erase(texIt);
2286 delete fresh;
2287 return true;
2288}
2289
2290bool Graphics::reloadTextureFromFile(const std::string &filename) {
2291 auto it = texturesByPath.find(filename);
2292 if (it == texturesByPath.end()) return false;
2293
2294 ensureFileTexturesReady();
2295
2296 image::ImageData *data = nullptr;
2297 try {
2298 auto *imgMod = image::Image::create();
2299 eve::ref<image::ImageData> cached(imgMod->newImageDataFromFile(filename));
2300 data = cached.get();
2301 } catch (...) {
2302 return false;
2303 }
2304 if (!data) return false;
2305
2306 Texture *tex = it->second;
2307 return updateTexture(tex, data->getWidth(), data->getHeight(),
2308 static_cast<const uint8_t *>(data->getData()));
2309}
2310
2311bool Graphics::releaseTexture(Texture *texture) {
2312 if (!texture) return false;
2313 dropDeferredFileTexture(texture);
2314 if (!texture->gpuHandle) {
2315 auto texIt = std::find_if(ownedTextures.begin(), ownedTextures.end(),
2316 [&](const std::unique_ptr<Texture> &t) {
2317 return t.get() == texture;
2318 });
2319 if (texIt == ownedTextures.end()) return false;
2320 for (auto it = texturesByPath.begin(); it != texturesByPath.end();) {
2321 if (it->second == texture)
2322 it = texturesByPath.erase(it);
2323 else
2324 ++it;
2325 }
2326 (void)texIt->release();
2327 ownedTextures.erase(texIt);
2328 return true;
2329 }
2330 // Renderer-owned fallback textures must never be released by callers.
2331 if (texture->gpuHandle == whiteTexture || texture->gpuHandle == flatNormalTexture ||
2332 texture->gpuHandle == flatNormalTexture3D ||
2333 texture->gpuHandle == defaultEnvCubemap)
2334 return false;
2335
2336 auto *gpu = static_cast<GpuTexture *>(texture->gpuHandle);
2337 auto gpuIt = std::find_if(ownedGpuTextures.begin(), ownedGpuTextures.end(),
2338 [&](const std::unique_ptr<GpuTexture> &g) {
2339 return g.get() == gpu;
2340 });
2341 if (gpuIt == ownedGpuTextures.end()) return false;
2342
2343 auto texIt = std::find_if(ownedTextures.begin(), ownedTextures.end(),
2344 [&](const std::unique_ptr<Texture> &t) {
2345 return t.get() == texture;
2346 });
2347 if (texIt == ownedTextures.end()) return false;
2348
2349 // Path-cached textures must leave the hot-reload cache once released.
2350 for (auto it = texturesByPath.begin(); it != texturesByPath.end();) {
2351 if (it->second == texture)
2352 it = texturesByPath.erase(it);
2353 else
2354 ++it;
2355 }
2356
2357 texture->gpuHandle = nullptr;
2358 ownedGpuTextures.erase(gpuIt);
2359 // Transfer the CPU facade to the caller instead of destroying it.
2360 (void)texIt->release();
2361 ownedTextures.erase(texIt);
2362 return true;
2363}
2364
2365bool Graphics::updateTexture(Texture *texture, int width, int height,
2366 const uint8_t *rgba) {
2367 if (!texture || !rgba || width <= 0 || height <= 0) return false;
2368 auto *gpu = gpuForTexture(texture);
2369 if (!gpu || width != texture->width || height != texture->height) return false;
2370 const auto owned = std::find_if(ownedGpuTextures.begin(), ownedGpuTextures.end(),
2371 [gpu](const std::unique_ptr<GpuTexture> &candidate) {
2372 return candidate.get() == gpu;
2373 });
2374 if (owned == ownedGpuTextures.end() || gpu->isCube) return false;
2375 uploadTexturePixelsMips(gpu, rgba, width, height);
2376 return true;
2377}
2378
2379eve::Result<void> Graphics::updateTextureRegion(Texture *texture, int x, int y, int width,
2380 int height,
2381 std::span<const std::uint8_t> rgba,
2382 std::size_t bytesPerRow) {
2383 const TextureRegionUpload upload{x, y, width, height, rgba, bytesPerRow};
2384 return updateTextureRegions(texture, std::span<const TextureRegionUpload>(&upload, 1));
2385}
2386
2387eve::Result<void> Graphics::updateTextureRegions(
2388 Texture *texture, std::span<const TextureRegionUpload> regions) {
2389 auto *gpu = gpuForTexture(texture);
2390 if (!texture || !gpu || gpu->isCube)
2391 return eve::Result<void>::failure(eve::Diagnostic::error(
2392 eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "texture is not an owned 2D texture",
2393 "graphics.updateTextureRegions.texture"));
2394 if (texture->mipmapCount != 1)
2395 return eve::Result<void>::failure(eve::Diagnostic::error(
2396 eve::DiagnosticCode::Unsupported, "partial updates require a single-mip texture",
2397 "graphics.updateTextureRegions.mipmaps"));
2398
2399 for (const TextureRegionUpload &region : regions) {
2400 if (region.x < 0 || region.y < 0 || region.width <= 0 || region.height <= 0 ||
2401 region.x > texture->width - region.width ||
2402 region.y > texture->height - region.height)
2403 return eve::Result<void>::failure(eve::Diagnostic::error(
2404 eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "invalid texture region",
2405 "graphics.updateTextureRegions.region"));
2406 const std::size_t packedRow = std::size_t(region.width) * 4U;
2407 const std::size_t stride = region.bytesPerRow == 0 ? packedRow : region.bytesPerRow;
2408 const std::size_t requiredBytes = stride * std::size_t(region.height - 1) + packedRow;
2409 if (stride < packedRow || region.rgba.size() < requiredBytes)
2410 return eve::Result<void>::failure(eve::Diagnostic::error(
2411 eve::DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2412 "source bytes do not cover the texture region",
2413 "graphics.updateTextureRegions.bytes"));
2414 }
2415
2416 for (const TextureRegionUpload &region : regions) {
2417 const std::size_t packedRow = std::size_t(region.width) * 4U;
2418 const std::size_t stride = region.bytesPerRow == 0 ? packedRow : region.bytesPerRow;
2419 const std::size_t requiredBytes = stride * std::size_t(region.height - 1) + packedRow;
2420 WGPUTexelCopyTextureInfo dst{};
2421 dst.texture = gpu->texture.Get();
2422 dst.mipLevel = 0;
2423 dst.origin = {std::uint32_t(region.x), std::uint32_t(region.y), 0};
2424 dst.aspect = WGPUTextureAspect_All;
2425 WGPUTexelCopyBufferLayout layout{};
2426 layout.offset = 0;
2427 layout.bytesPerRow = std::uint32_t(stride);
2428 layout.rowsPerImage = std::uint32_t(region.height);
2429 WGPUExtent3D extent{std::uint32_t(region.width), std::uint32_t(region.height), 1};
2430 queue.WriteTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo *>(&dst),
2431 region.rgba.data(), requiredBytes,
2432 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout *>(&layout),
2433 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::Extent3D *>(&extent));
2434 }
2435 return eve::Result<void>::success();
2436}

2447wgpu::BindGroup Graphics::makeTex2DBindGroup(GpuTexture *color, GpuTexture *depth,
2448 GpuTexture *motion, GpuTexture *extra,
2449 GpuTexture *specular) {
2450 GpuTexture *c = color ? color : whiteTexture;
2451 GpuTexture *d = depth ? depth : c;
2452 GpuTexture *m = motion ? motion : c;
2453 GpuTexture *e = extra ? extra : c;
2454 GpuTexture *s = specular ? specular : c;
2455 WGPUBindGroupEntry entries[11]{};
2456 entries[0].binding = 0;
2457 entries[0].textureView = c->view.Get();
2458 entries[1].binding = 1;
2459 entries[1].textureView = d->view.Get();
2460 entries[2].binding = 2;
2461 entries[2].sampler = c->sampler.Get();
2462 entries[3].binding = 3;
2463 entries[3].sampler = d->sampler.Get();
2464 entries[4].binding = 4;
2465 entries[4].buffer = currentUboArena().buffer.Get(); // replaced per-draw via dynamic offset
2466 entries[4].size =
2467 std::max<uint32_t>(Shader::kPushConstantBytes, uint32_t(sizeof(Lighting2DUBO)));
2468 entries[5].binding = 5;
2469 entries[5].textureView = m->view.Get();
2470 entries[6].binding = 6;
2471 entries[6].sampler = m->sampler.Get();
2472 entries[7].binding = 7;
2473 entries[7].textureView = e->view.Get();
2474 entries[8].binding = 8;
2475 entries[8].sampler = e->sampler.Get();
2476 entries[9].binding = 9;
2477 entries[9].textureView = s->view.Get();
2478 entries[10].binding = 10;
2479 entries[10].sampler = s->sampler.Get();
2480 WGPUBindGroupDescriptor desc{};
2481 desc.label = sv("eve_tex2d_group");
2482 desc.layout = tex2DSetLayout.Get();
2483 desc.entryCount = 11;
2484 desc.entries = entries;
2485 return device.CreateBindGroup(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor*>(&desc));
2486}
2487
2488wgpu::BindGroup Graphics::makeMeshBindGroup(GpuTexture *albedo, GpuTexture *normal, GpuTexture *env,
2489 GpuTexture *height, GpuTexture *depth, GpuTexture *sceneColor,
2490 uint32_t frameUboOffset, uint32_t shadowUboOffset,
2491 uint32_t pushUboOffset) {
2492 GpuTexture *a = albedo ? albedo : whiteTexture;
2493 GpuTexture *n = normal ? normal : flatNormalTexture;
2494 GpuTexture *e = env ? env : defaultEnvCubemap;
2495 auto localProbe = [&](int index) -> GpuTexture * {
2496 if (index < mesh3dReflectionProbes.count) {
2497 GpuTexture *gpu = gpuForTexture(mesh3dReflectionProbes.probes[index].cubemap);
2498 if (gpu && gpu->isCube) return gpu;
2499 }
2500 return defaultEnvCubemap;
2501 };
2502 GpuTexture *probe0 = localProbe(0);
2503 GpuTexture *probe1 = localProbe(1);
2504 GpuTexture *h = height ? height : flatHeightTexture3D;
2505 GpuTexture *d = depth ? depth : flatDepthTexture3D;
2506 GpuTexture *c = sceneColor ? sceneColor : whiteTexture;
2507 GpuTexture *shadow = shadowDepthArray ? shadowDepthArray : defaultShadowTex;
2508 wgpu::TextureView aoView_ =
2509 aoReady ? aoView[(aoWriteIndex + 1) % 2] : (whiteTexture ? whiteTexture->view : wgpu::TextureView());
2510 wgpu::TextureView decalAlbedoView = gpuForTextureOrWhite(decalFlatAlbedo)->view;
2511 wgpu::TextureView decalNormalView = gpuForTextureOrWhite(decalFlatNormal)->view;
2512 wgpu::TextureView decalParamsView = gpuForTextureOrWhite(decalFlatParams)->view;
2513 if (decalReady && lastDecalSlot < decalSlots.size()) {
2514 decalAlbedoView = decalSlots[lastDecalSlot].albedoView;
2515 decalNormalView = decalSlots[lastDecalSlot].normalView;
2516 decalParamsView = decalSlots[lastDecalSlot].paramsView;
2517 }
2518
2519 MeshBindGroupKey key{reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(currentUboArena().buffer.Get()),
2520 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(a->view.Get()),
2521 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(n->view.Get()),
2522 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(e->view.Get()),
2523 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(h->view.Get()),
2524 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(d->view.Get()),
2525 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(shadow->view.Get()),
2526 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(shadow->sampler.Get()),
2527 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(aoView_.Get()),
2528 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(decalAlbedoView.Get()),
2529 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(decalNormalView.Get()),
2530 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(decalParamsView.Get()),
2531 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(probe0->view.Get()),
2532 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(probe1->view.Get()),
2533 reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(c->view.Get())};
2534 auto cached = meshBindGroupCache_.find(key);
2535 if (cached != meshBindGroupCache_.end()) return cached->second;
2536 if (meshBindGroupCache_.size() >= kMaxMeshBindGroupCache) meshBindGroupCache_.clear();
2537
2538 WGPUBindGroupEntry entries[20]{};
2539 entries[0].binding = 0;
2540 entries[0].buffer = currentUboArena().buffer.Get();
2541 entries[0].size = sizeof(Mesh3DUBO);
2542 entries[1].binding = 1;
2543 entries[1].textureView = a->view.Get();
2544 entries[2].binding = 2;
2545 entries[2].textureView = n->view.Get();
2546 entries[3].binding = 3;
2547 entries[3].textureView = e->view.Get();
2548 entries[4].binding = 4;
2549 entries[4].buffer = currentUboArena().buffer.Get();
2550 entries[4].size = sizeof(ShadowUBO);
2551 entries[5].binding = 5;
2552 entries[5].textureView = shadow->view.Get();
2553 entries[6].binding = 6;
2554 entries[6].textureView = h->view.Get();
2555 entries[7].binding = 7;
2556 // The mesh shader currently has one material sampler binding. Follow the
2557 // albedo texture's public sampler state instead of silently substituting
2558 // the backend-global linear sampler (Vulkan also samples albedo with the
2559 // sampler owned by that texture).
2560 entries[7].sampler = a->sampler.Get();
2561 entries[8].binding = 8;
2562 entries[8].sampler = shadow->sampler.Get();
2563 entries[9].binding = 9;
2564 entries[9].textureView = d->view.Get();
2565 entries[10].binding = 10;
2566 entries[10].textureView = aoView_.Get();
2567 entries[11].binding = 11;
2568 entries[11].sampler = mainSampler.Get();
2569 entries[12].binding = 12;
2570 entries[12].textureView = decalAlbedoView.Get();
2571 entries[13].binding = 13;
2572 entries[13].textureView = decalNormalView.Get();
2573 entries[14].binding = 14;
2574 entries[14].textureView = decalParamsView.Get();
2575 entries[15].binding = 15;
2576 entries[15].buffer = currentUboArena().buffer.Get();
2577 entries[15].size = Shader::kPushConstantBytes;
2578 entries[16].binding = 16;
2579 entries[16].textureView = probe0->view.Get();
2580 entries[17].binding = 17;
2581 entries[17].textureView = probe1->view.Get();
2582 entries[18].binding = 18;
2583 entries[18].textureView = c->view.Get();
2584 entries[19].binding = 19;
2585 entries[19].sampler = c->sampler.Get();
2586
2587 (void)frameUboOffset;
2588 (void)shadowUboOffset;
2589 (void)pushUboOffset;
2590 WGPUBindGroupDescriptor desc{};
2591 desc.label = sv("eve_mesh_group");
2592 desc.layout = mesh3dSetLayout.Get();
2593 desc.entryCount = 20;
2594 desc.entries = entries;
2595 wgpu::BindGroup bg =
2596 device.CreateBindGroup(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor*>(&desc));
2597 meshBindGroupCache_.emplace(key, bg);
2598 return bg;
2599}

2601wgpu::BindGroup Graphics::makeMesh3DClusteredBindGroup(GpuTexture *albedo, GpuTexture *normal,
2602 GpuTexture *env, GpuTexture *height,
2603 GpuTexture *depth, wgpu::TextureView aoView,
2604 uint32_t frameUboOffset,
2605 uint32_t shadowUboOffset) {
2606 GpuTexture *a = albedo ? albedo : whiteTexture;
2607 GpuTexture *n = normal ? normal : flatNormalTexture3D;
2608 GpuTexture *e = env ? env : defaultEnvCubemap;
2609 auto localProbe = [&](int index) -> GpuTexture * {
2610 if (index < mesh3dReflectionProbes.count) {
2611 GpuTexture *gpu = gpuForTexture(mesh3dReflectionProbes.probes[index].cubemap);
2612 if (gpu && gpu->isCube) return gpu;
2613 }
2614 return defaultEnvCubemap;
2615 };
2616 GpuTexture *probe0 = localProbe(0);
2617 GpuTexture *probe1 = localProbe(1);
2618 GpuTexture *h = height ? height : flatHeightTexture3D;
2619 GpuTexture *d = depth ? depth : flatDepthTexture3D;
2620 GpuTexture *shadow = shadowDepthArray ? shadowDepthArray : defaultShadowTex;
2621 ClusteredStorage &st = clusteredStorage[currentFrameSlot()];
2622 wgpu::TextureView decalAlbedoView = gpuForTextureOrWhite(decalFlatAlbedo)->view;
2623 wgpu::TextureView decalNormalView = gpuForTextureOrWhite(decalFlatNormal)->view;
2624 wgpu::TextureView decalParamsView = gpuForTextureOrWhite(decalFlatParams)->view;
2625 if (decalReady && lastDecalSlot < decalSlots.size()) {
2626 decalAlbedoView = decalSlots[lastDecalSlot].albedoView;
2627 decalNormalView = decalSlots[lastDecalSlot].normalView;
2628 decalParamsView = decalSlots[lastDecalSlot].paramsView;
2629 }
2630
2631 WGPUBindGroupEntry entries[20]{};
2632 entries[0].binding = 0;
2633 entries[0].buffer = currentUboArena().buffer.Get();
2634 entries[0].size = sizeof(Mesh3DClusteredUBO);
2635 entries[1].binding = 1;
2636 entries[1].textureView = a->view.Get();
2637 entries[2].binding = 2;
2638 entries[2].textureView = n->view.Get();
2639 entries[3].binding = 3;
2640 entries[3].textureView = e->view.Get();
2641 entries[4].binding = 4;
2642 entries[4].buffer = currentUboArena().buffer.Get();
2643 entries[4].size = sizeof(ShadowUBO);
2644 entries[5].binding = 5;
2645 entries[5].textureView = shadow->view.Get();
2646 entries[6].binding = 6;
2647 entries[6].textureView = h->view.Get();
2648 entries[7].binding = 7;
2649 entries[7].sampler = a->sampler.Get();
2650 entries[8].binding = 8;
2651 entries[8].sampler = shadow->sampler.Get();
2652 entries[9].binding = 9;
2653 entries[9].textureView = d->view.Get();
2654 entries[10].binding = 10;
2655 entries[10].buffer = st.lights.Get();
2656 entries[10].size = st.lightsCap;
2657 entries[11].binding = 11;
2658 entries[11].buffer = st.table.Get();
2659 entries[11].size = st.tableCap;
2660 entries[12].binding = 12;
2661 entries[12].buffer = st.indices.Get();
2662 entries[12].size = st.indicesCap;
2663 entries[13].binding = 13;
2664 entries[13].textureView = aoView.Get();
2665 entries[14].binding = 14;
2666 entries[14].sampler = mainSampler.Get();
2667 entries[15].binding = 15;
2668 entries[15].textureView = decalAlbedoView.Get();
2669 entries[16].binding = 16;
2670 entries[16].textureView = decalNormalView.Get();
2671 entries[17].binding = 17;
2672 entries[17].textureView = decalParamsView.Get();
2673 entries[18].binding = 18;
2674 entries[18].textureView = probe0->view.Get();
2675 entries[19].binding = 19;
2676 entries[19].textureView = probe1->view.Get();
2677
2678 (void)frameUboOffset;
2679 (void)shadowUboOffset;
2680 WGPUBindGroupDescriptor desc{};
2681 desc.label = sv("eve_mesh3d_clustered_group");
2682 desc.layout = mesh3dClusteredSetLayout.Get();
2683 desc.entryCount = 20;
2684 desc.entries = entries;
2685 return device.CreateBindGroup(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor*>(&desc));
2686}

2688// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2689// Mesh creation
2690// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2691
2692Mesh *Graphics::newMeshFromArrays(const float *posXYZ, const float *nrmXYZ, const float *uvST,
2693 int vertexCount, const uint32_t *indices, int indexCount) {
2694 if (vertexCount <= 0 || !posXYZ) throw Exception("newMeshFromArrays: invalid vertex data");
2695 if (indexCount < 0 || (indexCount > 0 && (!indices || indexCount % 3 != 0)))
2696 throw Exception("newMeshFromArrays: invalid index data");
2697 for (int i = 0; i < indexCount; ++i) {
2698 if (indices[i] >= uint32_t(vertexCount))
2699 throw Exception("newMeshFromArrays: index out of range");
2700 }
2701
2702 std::vector<MeshVertex> verts(static_cast<size_t>(vertexCount));
2703 for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; ++i) {
2704 auto &v = verts[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
2705 v.pos = {posXYZ[i * 3 + 0], posXYZ[i * 3 + 1], posXYZ[i * 3 + 2]};
2706 if (nrmXYZ) {
2707 v.normal = {nrmXYZ[i * 3 + 0], nrmXYZ[i * 3 + 1], nrmXYZ[i * 3 + 2]};
2708 } else {
2709 v.normal = {0.f, 0.f, 1.f};
2710 }
2711 if (uvST) {
2712 v.uv = {uvST[i * 2 + 0], uvST[i * 2 + 1]};
2713 } else {
2714 v.uv = {0.f, 0.f};
2715 }
2716 }
2717
2718 auto gpu = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>();
2719 gpu->vertexCount = uint32_t(vertexCount);
2720 gpu->indexCount = indexCount > 0 ? uint32_t(indexCount) : 0;
2721 gpu->vertexStride = sizeof(MeshVertex);
2722 gpu->cpuVertices = verts;
2723
2724 WGPUBufferDescriptor vbd{};
2725 vbd.label = sv("eve_mesh_vb");
2726 vbd.size = verts.size() * sizeof(MeshVertex);
2727 vbd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Vertex | WGPUBufferUsage_Storage;
2728 vbd.mappedAtCreation = false;
2729 gpu->vertexBuffer = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&vbd));
2730 queue.WriteBuffer(gpu->vertexBuffer, 0, verts.data(), vbd.size);
2731 gpu->vertexCapacity = vbd.size;
2732
2733 if (indexCount > 0) {
2734 // 16-bit index format halves index memory for meshes with <= 65535 verts.
2735 if (vertexCount <= 65535) {
2736 std::vector<uint16_t> idx16;
2737 idx16.reserve(indexCount);
2738 for (int i = 0; i < indexCount; ++i) idx16.push_back(uint16_t(indices[i]));
2739 WGPUBufferDescriptor ibd{};
2740 ibd.label = sv("eve_mesh_ib");
2741 if (idx16.size() % 2 != 0) idx16.push_back(0); // WriteBuffer size must align to 4.
2742 ibd.size = uint64_t(idx16.size()) * sizeof(uint16_t);
2743 ibd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Index | WGPUBufferUsage_Storage;
2744 ibd.mappedAtCreation = false;
2745 gpu->indexBuffer =
2746 device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&ibd));
2747 queue.WriteBuffer(gpu->indexBuffer, 0, idx16.data(), ibd.size);
2748 gpu->indexFormat = wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint16;
2749 gpu->indexCapacity = ibd.size;
2750 } else {
2751 WGPUBufferDescriptor ibd{};
2752 ibd.label = sv("eve_mesh_ib");
2753 ibd.size = uint64_t(indexCount) * sizeof(uint32_t);
2754 ibd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Index | WGPUBufferUsage_Storage;
2755 ibd.mappedAtCreation = false;
2756 gpu->indexBuffer = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&ibd));
2757 queue.WriteBuffer(gpu->indexBuffer, 0, indices, ibd.size);
2758 gpu->indexFormat = wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32;
2759 gpu->indexCapacity = ibd.size;
2760 }
2761 }
2762
2763 auto *mesh = new Mesh();
2764 mesh->indexCount = indexCount;
2765 mesh->gpuVertexCount = vertexCount;
2766 mesh->gpuHandle = gpu.get();
2767 mesh->computeBounds(posXYZ, vertexCount);
2768 ownedGpuMeshes.push_back(std::move(gpu));
2769 ownedMeshes.push_back(std::unique_ptr<Mesh>(mesh));
2770 return mesh;
2771}
2772
2773std::optional<eve::graphics::MeshBackendDescriptor> Graphics::describeMesh(Mesh *mesh) const {
2774 if (!mesh || !mesh->gpuHandle) return std::nullopt;
2775 const auto *gpu = static_cast<const GpuMesh *>(mesh->gpuHandle);
2776 const auto owned =
2777 std::find_if(ownedGpuMeshes.begin(), ownedGpuMeshes.end(),
2778 [gpu](const std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> &candidate) { return candidate.get() == gpu; });
2779 if (owned == ownedGpuMeshes.end()) return std::nullopt;
2780 return eve::graphics::MeshBackendDescriptor{gpu->vertexCount, gpu->indexCount, gpu->vertexStride,
2781 gpu->indexFormat == wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint16 ? 2u : 4u};
2782}
2783
2784Mesh *Graphics::newMeshFromAssimp(const ::aiMesh &mesh) {
2785 aiMatrix4x4 ident;
2786 return newMeshFromAssimp(mesh, ident);
2787}
2788
2789Mesh *Graphics::newMeshFromAssimp(const ::aiMesh &mesh, const aiMatrix4x4 &worldTransform) {
2790 std::vector<float> pos, nrm, uv;
2791 std::vector<uint32_t> idx;
2792 pos.reserve(mesh.mNumVertices * 3);
2793 nrm.reserve(mesh.mNumVertices * 3);
2794 uv.reserve(mesh.mNumVertices * 2);
2795 idx.reserve(mesh.mNumFaces * 3);
2796
2797 for (unsigned i = 0; i < mesh.mNumVertices; ++i) {
2798 aiVector3D p = worldTransform * mesh.mVertices[i];
2799 pos.push_back(p.x);
2800 pos.push_back(p.y);
2801 pos.push_back(p.z);
2802 if (mesh.mNormals) {
2803 aiMatrix3x3 rot(worldTransform);
2804 aiVector3D n = rot * mesh.mNormals[i];
2805 n.Normalize();
2806 nrm.push_back(n.x);
2807 nrm.push_back(n.y);
2808 nrm.push_back(n.z);
2809 } else {
2810 nrm.push_back(0.f);
2811 nrm.push_back(0.f);
2812 nrm.push_back(1.f);
2813 }
2814 if (mesh.mTextureCoords[0]) {
2815 uv.push_back(mesh.mTextureCoords[0][i].x);
2816 uv.push_back(mesh.mTextureCoords[0][i].y);
2817 } else {
2818 uv.push_back(0.f);
2819 uv.push_back(0.f);
2820 }
2821 }
2822 for (unsigned f = 0; f < mesh.mNumFaces; ++f) {
2823 for (unsigned v = 0; v < mesh.mFaces[f].mNumIndices; ++v)
2824 idx.push_back(mesh.mFaces[f].mIndices[v]);
2825 }
2826 Mesh *m = newMeshFromArrays(pos.data(), nrm.data(), uv.data(), int(mesh.mNumVertices), idx.data(),
2827 int(idx.size()));
2828 if (m) m->captureImportedAttributes(mesh);
2829 if (m && mesh.mNumAnimMeshes > 0) {
2830 m->initMorphBase(int(mesh.mNumVertices), pos.data(), nrm.data(), uv.data());
2831 for (unsigned a = 0; a < mesh.mNumAnimMeshes; ++a) {
2832 const aiAnimMesh *am = mesh.mAnimMeshes[a];
2833 std::vector<float> absPos(am->mNumVertices * 3);
2834 for (unsigned i = 0; i < am->mNumVertices; ++i) {
2835 absPos[i * 3 + 0] = am->mVertices[i].x;
2836 absPos[i * 3 + 1] = am->mVertices[i].y;
2837 absPos[i * 3 + 2] = am->mVertices[i].z;
2838 }
2839 std::string name = am->mName.C_Str();
2840 if (name.empty()) name = "morph" + std::to_string(a);
2841 m->addMorphTargetAbsolute(name, absPos.data());
2842 }
2843 }
2844 return m;
2845}
2846
2847bool Graphics::bakeMeshMorph(Mesh *mesh) {
2848 if (!mesh || !mesh->hasMorphData() || !mesh->isMorphDirty()) return false;
2849 auto *gpu = static_cast<GpuMesh *>(mesh->gpuHandle);
2850 if (!gpu || !gpu->vertexBuffer) return false;
2851 std::vector<float> pos, nrm;
2852 mesh->computeMorphedPositions(pos, nrm);
2853 if (pos.empty()) return false;
2854 mesh->computeBounds(pos.data(), mesh->getVertexCount());
2855 auto &verts = gpu->cpuVertices;
2856 if (verts.size() != static_cast<size_t>(mesh->getVertexCount())) return false;
2857 const auto &uvs = mesh->baseUv();
2858 for (int i = 0; i < mesh->getVertexCount(); ++i) {
2859 auto &v = verts[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
2860 v.pos = {pos[i * 3 + 0], pos[i * 3 + 1], pos[i * 3 + 2]};
2861 if (nrm.size() >= size_t((i + 1) * 3)) {
2862 v.normal = {nrm[i * 3 + 0], nrm[i * 3 + 1], nrm[i * 3 + 2]};
2863 } else {
2864 v.normal = {0.f, 0.f, 1.f};
2865 }
2866 if (uvs.size() >= size_t((i + 1) * 2)) {
2867 v.uv = {uvs[i * 2 + 0], uvs[i * 2 + 1]};
2868 } else {
2869 v.uv = {0.f, 0.f};
2870 }
2871 }
2872 queue.WriteBuffer(gpu->vertexBuffer, 0, verts.data(), verts.size() * sizeof(MeshVertex));
2873 mesh->markMorphClean();
2874 return true;
2875}
2876
2877bool Graphics::updateMeshVertices(Mesh *mesh, const float *posXYZ, const float *nrmXYZ,
2878 const float *uvST, int vertexCount, const uint32_t *indices,
2879 int indexCount) {
2880 if (!mesh || !mesh->gpuHandle || !posXYZ || vertexCount <= 0 || indexCount < 0) return false;
2881 if (indexCount > 0 && (!indices || indexCount % 3 != 0)) return false;
2882 for (int i = 0; i < indexCount; ++i) {
2883 if (indices[i] >= uint32_t(vertexCount)) return false;
2884 }
2885 auto *gpu = static_cast<GpuMesh *>(mesh->gpuHandle);
2886 const auto owned = std::find_if(ownedGpuMeshes.begin(), ownedGpuMeshes.end(),
2887 [gpu](const std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> &candidate) {
2888 return candidate.get() == gpu;
2889 });
2890 if (owned == ownedGpuMeshes.end()) return false;
2891
2892 std::vector<float> verts;
2893 verts.reserve(size_t(vertexCount) * 8u);
2894 for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; ++i) {
2895 verts.insert(verts.end(), posXYZ + size_t(i) * 3u, posXYZ + size_t(i) * 3u + 3u);
2896 if (nrmXYZ)
2897 verts.insert(verts.end(), nrmXYZ + size_t(i) * 3u, nrmXYZ + size_t(i) * 3u + 3u);
2898 else
2899 verts.insert(verts.end(), {0.f, 0.f, 1.f});
2900 if (uvST)
2901 verts.insert(verts.end(), uvST + size_t(i) * 2u, uvST + size_t(i) * 2u + 2u);
2902 else
2903 verts.insert(verts.end(), {0.f, 0.f});
2904 }
2905
2906 const uint64_t vertexBytes = verts.size() * sizeof(float);
2907 if (vertexBytes > gpu->vertexCapacity) {
2908 WGPUBufferDescriptor desc{};
2909 desc.label = sv("eve_mesh_dynamic_vb");
2910 desc.size = vertexBytes;
2911 desc.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Vertex | WGPUBufferUsage_Storage;
2912 gpu->vertexBuffer =
2913 device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&desc));
2914 gpu->vertexCapacity = vertexBytes;
2915 }
2916 queue.WriteBuffer(gpu->vertexBuffer, 0, verts.data(), vertexBytes);
2917 gpu->vertexCount = uint32_t(vertexCount);
2918
2919 if (indexCount > 0) {
2920 const wgpu::IndexFormat format =
2921 vertexCount <= 65535 ? wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint16 : wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32;
2922 std::vector<uint16_t> idx16;
2923 const void *indexData = indices;
2924 uint64_t indexBytes = uint64_t(indexCount) * sizeof(uint32_t);
2925 if (format == wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint16) {
2926 idx16.reserve(size_t(indexCount) + 1u);
2927 for (int i = 0; i < indexCount; ++i) idx16.push_back(uint16_t(indices[i]));
2928 if (idx16.size() % 2 != 0) idx16.push_back(0);
2929 indexData = idx16.data();
2930 indexBytes = idx16.size() * sizeof(uint16_t);
2931 }
2932 if (format != gpu->indexFormat || indexBytes > gpu->indexCapacity) {
2933 WGPUBufferDescriptor desc{};
2934 desc.label = sv("eve_mesh_dynamic_ib");
2935 desc.size = indexBytes;
2936 desc.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Index | WGPUBufferUsage_Storage;
2937 gpu->indexBuffer =
2938 device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&desc));
2939 gpu->indexCapacity = indexBytes;
2940 }
2941 queue.WriteBuffer(gpu->indexBuffer, 0, indexData, indexBytes);
2942 gpu->indexFormat = format;
2943 gpu->indexCount = uint32_t(indexCount);
2944 }
2945
2946 mesh->computeBounds(posXYZ, vertexCount);
2947 mesh->gpuVertexCount = int(gpu->vertexCount);
2948 mesh->indexCount = int(gpu->indexCount);
2949 return true;
2950}
2951
2952void fillMeshAttributes(WGPUVertexAttribute (&attrs)[5]) {
2953 attrs[0].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x3;
2954 attrs[0].offset = 0;
2955 attrs[0].shaderLocation = 0;
2956 attrs[1].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x3;
2957 attrs[1].offset = 12;
2958 attrs[1].shaderLocation = 1;
2959 attrs[2].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x2;
2960 attrs[2].offset = 24;
2961 attrs[2].shaderLocation = 2;
2962 attrs[3].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Uint16x4;
2963 attrs[3].offset = 32;
2964 attrs[3].shaderLocation = 3;
2965 attrs[4].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x4;
2966 attrs[4].offset = 40;
2967 attrs[4].shaderLocation = 4;
2968}
2969
2970bool Graphics::setMeshSkinningData(Mesh *mesh, const uint16_t *joints4, const float *weights4,
2971 int vertexCount) {
2972 if (!mesh || !mesh->gpuHandle || !joints4 || !weights4) return false;
2973 auto *gpu = static_cast<GpuMesh *>(mesh->gpuHandle);
2974 if (vertexCount <= 0 || gpu->cpuVertices.size() != static_cast<size_t>(vertexCount)) return false;
2975 for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; ++i) {
2976 const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(i) * 4u;
2977 auto &v = gpu->cpuVertices[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
2978 v.joints = glm::u16vec4(joints4[base], joints4[base + 1], joints4[base + 2], joints4[base + 3]);
2979 v.weights = glm::vec4(weights4[base], weights4[base + 1], weights4[base + 2], weights4[base + 3]);
2980 }
2981 queue.WriteBuffer(gpu->vertexBuffer, 0, gpu->cpuVertices.data(),
2982 gpu->cpuVertices.size() * sizeof(MeshVertex));
2983 mesh->markGpuSkinned(true);
2984 return true;
2985}
2986
2987bool Graphics::releaseMesh(Mesh *mesh) {
2988 if (!mesh || !mesh->gpuHandle) return false;
2989
2990 auto *gpu = static_cast<GpuMesh *>(mesh->gpuHandle);
2991 auto gpuIt = std::find_if(ownedGpuMeshes.begin(), ownedGpuMeshes.end(),
2992 [&](const std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> &g) {
2993 return g.get() == gpu;
2994 });
2995 if (gpuIt == ownedGpuMeshes.end()) return false;
2996
2997 auto meshIt = std::find_if(ownedMeshes.begin(), ownedMeshes.end(),
2998 [&](const std::unique_ptr<Mesh> &m) {
2999 return m.get() == mesh;
3000 });
3001 if (meshIt == ownedMeshes.end()) return false;
3002
3003 mesh->gpuHandle = nullptr;
3004 ownedGpuMeshes.erase(gpuIt);
3005 // Transfer the CPU facade to the caller instead of destroying it.
3006 (void)meshIt->release();
3007 ownedMeshes.erase(meshIt);
3008 return true;
3009}
3010
3011Mesh *Graphics::newMeshSphere(int slices, int stacks) {
3012 std::vector<float> pos, nrm, uv;
3013 std::vector<uint32_t> idx;
3014 for (int y = 0; y <= stacks; ++y) {
3015 for (int x = 0; x <= slices; ++x) {
3016 float u = float(x) / float(slices);
3017 float v = float(y) / float(stacks);
3018 float theta = u * 2.f * glm::pi<float>();
3019 float phi = v * glm::pi<float>();
3020 float sx = std::sin(phi) * std::cos(theta);
3021 float sy = std::cos(phi);
3022 float sz = std::sin(phi) * std::sin(theta);
3023 pos.push_back(sx);
3024 pos.push_back(sy);
3025 pos.push_back(sz);
3026 nrm.push_back(sx);
3027 nrm.push_back(sy);
3028 nrm.push_back(sz);
3029 uv.push_back(u);
3030 uv.push_back(v);
3031 }
3032 }
3033 for (int y = 0; y < stacks; ++y) {
3034 for (int x = 0; x < slices; ++x) {
3035 int a = y * (slices + 1) + x;
3036 int b = a + slices + 1;
3037 idx.push_back(a);
3038 idx.push_back(a + 1);
3039 idx.push_back(b);
3040 idx.push_back(b);
3041 idx.push_back(a + 1);
3042 idx.push_back(b + 1);
3043 }
3044 }
3045 return newMeshFromArrays(pos.data(), nrm.data(), uv.data(), int(pos.size() / 3), idx.data(),
3046 int(idx.size()));
3047}
3048
3049Mesh *Graphics::newMeshCylinder(int slices, int stacks, bool caps) {
3050 std::vector<float> pos, nrm, uv;
3051 std::vector<uint32_t> idx;
3052 for (int y = 0; y <= stacks; ++y) {
3053 for (int x = 0; x <= slices; ++x) {
3054 float u = float(x) / float(slices);
3055 float v = float(y) / float(stacks);
3056 float theta = u * 2.f * glm::pi<float>();
3057 pos.push_back(std::cos(theta));
3058 pos.push_back(v * 2.f - 1.f);
3059 pos.push_back(std::sin(theta));
3060 nrm.push_back(std::cos(theta));
3061 nrm.push_back(0.f);
3062 nrm.push_back(std::sin(theta));
3063 uv.push_back(u);
3064 uv.push_back(v);
3065 }
3066 }
3067 for (int y = 0; y < stacks; ++y) {
3068 for (int x = 0; x < slices; ++x) {
3069 int a = y * (slices + 1) + x;
3070 int b = a + slices + 1;
3071 idx.push_back(a);
3072 idx.push_back(b);
3073 idx.push_back(a + 1);
3074 idx.push_back(b);
3075 idx.push_back(b + 1);
3076 idx.push_back(a + 1);
3077 }
3078 }
3079 if (caps) {
3080 int base = int(pos.size() / 3);
3081 pos.push_back(0.f); pos.push_back(-1.f); pos.push_back(0.f);
3082 nrm.push_back(0.f); nrm.push_back(-1.f); nrm.push_back(0.f);
3083 uv.push_back(0.5f); uv.push_back(0.5f);
3084 for (int x = 0; x < slices; ++x) {
3085 float theta0 = float(x) / float(slices) * 2.f * glm::pi<float>();
3086 float theta1 = float(x + 1) / float(slices) * 2.f * glm::pi<float>();
3087 int i0 = int(pos.size() / 3);
3088 pos.push_back(std::cos(theta0)); pos.push_back(-1.f); pos.push_back(std::sin(theta0));
3089 nrm.push_back(0.f); nrm.push_back(-1.f); nrm.push_back(0.f);
3090 uv.push_back(0.5f + 0.5f * std::cos(theta0)); uv.push_back(0.5f + 0.5f * std::sin(theta0));
3091 int i1 = int(pos.size() / 3);
3092 pos.push_back(std::cos(theta1)); pos.push_back(-1.f); pos.push_back(std::sin(theta1));
3093 nrm.push_back(0.f); nrm.push_back(-1.f); nrm.push_back(0.f);
3094 uv.push_back(0.5f + 0.5f * std::cos(theta1)); uv.push_back(0.5f + 0.5f * std::sin(theta1));
3095 idx.push_back(base);
3096 idx.push_back(i0);
3097 idx.push_back(i1);
3098 }
3099 base = int(pos.size() / 3);
3100 pos.push_back(0.f); pos.push_back(1.f); pos.push_back(0.f);
3101 nrm.push_back(0.f); nrm.push_back(1.f); nrm.push_back(0.f);
3102 uv.push_back(0.5f); uv.push_back(0.5f);
3103 for (int x = 0; x < slices; ++x) {
3104 float theta0 = float(x) / float(slices) * 2.f * glm::pi<float>();
3105 float theta1 = float(x + 1) / float(slices) * 2.f * glm::pi<float>();
3106 int i0 = int(pos.size() / 3);
3107 pos.push_back(std::cos(theta0)); pos.push_back(1.f); pos.push_back(std::sin(theta0));
3108 nrm.push_back(0.f); nrm.push_back(1.f); nrm.push_back(0.f);
3109 uv.push_back(0.5f + 0.5f * std::cos(theta0)); uv.push_back(0.5f + 0.5f * std::sin(theta0));
3110 int i1 = int(pos.size() / 3);
3111 pos.push_back(std::cos(theta1)); pos.push_back(1.f); pos.push_back(std::sin(theta1));
3112 nrm.push_back(0.f); nrm.push_back(1.f); nrm.push_back(0.f);
3113 uv.push_back(0.5f + 0.5f * std::cos(theta1)); uv.push_back(0.5f + 0.5f * std::sin(theta1));
3114 idx.push_back(base);
3115 idx.push_back(i1);
3116 idx.push_back(i0);
3117 }
3118 }
3119 return newMeshFromArrays(pos.data(), nrm.data(), uv.data(), int(pos.size() / 3), idx.data(),
3120 int(idx.size()));
3121}

3127void Graphics::clear2DBatches() {

3134
3135void Graphics::noteSolidOverlay(uint32_t idx) {
3136 if (idx >= solidBatches.size()) return;
3137 const uint32_t n = uint32_t(solidBatches[idx].batch.vertices().size());
3138 if (!overlaySpans.empty() && overlaySpans.back().kind == OverlayKind::Solid &&
3139 overlaySpans.back().index == idx) {
3140 overlaySpans.back().vertCount = n - overlaySpans.back().vertBegin;
3141 return;
3142 }
3143 const uint32_t begin = n >= 6u ? n - 6u : 0u;
3144 overlaySpans.push_back({OverlayKind::Solid, idx, begin, n - begin});
3145}
3146
3147void Graphics::noteTexturedOverlay(Texture *tex, uint32_t idx) {
3148 if (tex && tex == getSceneColorTexture()) sceneColorComposited = true;
3149 if (!overlaySpans.empty() && overlaySpans.back().kind == OverlayKind::Textured &&
3150 overlaySpans.back().index == idx)
3151 return;
3152 overlaySpans.push_back({OverlayKind::Textured, idx, 0, 0});
3153}
3154
3155void Graphics::noteLitOverlay(uint32_t idx) {
3156 if (!overlaySpans.empty() && overlaySpans.back().kind == OverlayKind::Lit &&
3157 overlaySpans.back().index == idx)
3158 return;
3159 overlaySpans.push_back({OverlayKind::Lit, idx, 0, 0});
3160}
3161
3162void Graphics::drawSolidRect(float x, float y, float w, float h, const Color &color,
3163 BlendMode blend) {
3164 auto it = std::find_if(solidBatches.begin(), solidBatches.end(),
3165 [&](const SolidBatch &sb) { return sb.blend == blend; });
3166 if (it == solidBatches.end()) {
3167 solidBatches.push_back(SolidBatch{blend, Batcher{}});
3168 it = solidBatches.end() - 1;
3169 }
3170 it->batch.addRect(x, y, w, h, color);
3171 noteSolidOverlay(uint32_t(it - solidBatches.begin()));
3172}
3173
3174void Graphics::drawPrimitiveCanvas(const PrimitiveCanvas2D &canvas) {
3175 const int targetWidth = activeCanvas ? activeCanvas->getWidth() : getWidth();
3176 const int targetHeight = activeCanvas ? activeCanvas->getHeight() : getHeight();
3177 const auto triangles = resolvePrimitiveStrokes2D(canvas, {targetWidth, targetHeight});
3178 if (triangles.vertices.empty()) return;
3179 auto logicalPoint = [targetWidth, targetHeight](const PrimitiveTriangleVertex &vertex) {
3180 const glm::vec2 ndc = glm::vec2(vertex.clipPosition) / vertex.clipPosition.w;
3181 return glm::vec2((ndc.x + 1.f) * 0.5f * static_cast<float>(targetWidth),
3182 (ndc.y + 1.f) * 0.5f * static_cast<float>(targetHeight));
3183 };
3184 for (const ResolvedPrimitiveBatch2D &resolvedBatch : triangles.batches2D) {
3185 auto it = std::find_if(solidBatches.begin(), solidBatches.end(),
3186 [&](const SolidBatch &batch) { return batch.blend == resolvedBatch.blend; });
3187 if (it == solidBatches.end()) {
3188 solidBatches.push_back(SolidBatch{resolvedBatch.blend, Batcher{}});
3189 it = solidBatches.end() - 1;
3190 }
3191 for (std::size_t i = resolvedBatch.firstVertex; i < resolvedBatch.firstVertex + resolvedBatch.vertexCount;
3192 i += 3) {
3193 it->batch.addTriangle(logicalPoint(triangles.vertices[i]), logicalPoint(triangles.vertices[i + 1]),
3194 logicalPoint(triangles.vertices[i + 2]), triangles.vertices[i].color,
3195 triangles.vertices[i + 1].color, triangles.vertices[i + 2].color);
3196 }
3197 const auto batchIndex = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(it - solidBatches.begin());
3198 const std::uint32_t count = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(resolvedBatch.vertexCount);
3199 const std::uint32_t end = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(it->batch.vertices().size());
3200 overlaySpans.push_back({OverlayKind::Solid, batchIndex, end - count, count});
3201 }
3202}

3231void Graphics::drawTexturedRectShaderUV(Texture *texture, Shader *shader, float x, float y, float w,
3232 float h, float u0, float v0, float u1, float v1,
3233 const Color &color, bool rotatedUV, BlendMode blend) {
3234 if (!texture) {
3235 drawSolidRect(x, y, w, h, color, blend);
3236 return;
3237 }
3238 if (texturedBatches.empty() || texturedBatches.back().texture != texture ||
3239 texturedBatches.back().shader != shader || texturedBatches.back().depth != nullptr ||
3240 texturedBatches.back().blend != blend) {
3241 texturedBatches.push_back(TexturedBatch{texture, nullptr, shader, blend, Batcher{}});
3242 }
3243 texturedBatches.back().batch.addTexturedRect(x, y, w, h, color, u0, v0, u1, v1, rotatedUV);
3244 noteTexturedOverlay(texture, uint32_t(texturedBatches.size() - 1));
3245}

3360
3361void Graphics::flush2D(wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass, int viewW, int viewH,
3362 WGPUTextureFormat format) {
3363 ensureFileTexturesReady();
3364 auto spans = std::move(overlaySpans);
3365 const bool offscreen = uint32_t(format) != uint32_t(surfaceFormat);
3366
3367 struct SolidUpload {
3368 BlendMode blend = BlendMode::Alpha;
3369 uint64_t offset = 0;
3370 uint64_t bytes = 0;
3371 };
3372 std::vector<SolidUpload> solidUploads;
3373 solidUploads.reserve(solidBatches.size());
3374 for (const auto &sb : solidBatches) {
3375 if (sb.batch.empty()) {
3376 solidUploads.push_back(SolidUpload{sb.blend, 0, 0});
3377 continue;
3378 }
3379 Batcher ndc = sb.batch;
3380 ndc.toNDC(viewW, viewH);
3381 auto verts = ndc.vertices();
3382 // Batcher::toNDC targets Vulkan's Y-down NDC ((-1,-1)=top-left), but
3383 // WebGPU's clip space is Y-up ((-1,-1)=bottom-left). Flip Y so logical
3384 // top-left maps to the swapchain's top-left.
3385 for (auto &v : verts) v.pos.y = -v.pos.y;
3386 std::vector<float> data;
3387 data.reserve(verts.size() * 6);
3388 for (const auto &v : verts) {
3389 data.push_back(v.pos.x);
3390 data.push_back(v.pos.y);
3391 data.push_back(v.color.r);
3392 data.push_back(v.color.g);
3393 data.push_back(v.color.b);
3394 data.push_back(v.color.a);
3395 }
3396 const uint64_t bytes = data.size() * sizeof(float);
3397 auto &arena = currentVertexArena();
3398 ensureVertexArena(arena, arena.used + bytes);
3399 const uint64_t offset = arena.alloc(bytes);
3400 queue.WriteBuffer(arena.buffer, offset, data.data(), bytes);
3401 solidUploads.push_back(SolidUpload{sb.blend, offset, bytes});
3402 }
3403
3404 auto solidPipe = [&](BlendMode mode) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
3405 return get2DColorPipeline(mode, offscreen);
3406 };
3407
3408 auto drawSolid = [&](uint32_t batchIndex, uint32_t first, uint32_t count) {
3409 if (batchIndex >= solidUploads.size()) return;
3410 const SolidUpload &u = solidUploads[batchIndex];
3411 if (u.bytes == 0 || count == 0) return;
3412 pass.SetPipeline(solidPipe(u.blend));
3413 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, currentVertexArena().buffer, u.offset, u.bytes);
3414 pass.Draw(count, 1, first, 0);
3415 };
3416
3417 if (!spans.empty()) {
3418 for (const auto &sp : spans) {
3419 if (sp.kind == OverlayKind::Solid)
3420 drawSolid(sp.index, sp.vertBegin, sp.vertCount);
3421 else if (sp.kind == OverlayKind::Textured && sp.index < texturedBatches.size())
3422 drawTexturedBatch(pass, texturedBatches[sp.index], viewW, viewH, format, offscreen);
3423 else if (sp.kind == OverlayKind::Lit && sp.index < litBatches.size())
3424 drawLitBatch(pass, litBatches[sp.index], viewW, viewH, format);
3425 }
3426 } else {
3427 for (size_t i = 0; i < solidUploads.size(); ++i) {
3428 if (solidUploads[i].bytes > 0)
3429 drawSolid(uint32_t(i), 0, uint32_t(solidBatches[i].batch.vertices().size()));
3430 }
3431 for (auto &tb : texturedBatches) {
3432 if (tb.batch.empty()) continue;
3433 drawTexturedBatch(pass, tb, viewW, viewH, format, offscreen);
3434 }
3435 for (auto &lb : litBatches) {
3436 if (lb.batch.empty()) continue;
3437 drawLitBatch(pass, lb, viewW, viewH, format);
3438 }
3439 }
3440 clear2DBatches();
3441}
3442
3443void Graphics::drawTexturedBatch(wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass, TexturedBatch &tb, int viewW,
3444 int viewH, WGPUTextureFormat format, bool offscreen) {
3445 Batcher ndc = tb.batch;
3446 ndc.toNDC(viewW, viewH);
3447 auto verts = ndc.vertices();
3448 for (auto &v : verts) v.pos.y = -v.pos.y;
3449 if (verts.empty()) return;
3450
3451 std::vector<float> data;
3452 data.reserve(verts.size() * 8);
3453 for (const auto &v : verts) {
3454 data.push_back(v.pos.x);
3455 data.push_back(v.pos.y);
3456 data.push_back(v.color.r);
3457 data.push_back(v.color.g);
3458 data.push_back(v.color.b);
3459 data.push_back(v.color.a);
3460 data.push_back(v.uv.x);
3461 data.push_back(v.uv.y);
3462 }
3463 uint64_t bytes = data.size() * sizeof(float);
3464 auto &arena = currentVertexArena();
3465 ensureVertexArena(arena, arena.used + bytes);
3466 uint64_t vtxOffset = arena.alloc(bytes);
3467 queue.WriteBuffer(arena.buffer, vtxOffset, data.data(), bytes);
3468
3469 GpuTexture *gpu = gpuForTexture(tb.texture);
3470 GpuTexture *depthGpu = gpuForTexture(tb.depth);
3471 GpuTexture *motionGpu = gpuForTexture(tb.motion);
3472 GpuTexture *extraGpu = gpuForTexture(tb.extra);
3473 GpuTexture *specularGpu = gpuForTexture(tb.specular);
3474 auto &uboArena = currentUboArena();
3475 ensureUboArena(uboArena, uboArena.used + 256);
3476
3477 // Push-constant (Externals) block for custom shaders.
3478 uint32_t pushOffset = 0;
3479 if (tb.shader && tb.shader->pushConstantSize() > 0) {
3480 pushOffset = uboArena.alloc(Shader::kPushConstantBytes, 256);
3481 queue.WriteBuffer(uboArena.buffer, pushOffset, tb.shader->pushConstantData(),
3482 Shader::kPushConstantBytes);
3483 }
3484
3485 wgpu::BindGroup bg = makeTex2DBindGroup(gpu, depthGpu, motionGpu, extraGpu, specularGpu);
3486 uint32_t offsets[1] = {pushOffset};
3487
3488 wgpu::RenderPipeline pipe;
3489 if (tb.shader && tb.shader->gpuHandle) {
3490 auto *gs = static_cast<GpuShader *>(tb.shader->gpuHandle);
3491 const bool hdr = format == WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float;
3492 if (tb.blend == BlendMode::Opaque)
3493 pipe = hdr ? gs->hdrOffscreenOpaquePipeline
3494 : (offscreen ? gs->offscreenOpaquePipeline : gs->swapchainOpaquePipeline);
3495 else
3496 pipe = hdr ? gs->hdrOffscreenPipeline
3497 : (offscreen ? gs->offscreenPipeline : gs->swapchainPipeline);
3498 } else {
3499 switch (tb.blend) {
3500 case BlendMode::Additive:
3501 pipe = offscreen ? offscreenTexturedAdditivePipeline : texturedAdditivePipeline;
3502 break;
3503 case BlendMode::Premultiplied:
3504 pipe = offscreen ? offscreenTexturedPremultipliedPipeline
3505 : texturedPremultipliedPipeline;
3506 break;
3507 case BlendMode::Multiply:
3508 pipe = offscreen ? offscreenTexturedMultiplyPipeline
3509 : texturedMultiplyPipeline;
3510 break;
3511 case BlendMode::Opaque:
3512 pipe = format == WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float
3513 ? hdrOffscreenTexturedOpaquePipeline
3514 : (offscreen ? offscreenTexturedOpaquePipeline
3515 : texturedOpaquePipeline);
3516 break;
3517 case BlendMode::Alpha:
3518 default:
3519 pipe = format == WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float
3520 ? hdrOffscreenTexturedPipeline
3521 : (offscreen ? offscreenTexturedPipeline : texturedPipeline);
3522 break;
3523 }
3524 }
3525 if (!pipe) return;
3526 pass.SetPipeline(pipe);
3527 pass.SetBindGroup(0, bg, 1, offsets);
3528 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, arena.buffer, vtxOffset, bytes);
3529 pass.Draw(static_cast<uint32_t>(verts.size()), 1, 0, 0);
3530}
3531
3532void Graphics::drawLitBatch(wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass, LitBatch &lb, int viewW, int viewH,
3533 WGPUTextureFormat format) {
3534 Batcher ndc = lb.batch;
3535 ndc.toNDC(viewW, viewH);
3536 auto verts = ndc.vertices();
3537 for (auto &v : verts) v.pos.y = -v.pos.y;
3538 if (verts.empty()) return;
3539
3540 std::vector<float> data;
3541 data.reserve(verts.size() * 8);
3542 for (const auto &v : verts) {
3543 data.push_back(v.pos.x);
3544 data.push_back(v.pos.y);
3545 data.push_back(v.color.r);
3546 data.push_back(v.color.g);
3547 data.push_back(v.color.b);
3548 data.push_back(v.color.a);
3549 data.push_back(v.uv.x);
3550 data.push_back(v.uv.y);
3551 }
3552 uint64_t bytes = data.size() * sizeof(float);
3553 auto &arena = currentVertexArena();
3554 ensureVertexArena(arena, arena.used + bytes);
3555 uint64_t vtxOffset = arena.alloc(bytes);
3556 queue.WriteBuffer(arena.buffer, vtxOffset, data.data(), bytes);
3557
3558 GpuTexture *albedoGpu = gpuForTextureOrWhite(lb.albedo);
3559 GpuTexture *normalGpu = gpuForTextureOrWhite(lb.normal);
3560
3561 auto &uboArena = currentUboArena();
3562 ensureUboArena(uboArena, uboArena.used + 512);
3563 uint32_t uboOffset = uboArena.alloc(sizeof(Lighting2DUBO), 256);
3564 queue.WriteBuffer(uboArena.buffer, uboOffset, &lighting2dFrame, sizeof(Lighting2DUBO));
3565
3566 wgpu::BindGroup bg = makeTex2DBindGroup(albedoGpu, normalGpu);
3567 uint32_t offsets[1] = {uboOffset};
3568 wgpu::RenderPipeline pipe =
3569 get2DLitPipeline(uint32_t(format) != uint32_t(surfaceFormat));
3570 if (!pipe) return;
3571 pass.SetPipeline(pipe);
3572 pass.SetBindGroup(0, bg, 1, offsets);
3573 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, arena.buffer, vtxOffset, bytes);
3574 pass.Draw(static_cast<uint32_t>(verts.size()), 1, 0, 0);
3575}

3578// 3D rendering
3579// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
3580
3581void Graphics::begin3DFrame() {
3582 if (!initialized || !device) return;
3583 frame3DStarted = true;
3584 frameHad3DThisFrame = false;
3585 // Match the desktop (Vulkan) backend: had3DThisFrame() must return true
3586 // once a 3D frame begins, or RenderSystem3D::render bails out before any
3587 // mesh is drawn.
3588 frameHad3D = true;
3589 sceneColorPassOpen = false;
3590 mesh3dDraws.clear();
3591 primitive3DDraws.clear();
3592 shadowPassDraws.clear();
3593 voxelDraws.clear();
3594 if (surfaceNeedsRecreate.load()) {
3595 surfaceNeedsRecreate.store(false);
3596 markSwapchainDirty();
3597 }
3598 rebuildSwapchainIfNeeded();
3599}
3600
3601void Graphics::drawPrimitiveScene(const PrimitiveSceneCanvas3D &canvas) {
3602 if (!frame3DStarted) throw Exception("drawPrimitiveScene: call begin3DFrame first");
3603 const ResolvedPrimitiveTriangles resolved = resolvePrimitiveStrokes3D(canvas);
3604 if (resolved.vertices.empty()) return;
3605
3606 const std::size_t firstSequence = primitive3DDraws.size();
3607 primitive3DDraws.reserve(firstSequence + resolved.batches3D.size());
3608 for (const ResolvedPrimitiveBatch3D &batch : resolved.batches3D) {
3609 Primitive3DDraw draw;
3610 draw.paint = batch.paint;
3611 draw.averageDepth = batch.averageDepth;
3612 draw.sequence = firstSequence + batch.sequence;
3613 draw.vertices.reserve(batch.vertexCount);
3614 for (std::size_t vertex = batch.firstVertex; vertex < batch.firstVertex + batch.vertexCount; ++vertex)
3615 draw.vertices.push_back({resolved.vertices[vertex].clipPosition, resolved.vertices[vertex].color});
3616 primitive3DDraws.push_back(std::move(draw));
3617 }
3618}
3619
3620void Graphics::begin3DFrameToCanvas(Canvas *canvas) {
3621 if (!canvas) throw Exception("begin3DFrameToCanvas: null canvas");
3622 if (!device) throw Exception("begin3DFrameToCanvas: device not initialized");
3623 auto *offscreen = dynamic_cast<OffscreenCanvas *>(canvas);
3624 if (!offscreen) throw Exception("begin3DFrameToCanvas: not an offscreen canvas");
3625 clearColor = backgroundColor;
3626 active3DCanvas = offscreen;
3627 begin3DFrame();
3628}
3629void Graphics::end3DFrameToCanvas() {
3630 OffscreenCanvas *canvas = active3DCanvas;
3631 if (!canvas || !device) return;
3632 auto &uboArena = currentUboArena();
3633 uboArena.reset();
3634 ensureUboArena(uboArena, 4096);
3635 auto &vertexArena = currentVertexArena();
3636 vertexArena.reset();
3637
3638 wgpuInstanceProcessEvents(instance.Get());
3639 OffscreenTimestampReadback *timestampSlot = nullptr;
3640 if (offscreenTimestampSupported && offscreenTimestampQuerySet &&
3641 offscreenTimestampResolveBuffer) {
3642 for (size_t candidate = 0; candidate < offscreenTimestampReadbacks.size(); ++candidate) {
3643 const size_t index =
3644 (offscreenTimestampReadbackCursor + candidate) % offscreenTimestampReadbacks.size();
3645 if (!offscreenTimestampReadbacks[index].pending) {
3646 timestampSlot = &offscreenTimestampReadbacks[index];
3647 offscreenTimestampReadbackCursor =
3648 (index + 1) % offscreenTimestampReadbacks.size();
3649 break;
3650 }
3651 }
3652 }
3653
3654 wgpu::CommandEncoder encoder = device.CreateCommandEncoder();
3655 WGPURenderPassColorAttachment color{};
3656 color.view = canvas->colorView.Get();
3657 color.depthSlice = WGPU_DEPTH_SLICE_UNDEFINED;
3658 color.loadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
3659 color.storeOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
3660 const Color canvasClear = canvas->clearRequested ? canvas->clearColor : clearColor;
3661 color.clearValue = {canvasClear.r, canvasClear.g, canvasClear.b, canvasClear.a};
3662 WGPURenderPassDepthStencilAttachment depth{};
3663 depth.view = canvas->depthView.Get();
3664 depth.depthClearValue = 1.f;
3665 depth.depthLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
3666 depth.depthStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
3667 depth.stencilLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Undefined;
3668 depth.stencilStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Undefined;
3669 WGPURenderPassDescriptor descriptor{};
3670 descriptor.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
3671 descriptor.colorAttachments = &color;
3672 descriptor.depthStencilAttachment = &depth;
3673 WGPUPassTimestampWrites timestampWrites{};
3674 if (timestampSlot) {
3675 timestampWrites.querySet = offscreenTimestampQuerySet.Get();
3676 timestampWrites.beginningOfPassWriteIndex = 0;
3677 timestampWrites.endOfPassWriteIndex = 1;
3678 descriptor.timestampWrites = &timestampWrites;
3679 }
3680 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass = encoder.BeginRenderPass(
3681 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor *>(&descriptor));
3682 flushMesh3D(pass,
3683 canvas->isHDR() ? WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float
3684 : WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm,
3685 true);
3686 flushPrimitive3D(pass, canvas->isHDR() ? WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float : WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm, 1);
3687 pass.End();
3688 if (timestampSlot) {
3689 encoder.ResolveQuerySet(offscreenTimestampQuerySet, 0, 2,
3690 offscreenTimestampResolveBuffer, 0);
3691 encoder.CopyBufferToBuffer(offscreenTimestampResolveBuffer, 0, timestampSlot->buffer, 0,
3692 sizeof(uint64_t) * 2);
3693 }
3694 wgpu::CommandBuffer command = encoder.Finish();
3695 queue.Submit(1, &command);
3696 if (timestampSlot) {
3697 timestampSlot->pending = true;
3698 WGPUBufferMapCallbackInfo callback{};
3699 callback.mode = WGPUCallbackMode_AllowProcessEvents;
3700 callback.callback = [](WGPUMapAsyncStatus status, WGPUStringView,
3701 void *userdata1, void *) {
3702 auto *slot = static_cast<OffscreenTimestampReadback *>(userdata1);
3703 if (status == WGPUMapAsyncStatus_Success && slot && slot->owner) {
3704 const auto *ticks = static_cast<const uint64_t *>(
3705 slot->buffer.GetConstMappedRange(0, sizeof(uint64_t) * 2));
3706 if (ticks && ticks[1] >= ticks[0]) {
3707 const float milliseconds = float(ticks[1] - ticks[0]) * 1.0e-6f;
3708 slot->owner->completedOffscreenTimestampMs.fetch_add(milliseconds);
3709 }
3710 slot->buffer.Unmap();
3711 }
3712 if (slot) slot->pending = false;
3713 };
3714 callback.userdata1 = timestampSlot;
3715 wgpuBufferMapAsync(timestampSlot->buffer.Get(), WGPUMapMode_Read, 0,
3716 sizeof(uint64_t) * 2, callback);
3717 }
3718 canvas->clearRequested = false;
3719 active3DCanvas = nullptr;
3720 frame3DStarted = false;
3721 frameHad3DThisFrame = false;
3722 frameHad3D = false;
3723}

3830
3831void Graphics::uploadClusteredLighting(const ClusteredLightingUpload &upload) {
3832 if (!device) return;
3833 ClusteredStorage &st = clusteredStorage[currentFrameSlot()];
3834 auto ensure = [&](wgpu::Buffer &buf, uint64_t &cap, uint64_t need) {
3835 if (need == 0) need = 4;
3836 if (buf && cap >= need) return;
3837 WGPUBufferDescriptor bd{};
3838 bd.label = sv("eve_clustered_ssbo");
3839 bd.size = std::max(need, cap ? cap * 2 : need);
3840 bd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Storage;
3841 bd.mappedAtCreation = false;
3842 buf = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&bd));
3843 cap = bd.size;
3844 };
3845 const uint64_t lightsBytes =
3846 std::max<uint64_t>(1, upload.lights.size()) * sizeof(ClusteredLightGpu);
3847 const uint64_t tableBytes =
3848 std::max<uint64_t>(1, upload.clusterTable.size()) * sizeof(ClusterTableEntry);
3849 const uint64_t indicesBytes =
3850 std::max<uint64_t>(1, upload.lightIndices.size()) * sizeof(uint32_t);
3851 ensure(st.lights, st.lightsCap, lightsBytes);
3852 ensure(st.table, st.tableCap, tableBytes);
3853 ensure(st.indices, st.indicesCap, indicesBytes);
3854
3855 ClusteredLightGpu zero{};
3856 if (!upload.lights.empty())
3857 queue.WriteBuffer(st.lights, 0, upload.lights.data(), lightsBytes);
3858 else
3859 queue.WriteBuffer(st.lights, 0, &zero, sizeof(zero));
3860 if (!upload.clusterTable.empty())
3861 queue.WriteBuffer(st.table, 0, upload.clusterTable.data(), tableBytes);
3862 if (!upload.lightIndices.empty())
3863 queue.WriteBuffer(st.indices, 0, upload.lightIndices.data(), indicesBytes);
3864}

4003void Graphics::drawDecal(const glm::mat4 &model, Texture *albedo, Texture *normal,

4007 if (!decalPassActive) return;
4008 DecalDraw draw;

4011 draw.normal = normal ? normal : decalFlatNormal;
4012 draw.params = params ? params : decalFlatParams;
4013 if (uvRect) draw.uvRect = glm::vec4(uvRect[0], uvRect[1], uvRect[2], uvRect[3]);
4014 draw.fadeParams = glm::vec4(fade, normalStrength, roughnessStrength, metalStrength);
