4025// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
4026// Voxel
4027// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
4028
4029void Graphics::drawVoxelFaceInstances(const uint32_t *packed, int count, float originX,
4030 float originY, float originZ, const std::string &faceDir,
4031 Texture *atlas, int tilesPerRow, const uint32_t *ao) {
4032 if (!device || count <= 0 || !packed) return;
4033 if (!voxelUnitQuadVerts) return;
4034 frameHad3DThisFrame = true;
4035 frameHad3D = true;
4036
4037 int face = -1;
4038 if (faceDir == "posX" || faceDir == "+x") face = 0;
4039 else if (faceDir == "negX" || faceDir == "-x") face = 1;
4040 else if (faceDir == "posY" || faceDir == "+y") face = 2;
4041 else if (faceDir == "negY" || faceDir == "-y") face = 3;
4042 else if (faceDir == "posZ" || faceDir == "+z") face = 4;
4043 else if (faceDir == "negZ" || faceDir == "-z") face = 5;
4044 else
4045 throw Exception("drawVoxelFaceInstances: unknown faceDir '%s'", faceDir.c_str());
4046
4047 VoxelDraw d;
4048 d.count = uint32_t(count);
4049 d.atlas = gpuForTextureOrWhite(atlas);
4050 d.viewProj = mesh3dViewProj;
4051 d.chunkOrigin = glm::vec4(originX, originY, originZ, float(face));
4052 d.atlasInfo = glm::vec4(float(std::max(1, tilesPerRow)), 0.f, 0.f, 0.f);
4053 d.tint = glm::vec4(1.f);
4054 d.instanceBufferOffset = 0;
4055 d.pushUboOffset = 0;
4056
4057 // Upload packed instances + the parallel AO word (2 bits per corner) into
4058 // the per-frame instance arenas.
4059 auto &arena = voxelInstanceArena;
4060 auto &aoArena = voxelAoArena;
4061 auto ensureArena = [&](VertexArena &a) {
4062 if (!a.buffer) {
4063 WGPUBufferDescriptor bd{};
4064 bd.label = sv("eve_voxel_instances");
4065 bd.size = 1u << 20;
4066 bd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Vertex;
4067 bd.mappedAtCreation = false;
4068 a.buffer = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&bd));
4069 a.capacity = 1u << 20;
4070 }
4071 uint64_t need = uint64_t(count) * 4;
4072 if (a.used + need > a.capacity) {
4073 uint64_t cap = a.capacity * 2;
4074 WGPUBufferDescriptor bd{};
4075 bd.label = sv("eve_voxel_instances");
4076 bd.size = cap;
4077 bd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Vertex;
4078 bd.mappedAtCreation = false;
4079 a.buffer = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&bd));
4080 a.capacity = cap;
4081 a.used = 0;
4082 }
4083 };
4084 ensureArena(arena);
4085 ensureArena(aoArena);
4086 const uint32_t defaultAO = 0xFFu; // all four corners AO=3 (full bright)
4087 std::vector<uint32_t> aoDefaults;
4088 if (!ao) {
4089 aoDefaults.assign(size_t(count), defaultAO);
4090 ao = aoDefaults.data();
4091 }
4092 const uint64_t need = uint64_t(count) * 4;
4093 d.instanceBufferOffset = static_cast<uint32_t>(arena.used);
4094 queue.WriteBuffer(arena.buffer, arena.used, packed, need);
4095 arena.used += need;
4096 d.aoBufferOffset = static_cast<uint32_t>(aoArena.used);
4097 queue.WriteBuffer(aoArena.buffer, aoArena.used, ao, need);
4098 aoArena.used += need;
4099 voxelDraws.push_back(d);
4100}

4105
4106void Graphics::createSceneColorResources(int width, int height) {
4107 if (!device) return;
4108 // Keep the main WebGPU scene single-sampled. Dawn/Metal does not complete
4109 // the current MSAA resolve followed by synchronous scene readback chain.
4110 // Temporal AA remains available; Vulkan owns the multisampled main path.
4111 const uint32_t want = 1u;
4112 if (sceneColorWidth == width && sceneColorHeight == height && sceneColorSamples == want &&
4113 !sceneColorSlots.empty())
4114 return;
4115
4116 destroySceneColorResources();
4117 sceneColorWidth = width;
4118 sceneColorHeight = height;
4119 const uint32_t oldSamples = sceneColorSamples;
4120 const bool samplesChanged = oldSamples != want;
4121 sceneColorSamples = want;
4122 sceneColorSlots.reserve(kFramesInFlight);
4123 for (int s = 0; s < int(kFramesInFlight); ++s) {
4124 sceneColorSlots.emplace_back();
4125 SceneColorSlot &slot = sceneColorSlots.back();
4126 slot.sampleCount = sceneColorSamples;
4127
4128 WGPUTextureDescriptor cd{};
4129 cd.label = sv("eve_scene_color");
4130 cd.dimension = WGPUTextureDimension_2D;
4131 cd.size = {static_cast<uint32_t>(width), static_cast<uint32_t>(height), 1};
4132 // Single-sample resolve target: composited to the swapchain and used
4133 // as the frame-readback source. The multisampled color lives in
4134 // msaaColor (created below) and is resolved into this texture.
4135 cd.sampleCount = 1;
4136 cd.format = sceneColorFormat;
4137 cd.mipLevelCount = 1;
4138 cd.usage = WGPUTextureUsage_TextureBinding | WGPUTextureUsage_RenderAttachment |
4139 WGPUTextureUsage_CopySrc;
4140 slot.color = device.CreateTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor*>(&cd));
4141 slot.colorView = slot.color.CreateView();
4142
4143 if (sceneColorSamples > 1) {
4144 // Multisampled color target; the scene pass resolves it into the
4145 // single-sample `color` above for compositing / readback.
4146 WGPUTextureDescriptor mcd{};
4147 mcd.label = sv("eve_scene_color_msaa");
4148 mcd.dimension = WGPUTextureDimension_2D;
4149 mcd.size = {static_cast<uint32_t>(width), static_cast<uint32_t>(height), 1};
4150 mcd.sampleCount = sceneColorSamples;
4151 mcd.format = sceneColorFormat;
4152 mcd.mipLevelCount = 1;
4153 mcd.usage = WGPUTextureUsage_RenderAttachment;
4154 slot.msaaColor =
4155 device.CreateTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor*>(&mcd));
4156 slot.msaaView = slot.msaaColor.CreateView();
4157 }
4158
4159 WGPUTextureDescriptor dd{};
4160 dd.label = sv("eve_scene_depth");
4161 dd.dimension = WGPUTextureDimension_2D;
4162 dd.size = {static_cast<uint32_t>(width), static_cast<uint32_t>(height), 1};
4163 dd.sampleCount = sceneColorSamples;
4164 dd.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
4165 dd.mipLevelCount = 1;
4166 dd.usage = WGPUTextureUsage_RenderAttachment;
4167 slot.depth = device.CreateTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor*>(&dd));
4168 slot.depthView = slot.depth.CreateView();
4169
4170 slot.colorGpu.texture = slot.color;
4171 slot.colorGpu.view = slot.colorView;
4172 slot.colorGpu.width = width;
4173 slot.colorGpu.height = height;
4174 slot.colorGpu.sampler = createLinearSampler(device);
4175 slot.colorGpu.samplerState = TextureSampler::linearMipmap();
4176
4177 slot.colorTex.gpuHandle = &slot.colorGpu;
4178 slot.colorTex.width = width;
4179 slot.colorTex.height = height;
4180 slot.colorTex.mipmapCount = 1;
4181
4182 }
4183 sceneColorTexture = &sceneColorSlots[0].colorTex;
4184 // 3D pipelines that render into the scene target must match its sample
4185 // count. Invalidate only the affected cached variants; they are rebuilt
4186 // individually if a later draw actually needs them.
4187 if (samplesChanged) {
4188 mesh3dPipelines = {};
4189 mesh3dPipeline = {};
4190 mesh3dTransparentPipeline = {};
4191 mesh3dClusteredPipeline = {};
4192 voxelRectPipeline = {};
4193 }
4194 if (samplesChanged && gpuDrivenCullPipeline_) {
4195 // The forward indirect pipeline inherits the scene target sample
4196 // count. Recreate the GPU-driven layouts/pipelines lazily on the next
4197 // cull after an MSAA toggle.
4198 gpuDrivenCullPipeline_ = {};
4199 gpuDrivenRenderPipeline_ = {};
4200 gpuDrivenCanvasPipeline_ = {};
4201 gpuDrivenComputePipelineLayout_ = {};
4202 gpuDrivenRenderPipelineLayout_ = {};
4203 gpuDrivenComputeSetLayout_ = {};
4204 gpuDrivenRenderSetLayout_ = {};
4205 gpuDrivenComputeBindGroup_ = {};
4206 gpuDrivenRenderBindGroup_ = {};
4207 }
4208}

4210void Graphics::destroySceneColorResources() {
4211 sceneColorSlots.clear();
4212 sceneColorTexture = nullptr;
4213 sceneColorHistoryValid = false;
4214}

4216void Graphics::setMsaaSamples(int samples) {
4217 msaaSamples = samples > 0 ? samples : 0;
4218 if (!initialized || sceneColorWidth <= 0 || sceneColorHeight <= 0) return;
4219 // Force the offscreen targets (and the 3D pipelines that bind them) to
4220 // rebuild at the new sample count.
4221 destroySceneColorResources();
4222 createSceneColorResources(sceneColorWidth, sceneColorHeight);
4223}

4225void Graphics::createShadowResources() {
4226 if (!device) return;
4227 if (shadowDepthArray) return;
4228 shadowMapSize = ShadowConfig::kMapSize;
4229
4230 // Depth array: 3 cascade layers, renderable + sampleable.
4231 auto *gpu = new GpuTexture();
4232 WGPUTextureDescriptor td{};
4233 td.label = sv("eve_shadow_depth");
4234 td.dimension = WGPUTextureDimension_2D;
4235 td.size = {static_cast<uint32_t>(shadowMapSize), static_cast<uint32_t>(shadowMapSize), 3};
4236 td.sampleCount = 1;
4237 td.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
4238 td.mipLevelCount = 1;
4239 td.usage = WGPUTextureUsage_TextureBinding | WGPUTextureUsage_RenderAttachment |
4240 WGPUTextureUsage_CopySrc | WGPUTextureUsage_CopyDst;
4241 gpu->texture = device.CreateTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor*>(&td));
4242
4243 WGPUTextureViewDescriptor avd{};
4244 avd.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
4245 avd.dimension = WGPUTextureViewDimension_2DArray;
4246 avd.baseMipLevel = 0;
4247 avd.mipLevelCount = 1;
4248 avd.baseArrayLayer = 0;
4249 avd.arrayLayerCount = 3;
4250 gpu->view = gpu->texture.CreateView(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor*>(&avd));
4251
4252 WGPUSamplerDescriptor sd{};
4253 sd.label = sv("eve_shadow_sampler");
4254 sd.addressModeU = WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
4255 sd.addressModeV = WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
4256 sd.addressModeW = WGPUAddressMode_ClampToEdge;
4257 sd.magFilter = WGPUFilterMode_Linear;
4258 sd.minFilter = WGPUFilterMode_Linear;
4259 sd.mipmapFilter = WGPUMipmapFilterMode_Nearest;
4260 sd.compare = WGPUCompareFunction_LessEqual;
4261 sd.maxAnisotropy = 1.f;
4262 gpu->sampler = device.CreateSampler(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::SamplerDescriptor*>(&sd));
4263 shadowDepthArray = gpu;
4264}

4270void Graphics::createGbufferResources(int width, int height) {

4273 destroyGbufferResources();
4274 gbufferWidth = width;
4275 gbufferHeight = height;

4279 td.dimension = WGPUTextureDimension_2D;
4280 td.size = {static_cast<uint32_t>(width), static_cast<uint32_t>(height), 1};

4297 WGPUTextureDescriptor visIdDesc = td;

4313 slot.albedoView = slot.albedo.CreateView();
4314 slot.depth = device.CreateTexture(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor*>(&dd));
4315 slot.depthView = slot.depth.CreateView();
4316 slot.visID = device.CreateTexture(
4317 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor *>(&visIdDesc));
4318 slot.visIDView = slot.visID.CreateView();
4319 slot.visBary = device.CreateTexture(
4320 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureDescriptor *>(&visBaryDesc));
4321 slot.visBaryView = slot.visBary.CreateView();
4322
4323 slot.normalGpu.texture = slot.normal;
4324 slot.normalGpu.view = slot.normalView;
4325 slot.normalGpu.sampler = createLinearSampler(device);
4326 slot.depthColorGpu.texture = slot.depthColor;
4327 slot.depthColorGpu.view = slot.depthColorView;
4328 slot.depthColorGpu.sampler = createLinearSampler(device);
4329 slot.albedoGpu.texture = slot.albedo;
4330 slot.albedoGpu.view = slot.albedoView;
4331 slot.albedoGpu.sampler = createLinearSampler(device);
4332 slot.depthGpu.texture = slot.depth;
4333 slot.depthGpu.view = slot.depthView;
4334 slot.depthGpu.sampler = createLinearSampler(device);
4335
4336 slot.normalTex.gpuHandle = &slot.normalGpu;
4337 slot.normalTex.width = width;
4338 slot.normalTex.height = height;
4339 slot.depthColorTex.gpuHandle = &slot.depthColorGpu;
4340 slot.depthColorTex.width = width;
4341 slot.depthColorTex.height = height;
4342 slot.albedoTex.gpuHandle = &slot.albedoGpu;
4343 slot.albedoTex.width = width;
4344 slot.albedoTex.height = height;
4345 slot.depthTex.gpuHandle = &slot.depthGpu;
4346 slot.depthTex.width = width;
4347 slot.depthTex.height = height;
4348
4349 }

4392
4393void Graphics::flushPrimitive3D(wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass, WGPUTextureFormat format, uint32_t sampleCount) {
4394 if (primitive3DDraws.empty()) return;
4395 std::stable_sort(primitive3DDraws.begin(), primitive3DDraws.end(),
4396 [](const Primitive3DDraw &a, const Primitive3DDraw &b) {
4397 const bool ignoreA = a.paint.depth == PrimitiveDepthMode::Ignore;
4398 const bool ignoreB = b.paint.depth == PrimitiveDepthMode::Ignore;
4399 if (ignoreA != ignoreB) return !ignoreA;
4400 if (a.paint.layer != b.paint.layer) return a.paint.layer < b.paint.layer;
4401 const bool transparentA = a.paint.blend != BlendMode::Opaque || a.paint.color.a < 1.f;
4402 const bool transparentB = b.paint.blend != BlendMode::Opaque || b.paint.color.a < 1.f;
4403 if (transparentA != transparentB) return !transparentA;
4404 if (transparentA && a.averageDepth != b.averageDepth) return a.averageDepth > b.averageDepth;
4405 return a.sequence < b.sequence;
4406 });
4407 auto &arena = currentVertexArena();
4408 std::size_t totalBytes = 0;
4409 for (const Primitive3DDraw &draw : primitive3DDraws) totalBytes += draw.vertices.size() * sizeof(Primitive3DVertex);
4410 ensureVertexArena(arena, arena.used + totalBytes);
4411 for (const Primitive3DDraw &draw : primitive3DDraws) {
4412 if (draw.vertices.empty()) continue;
4413 const uint64_t bytes = draw.vertices.size() * sizeof(Primitive3DVertex);
4414 const uint64_t offset = arena.alloc(bytes);
4415 queue.WriteBuffer(arena.buffer, offset, draw.vertices.data(), bytes);
4416 pass.SetPipeline(
4417 getPrimitive3DPipeline(draw.paint.depth, draw.paint.blend, draw.paint.cull, format, sampleCount));
4418 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, arena.buffer, offset, bytes);
4419 pass.Draw(static_cast<uint32_t>(draw.vertices.size()), 1, 0, 0);
4420 }
4421 primitive3DDraws.clear();
4422}
4423
4424void Graphics::flushMesh3D(wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass, WGPUTextureFormat format,
4425 bool canvasTarget) {
4426 if (mesh3dDraws.empty()) return;
4427
4428 if (mesh3dClusteredActive && !canvasTarget && !mesh3dClusteredPipeline) {
4429 for (const auto &d : mesh3dDraws) {
4430 const bool customShader = d.shader && d.shader->gpuHandle;
4431 if (!customShader && !d.doubleSided && d.surfaceMode != SurfaceMode::Transparent &&
4432 d.mesh && !d.mesh->hasGpuSkinning()) {
4433 createMesh3DClusteredPipeline();
4434 break;
4435 }
4436 }
4437 }
4438
4439 auto &uboArena = currentUboArena();
4440 ensureUboArena(uboArena, uboArena.used + mesh3dDraws.size() * 10240);
4441 auto &vtxArena = currentVertexArena();
4442
4443 // Pre-allocate per-draw UBO slots.
4444 for (auto &d : mesh3dDraws) {
4445 d.frameUboOffset = uboArena.alloc(sizeof(Mesh3DUBO), 256);
4446 d.shadowUboOffset = uboArena.alloc(sizeof(ShadowUBO), 256);
4447 d.clusteredUboOffset = 0;
4448 if (mesh3dClusteredActive && !canvasTarget && d.mesh && !d.mesh->hasGpuSkinning())
4449 d.clusteredUboOffset = uboArena.alloc(sizeof(Mesh3DClusteredUBO), 256);
4450 d.pushUboOffset = 0;
4451 if (d.shader && d.shader->pushConstantSize() > 0)
4452 d.pushUboOffset = uboArena.alloc(Shader::kPushConstantBytes, 256);
4453 }
4454
4455 // Upload the per-draw frame UBO + shared shadow UBO.
4456 for (auto &d : mesh3dDraws) {
4457 if (mesh3dClusteredActive && !canvasTarget && mesh3dClusteredPipeline && d.clusteredUboOffset) {
4458 Mesh3DClusteredUBO cubo;
4459 cubo.mvp = mesh3dViewProj * d.model;
4460 cubo.model = d.model;
4461 cubo.view = mesh3dView;
4462 cubo.lightDir = glm::vec4(glm::vec3(mesh3dClustered.primaryDir),
4463 mesh3dClustered.primaryDir.w);
4464 cubo.lightColor = glm::vec4(glm::vec3(mesh3dClustered.primaryColor), mesh3dEnvIntensity);
4465 cubo.tint = d.tint;
4466 cubo.cameraPos = glm::vec4(mesh3dCameraPos, mesh3dRoughness);
4467 cubo.ambient = glm::vec4(glm::vec3(mesh3dClustered.ambient), mesh3dMetallic);
4468 cubo.gridInfo = mesh3dClustered.gridInfo;
4469 cubo.clipInfo = mesh3dClustered.clipInfo;
4470 cubo.texBomb =
4471 glm::vec4(mesh3dTexBombScale, mesh3dTexBombStrength, mesh3dTexBombRot, 0.f);
4472 cubo.parallax = glm::vec4(mesh3dParallaxScale, mesh3dParallaxMin, mesh3dParallaxMax, 0.f);
4473 cubo.virtualTexture = d.virtualTexture;
4474 cubo.virtualAtlas = d.virtualAtlas;
4475 float surfaceCode = float(int(d.surfaceMode));
4476 if (d.surfaceMode == SurfaceMode::Masked && d.alphaTechnique == "dither")
4477 surfaceCode = 3.f;
4478 else if (d.surfaceMode == SurfaceMode::Masked && d.alphaTechnique == "coverage")
4479 surfaceCode = 4.f;
4480 const float aoStrength =
4481 (renderControl_ && renderControl_->isEnabled("ao")) ? mesh3dSsaoIntensity : 0.f;
4482 cubo.surface = glm::vec4(surfaceCode, d.alphaCutoff, aoStrength, 0.f);
4483 cubo.envProbeCenter = glm::vec4(mesh3dEnvProbeCenter, 1.f);
4484 cubo.envProbeExtent = glm::vec4(mesh3dEnvProbeExtent, 0.f);
4485 for (int i = 0; i < ReflectionProbeUpload::kMaxProbes; ++i) {
4486 if (i >= mesh3dReflectionProbes.count) continue;
4487 const auto &probe = mesh3dReflectionProbes.probes[i];
4488 GpuTexture *gpu = gpuForTexture(probe.cubemap);
4489 if (!gpu || !gpu->isCube) continue;
4490 cubo.reflectionProbeCenter[i] = glm::vec4(probe.center, probe.intensity);
4491 cubo.reflectionProbeExtent[i] = glm::vec4(probe.extent, probe.blendDistance);
4492 }
4493 queue.WriteBuffer(uboArena.buffer, d.clusteredUboOffset, &cubo, sizeof(cubo));
4494 continue;
4495 }
4496 Mesh3DUBO ubo;
4497 ubo.mvp = mesh3dViewProj * d.model;
4498 ubo.model = d.model;
4499 ubo.lightDir = glm::vec4(glm::vec3(mesh3dLighting.lights[0].posRadius), float(mesh3dLighting.count));
4500 ubo.lightColor = mesh3dLighting.lights[0].color;
4501 ubo.tint = d.tint;
4502 ubo.cameraPos = glm::vec4(mesh3dCameraPos, mesh3dRoughness);
4503 ubo.ambient = glm::vec4(glm::vec3(mesh3dLighting.ambient), mesh3dMetallic);
4504 for (int i = 0; i < Lighting3DPack::kMaxLights; ++i)
4505 ubo.lights[i] = mesh3dLighting.lights[i];
4506 float surfaceCode = float(int(d.surfaceMode));
4507 if (d.surfaceMode == SurfaceMode::Masked && d.alphaTechnique == "dither")
4508 surfaceCode = 3.f;
4509 else if (d.surfaceMode == SurfaceMode::Masked && d.alphaTechnique == "coverage")
4510 surfaceCode = 4.f;
4511 ubo.texBomb =
4512 glm::vec4(mesh3dTexBombScale, mesh3dTexBombStrength, mesh3dTexBombRot, 0.f);
4513 ubo.parallax =
4514 glm::vec4(mesh3dParallaxScale, mesh3dParallaxMin, mesh3dParallaxMax, d.alphaCutoff);
4515 ubo.virtualTexture = d.virtualTexture;
4516 ubo.virtualAtlas = d.virtualAtlas;
4517 const float aoStrength =
4518 (renderControl_ && renderControl_->isEnabled("ao")) ? mesh3dSsaoIntensity : 0.f;
4519 ubo.surface = glm::vec4(surfaceCode, d.alphaCutoff, aoStrength, 0.f);
4520 ubo.view = mesh3dView;
4521 ubo.clipInfo = glm::vec4(mesh3dNear, mesh3dFar, 0.f, 0.f);
4522 ubo.cloud = mesh3dCloud;
4523 ubo.cloudWind = mesh3dCloudWind;
4524 ubo.envProbeCenter = glm::vec4(mesh3dEnvProbeCenter, 1.f);
4525 ubo.envProbeExtent = glm::vec4(mesh3dEnvProbeExtent, 0.f);
4526 for (int i = 0; i < ReflectionProbeUpload::kMaxProbes; ++i) {
4527 if (i >= mesh3dReflectionProbes.count) continue;
4528 const auto &probe = mesh3dReflectionProbes.probes[i];
4529 GpuTexture *gpu = gpuForTexture(probe.cubemap);
4530 if (!gpu || !gpu->isCube) continue;
4531 ubo.reflectionProbeCenter[i] = glm::vec4(probe.center, probe.intensity);
4532 ubo.reflectionProbeExtent[i] = glm::vec4(probe.extent, probe.blendDistance);
4533 }
4534 ubo.lightColor.w = mesh3dEnvIntensity;
4535 if (d.mesh && d.mesh->hasGpuSkinning()) {
4536 const int count = std::min(d.mesh->getSkinPaletteCount(), Mesh::kMaxSkinBones);
4537 ubo.skinInfo.x = static_cast<float>(count);
4538 const auto &palette = d.mesh->skinPalette();
4539 for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
4540 std::memcpy(&ubo.skinBones[i], palette.data() + static_cast<size_t>(i) * 16u,
4541 sizeof(glm::mat4));
4542 }
4543 }
4544 // X-ray params travel through the Frame UBO (no extra binding). Packed
4545 // in bindMeshUniforms("xray") order: colorR..G..B, bias, screenW, screenH,
4546 // rimPower, rimStrength, alpha.
4547 if (d.shader && d.shader->isXray() && d.shader->pushConstantSize() >= 9 * sizeof(float)) {
4548 const float *pc = d.shader->pushConstantData();
4549 ubo.texBomb = glm::vec4(pc[0], pc[1], pc[2], pc[8]); // color.xyz + alpha
4550 ubo.parallax = glm::vec4(pc[3], pc[4], pc[5], pc[7]); // bias, screenW, screenH, rimStrength
4551 ubo.clipInfo.z = pc[6]; // rimPower
4552 }
4553 queue.WriteBuffer(uboArena.buffer, d.frameUboOffset, &ubo, sizeof(ubo));
4554 if (d.shader && d.shader->pushConstantSize() > 0)
4555 queue.WriteBuffer(uboArena.buffer, d.pushUboOffset, d.shader->pushConstantData(),
4556 Shader::kPushConstantBytes);
4557 }
4558
4559 // Capture receive-shadow per draw; RenderSystem3D changes it between queued meshes.
4560 for (auto &d : mesh3dDraws) {
4561 ShadowUBO shadowUbo = mesh3dShadows.ubo;
4562 if (!mesh3dShadows.active || !d.shadowReceive) shadowUbo.bias.y = 0.f;
4563 queue.WriteBuffer(uboArena.buffer, d.shadowUboOffset, &shadowUbo, sizeof(shadowUbo));
4564 }
4565
4566 for (auto &d : mesh3dDraws) {
4567 auto *gpuMesh = static_cast<GpuMesh *>(d.mesh->gpuHandle);
4568 if (!gpuMesh || !gpuMesh->vertexBuffer) continue;
4569
4570 const bool transparent = d.surfaceMode == SurfaceMode::Transparent;
4571 const BlendMode blend = transparent ? d.surfaceBlend : BlendMode::Opaque;
4572 const bool depthWrite = !transparent || d.depthWrite;
4573 // Canvas targets are 1-sample; scene pipelines follow the active MSAA
4574 // count. Both sets preserve the per-draw material raster state.
4575 const bool customShader = d.shader && d.shader->gpuHandle;
4576 wgpu::RenderPipeline pipe;
4577 if (d.shader && d.shader->gpuHandle) {
4578 auto *gs = static_cast<GpuShader *>(d.shader->gpuHandle);
4579 if (gs->isMesh3D && gs->mesh3dPipeline) {
4580 if (d.shader->isXray() && gs->mesh3dXrayPipeline)
4581 pipe = gs->mesh3dXrayPipeline;
4582 else
4583 pipe = gs->mesh3dPipeline;
4584 }
4585 }
4586 if (!pipe) pipe = getMesh3DPipeline(blend, depthWrite, d.doubleSided, canvasTarget);
4587 const bool useClustered = !canvasTarget && !customShader && !d.doubleSided &&
4588 mesh3dClusteredActive &&
4589 d.surfaceMode != SurfaceMode::Transparent &&
4590 mesh3dClusteredPipeline && d.clusteredUboOffset;
4591 if (useClustered) pipe = mesh3dClusteredPipeline;
4592 if (!pipe) continue;
4593 pass.SetPipeline(pipe);
4594
4595 GpuTexture *albedo = gpuForTexture(d.texture);
4596 GpuTexture *normal = gpuForTexture(d.normalTexture);
4597 GpuTexture *env = gpuForTexture(mesh3dEnvTexture);
4598 GpuTexture *height = gpuForTexture(d.heightTexture);
4599 GpuTexture *depth = mesh3dSceneDepthTexture ? gpuForTexture(mesh3dSceneDepthTexture)
4600 : flatDepthTexture3D;
4601 GpuTexture *sceneColor = mesh3dSceneColorTexture ? gpuForTexture(mesh3dSceneColorTexture)
4602 : sceneColorHistoryValid && lastPresentSlot < sceneColorSlots.size()
4603 ? &sceneColorSlots[lastPresentSlot].colorGpu
4604 : whiteTexture;
4605 wgpu::BindGroup bg;
4606 uint32_t offsets[3];
4607 if (useClustered) {
4608 wgpu::TextureView aoView_ =
4609 aoReady ? aoView[(aoWriteIndex + 1) % 2]
4610 : (whiteTexture ? whiteTexture->view : wgpu::TextureView());
4611 bg = makeMesh3DClusteredBindGroup(albedo, normal, env, height, depth, aoView_,
4612 d.clusteredUboOffset, d.shadowUboOffset);
4613 offsets[0] = d.clusteredUboOffset;
4614 offsets[1] = d.shadowUboOffset;
4615 pass.SetBindGroup(0, bg, 2, offsets);
4616 } else {
4617 bg = makeMeshBindGroup(albedo, normal, env, height, depth, sceneColor,
4618 d.frameUboOffset, d.shadowUboOffset, d.pushUboOffset);
4619 offsets[0] = d.frameUboOffset;
4620 offsets[1] = d.shadowUboOffset;
4621 offsets[2] = d.pushUboOffset;
4622 pass.SetBindGroup(0, bg, 3, offsets);
4623 }
4624
4625 if (gpuMesh->indexBuffer) {
4626 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, gpuMesh->vertexBuffer, 0,
4627 uint64_t(gpuMesh->vertexCount) * gpuMesh->vertexStride);
4628 const uint64_t indexBytes = gpuMesh->indexFormat == wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint16 ? 2u : 4u;
4629 pass.SetIndexBuffer(gpuMesh->indexBuffer, gpuMesh->indexFormat, 0,
4630 uint64_t(gpuMesh->indexCount) * indexBytes);
4631 pass.DrawIndexed(gpuMesh->indexCount, 1, 0, 0, 0);
4632 } else {
4633 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, gpuMesh->vertexBuffer, 0,
4634 uint64_t(gpuMesh->vertexCount) * gpuMesh->vertexStride);
4635 pass.Draw(gpuMesh->vertexCount, 1, 0, 0);
4636 }
4637 }
4638 mesh3dDraws.clear();
4639}

4641void Graphics::flushShadowPass(wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass, int cascade) {
4642 auto &uboArena = currentUboArena();
4643 if (cascade < 0 || cascade >= ShadowConfig::kCascades) return;
4644 if (!mesh3dShadowPipeline) createShadowPipelines();
4645 ensureUboArena(uboArena, uboArena.used + shadowCascadeDraws[cascade].size() * 8448);
4646 for (auto &d : shadowCascadeDraws[cascade]) {
4647 auto *gpuMesh = static_cast<GpuMesh *>(d.mesh->gpuHandle);
4648 if (!gpuMesh || !gpuMesh->vertexBuffer) continue;
4649
4650 pass.SetPipeline(d.alphaTest ? mesh3dShadowAlphaPipeline : mesh3dShadowPipeline);
4651
4652 SkinPassUBO ubo;
4653 ubo.mvp = d.mvp;
4654 if (d.mesh->hasGpuSkinning()) {
4655 const int count = std::min(d.mesh->getSkinPaletteCount(), Mesh::kMaxSkinBones);
4656 ubo.skinInfo.x = static_cast<float>(count);
4657 const auto &palette = d.mesh->skinPalette();
4658 std::memcpy(ubo.skinBones, palette.data(), static_cast<size_t>(count) * sizeof(glm::mat4));
4659 }
4660 uint32_t offset = uboArena.alloc(sizeof(SkinPassUBO), 256);
4661 queue.WriteBuffer(uboArena.buffer, offset, &ubo, sizeof(ubo));
4662
4663 GpuTexture *albedo = gpuForTextureOrWhite(d.albedo);
4664 WGPUBindGroupEntry entries[3]{};
4665 entries[0].binding = 0;
4666 entries[0].buffer = uboArena.buffer.Get();
4667 entries[0].size = sizeof(SkinPassUBO);
4668 entries[1].binding = 1;
4669 entries[1].textureView = albedo->view.Get();
4670 entries[2].binding = 2;
4671 entries[2].sampler = albedo->sampler.Get();
4672 WGPUBindGroupDescriptor bgd{};
4673 bgd.layout = shadowSetLayout.Get();
4674 bgd.entryCount = 3;
4675 bgd.entries = entries;
4676 wgpu::BindGroup bg = device.CreateBindGroup(
4677 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor *>(&bgd));
4678 uint32_t offsets[1] = {offset};
4679 pass.SetBindGroup(0, bg, 1, offsets);
4680
4681 if (gpuMesh->indexBuffer) {
4682 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, gpuMesh->vertexBuffer, 0,
4683 uint64_t(gpuMesh->vertexCount) * gpuMesh->vertexStride);
4684 const uint64_t indexBytes =
4685 gpuMesh->indexFormat == wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint16 ? 2u : 4u;
4686 pass.SetIndexBuffer(gpuMesh->indexBuffer, gpuMesh->indexFormat, 0,
4687 uint64_t(gpuMesh->indexCount) * indexBytes);
4688 pass.DrawIndexed(gpuMesh->indexCount, 1, 0, 0, 0);
4689 } else {
4690 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, gpuMesh->vertexBuffer, 0,
4691 uint64_t(gpuMesh->vertexCount) * gpuMesh->vertexStride);
4692 pass.Draw(gpuMesh->vertexCount, 1, 0, 0);
4693 }
4694 }
4695 shadowCascadeDraws[cascade].clear();
4696}
4697
4698void Graphics::flushGbufferPass(wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass) {
4699 if (gbufferPassDraws.empty() || gbufferSlots.empty()) return;
4700 if (!mesh3dGbufferPipeline) createGbufferPipelines();
4701 auto &uboArena = currentUboArena();
4702 ensureUboArena(uboArena, uboArena.used + gbufferPassDraws.size() * 8448);
4703 for (auto &d : gbufferPassDraws) {
4704 auto *gpuMesh = static_cast<GpuMesh *>(d.mesh->gpuHandle);
4705 if (!gpuMesh || !gpuMesh->vertexBuffer) continue;
4706
4707 pass.SetPipeline(d.alphaTest ? mesh3dGbufferAlphaPipeline : mesh3dGbufferPipeline);
4708
4709 SkinPassUBO ubo;
4710 ubo.mvp = d.mvp;
4711 ubo.model = d.model;
4712 auto u6 = [](float value) {
4713 return uint32_t(std::lround(std::clamp(value, 0.f, 1.f) * 63.f));
4714 };
4715 const uint32_t rough3 =
4716 uint32_t(std::lround(std::clamp(d.roughness, 0.f, 1.f) * 7.f));
4717 const uint32_t metal3 =
4718 uint32_t(std::lround(std::clamp(d.metallic, 0.f, 1.f) * 7.f));
4719 const uint32_t packedTint = u6(d.tint.r) | (u6(d.tint.g) << 6) | (u6(d.tint.b) << 12) |
4720 (rough3 << 18) | (metal3 << 21);
4721 auto motion12 = [](float value) {
4722 return uint32_t(std::lround(std::clamp(value, -1.f, 1.f) * 2047.f)) + 2047u;
4723 };
4724 const uint32_t packedMotion = motion12(d.motion.x) | (motion12(d.motion.y) << 12);
4725 ubo.clip = glm::vec4(d.nearZ, d.farZ, float(packedTint), float(packedMotion));
4726 if (d.mesh->hasGpuSkinning()) {
4727 const int count = std::min(d.mesh->getSkinPaletteCount(), Mesh::kMaxSkinBones);
4728 ubo.skinInfo.x = static_cast<float>(count);
4729 const auto &palette = d.mesh->skinPalette();
4730 std::memcpy(ubo.skinBones, palette.data(), static_cast<size_t>(count) * sizeof(glm::mat4));
4731 }
4732
4733 uint32_t offset = uboArena.alloc(sizeof(SkinPassUBO), 256);
4734 queue.WriteBuffer(uboArena.buffer, offset, &ubo, sizeof(ubo));
4735
4736 GpuTexture *albedo = gpuForTextureOrWhite(d.albedo);
4737 WGPUBindGroupEntry entries[3]{};
4738 entries[0].binding = 0;
4739 entries[0].buffer = uboArena.buffer.Get();
4740 entries[0].size = sizeof(SkinPassUBO);
4741 entries[1].binding = 1;
4742 entries[1].textureView = albedo->view.Get();
4743 entries[2].binding = 2;
4744 entries[2].sampler = albedo->sampler.Get();
4745 WGPUBindGroupDescriptor bgd{};
4746 bgd.layout = gbufferSetLayout.Get();
4747 bgd.entryCount = 3;
4748 bgd.entries = entries;
4749 wgpu::BindGroup bg = device.CreateBindGroup(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor*>(&bgd));
4750 uint32_t offsets[1] = {offset};
4751 pass.SetBindGroup(0, bg, 1, offsets);
4752
4753 if (gpuMesh->indexBuffer) {
4754 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, gpuMesh->vertexBuffer, 0,
4755 uint64_t(gpuMesh->vertexCount) * gpuMesh->vertexStride);
4756 const uint64_t indexBytes = gpuMesh->indexFormat == wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint16 ? 2u : 4u;
4757 pass.SetIndexBuffer(gpuMesh->indexBuffer, gpuMesh->indexFormat, 0,
4758 uint64_t(gpuMesh->indexCount) * indexBytes);
4759 pass.DrawIndexed(gpuMesh->indexCount, 1, 0, 0, 0);
4760 } else {
4761 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, gpuMesh->vertexBuffer, 0,
4762 uint64_t(gpuMesh->vertexCount) * gpuMesh->vertexStride);
4763 pass.Draw(gpuMesh->vertexCount, 1, 0, 0);
4764 }
4765 }
4766 gbufferPassDraws.clear();
4767 gbufferPassPending = false;
4768}

4770void Graphics::flushDecalPass(wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass) {
4771 if (decalPassDraws.empty() || gbufferSlots.empty()) {
4772 decalPassPending = false;
4773 return;
4774 }
4775 if (!decalPipeline) createDecalPipeline();
4776 auto &uboArena = currentUboArena();
4777 ensureUboArena(uboArena, uboArena.used + decalPassDraws.size() * 512);
4778 GbufferSlot &gbuffer = gbufferSlots[lastGbufferSlot];
4779 pass.SetPipeline(decalPipeline);
4780 struct DecalUniforms {
4781 glm::mat4 invViewProj;
4782 glm::mat4 invModel;
4783 glm::vec4 modelR0;
4784 glm::vec4 modelR1;
4785 glm::vec4 modelR2;
4786 glm::vec4 uvRect;
4787 glm::vec4 fadeParams;
4788 glm::vec4 extraParams;
4789 glm::vec4 texel;
4790 };
4791 static_assert(sizeof(DecalUniforms) == 240);
4792 for (const auto &draw : decalPassDraws) {
4793 DecalUniforms uniforms{};
4794 uniforms.invViewProj = glm::inverse(decalViewProj);
4795 uniforms.invModel = glm::inverse(draw.model);
4796 uniforms.modelR0 = draw.model[0];
4797 uniforms.modelR1 = draw.model[1];
4798 uniforms.modelR2 = draw.model[2];
4799 uniforms.uvRect = draw.uvRect;
4800 uniforms.fadeParams = draw.fadeParams;
4801 uniforms.extraParams = draw.extraParams;
4802 uniforms.texel = glm::vec4(1.f / float(decalWidth), 1.f / float(decalHeight), 0.f, 0.f);
4803 uint32_t offset = uboArena.alloc(256, 256);
4804 queue.WriteBuffer(uboArena.buffer, offset, &uniforms, sizeof(uniforms));
4805 GpuTexture *albedo = gpuForTextureOrWhite(draw.albedo);
4806 GpuTexture *normal = gpuForTextureOrWhite(draw.normal);
4807 GpuTexture *params = gpuForTextureOrWhite(draw.params);
4808 WGPUBindGroupEntry entries[7]{};
4809 entries[0].binding = 0;
4810 entries[0].buffer = uboArena.buffer.Get();
4811 entries[0].size = sizeof(uniforms);
4812 entries[1].binding = 1;
4813 entries[1].textureView = albedo->view.Get();
4814 entries[2].binding = 2;
4815 entries[2].textureView = normal->view.Get();
4816 entries[3].binding = 3;
4817 entries[3].textureView = params->view.Get();
4818 entries[4].binding = 4;
4819 entries[4].textureView = gbuffer.depthView.Get();
4820 entries[5].binding = 5;
4821 entries[5].textureView = gbuffer.normalView.Get();
4822 entries[6].binding = 6;
4823 entries[6].sampler = mainSampler.Get();
4824 WGPUBindGroupDescriptor descriptor{};
4825 descriptor.layout = decalSetLayout.Get();
4826 descriptor.entryCount = 7;
4827 descriptor.entries = entries;
4828 wgpu::BindGroup group = device.CreateBindGroup(
4829 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor *>(&descriptor));
4830 uint32_t offsets[1] = {offset};
4831 pass.SetBindGroup(0, group, 1, offsets);
4832 pass.Draw(3, 1, 0, 0);
4833 }
4834 decalPassDraws.clear();
4835 decalPassPending = false;
4836 decalReady = true;
4837 clearMeshBindGroupCache();
4838}
4839
4840void Graphics::submitPendingDeferredPasses() {
4841 if ((!gbufferPassPending || gbufferSlots.empty()) &&
4842 (!decalPassPending || decalSlots.empty()))
4843 return;
4844 auto &uboArena = currentUboArena();
4845 uboArena.reset();
4846 ensureUboArena(uboArena, 4096 + (gbufferPassDraws.size() + decalPassDraws.size()) * 512);
4847 wgpu::CommandEncoder encoder = device.CreateCommandEncoder();
4848 if (gbufferPassPending && !gbufferSlots.empty()) {
4849 lastGbufferSlot = currentFrameSlot();
4850 GbufferSlot &slot = gbufferSlots[lastGbufferSlot];
4851 WGPURenderPassColorAttachment colors[3]{};
4852 for (auto &color : colors) {
4853 color.depthSlice = WGPU_DEPTH_SLICE_UNDEFINED;
4854 color.loadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
4855 color.storeOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
4856 color.clearValue = {0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
4857 }
4858 colors[1].clearValue = {1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f};
4859 colors[0].view = slot.normalView.Get();
4860 colors[1].view = slot.depthColorView.Get();
4861 colors[2].view = slot.albedoView.Get();
4862 WGPURenderPassDepthStencilAttachment depth{};
4863 depth.view = slot.depthView.Get();
4864 depth.depthClearValue = 1.f;
4865 depth.depthLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
4866 depth.depthStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
4867 depth.stencilLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Undefined;
4868 depth.stencilStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Undefined;
4869 WGPURenderPassDescriptor descriptor{};
4870 descriptor.colorAttachmentCount = 3;
4871 descriptor.colorAttachments = colors;
4872 descriptor.depthStencilAttachment = &depth;
4873 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass = encoder.BeginRenderPass(
4874 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor *>(&descriptor));
4875 flushGbufferPass(pass);
4876 pass.End();
4877 gbufferDepthValid_ = true;
4878 }
4879 if (decalPassPending && !decalSlots.empty() && !gbufferSlots.empty()) {
4880 lastDecalSlot = currentFrameSlot();
4881 DecalSlot &slot = decalSlots[lastDecalSlot];
4882 WGPURenderPassColorAttachment colors[3]{};
4883 for (auto &color : colors) {
4884 color.depthSlice = WGPU_DEPTH_SLICE_UNDEFINED;
4885 color.loadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
4886 color.storeOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
4887 color.clearValue = {0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
4888 }
4889 colors[0].view = slot.albedoView.Get();
4890 colors[1].view = slot.normalView.Get();
4891 colors[2].view = slot.paramsView.Get();
4892 WGPURenderPassDescriptor descriptor{};
4893 descriptor.colorAttachmentCount = 3;
4894 descriptor.colorAttachments = colors;
4895 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass = encoder.BeginRenderPass(
4896 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor *>(&descriptor));
4897 flushDecalPass(pass);
4898 pass.End();
4899 }
4900 wgpu::CommandBuffer command = encoder.Finish();
4901 queue.Submit(1, &command);
4902}

4904void Graphics::flushVoxelDraws(wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass, WGPUTextureFormat format) {
4905 if (voxelDraws.empty()) return;
4906 if (!voxelRectPipeline) createVoxelPipelines();
4907 auto &uboArena = currentUboArena();
4908 ensureUboArena(uboArena, uboArena.used + voxelDraws.size() * 512);
4909 pass.SetPipeline(voxelRectPipeline);
4910
4911 for (auto &d : voxelDraws) {
4912 uint32_t offset = uboArena.alloc(256, 256);
4913 struct VoxelPC {
4914 glm::mat4 viewProj;
4915 glm::vec4 chunkOrigin;
4916 glm::vec4 atlasInfo;
4917 glm::vec4 tint;
4918 } pc;
4919 pc.viewProj = d.viewProj;
4920 pc.chunkOrigin = d.chunkOrigin;
4921 pc.atlasInfo = d.atlasInfo;
4922 pc.tint = d.tint;
4923 queue.WriteBuffer(uboArena.buffer, offset, &pc, sizeof(pc));
4924
4925 WGPUBindGroupEntry entries[3]{};
4926 entries[0].binding = 0;
4927 entries[0].buffer = uboArena.buffer.Get();
4928 entries[0].size = sizeof(pc);
4929 entries[1].binding = 1;
4930 entries[1].textureView = d.atlas->view.Get();
4931 entries[2].binding = 2;
4932 entries[2].sampler = d.atlas->sampler.Get();
4933 WGPUBindGroupDescriptor bgd{};
4934 bgd.layout = voxelSetLayout.Get();
4935 bgd.entryCount = 3;
4936 bgd.entries = entries;
4937 wgpu::BindGroup bg = device.CreateBindGroup(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor*>(&bgd));
4938 uint32_t offsets[1] = {offset};
4939 pass.SetBindGroup(0, bg, 1, offsets);
4940
4941 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, voxelUnitQuadVerts, 0, 32);
4942 pass.SetVertexBuffer(1, voxelInstanceArena.buffer, d.instanceBufferOffset,
4943 uint64_t(d.count) * 4);
4944 pass.SetVertexBuffer(2, voxelAoArena.buffer, d.aoBufferOffset,
4945 uint64_t(d.count) * 4);
4946 pass.SetIndexBuffer(voxelUnitQuadIndices, wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32, 0, 24);
4947 pass.DrawIndexed(6, d.count, 0, 0, 0);
4948 }
4949 voxelDraws.clear();
4950}

5001
5002void Graphics::present() {
5003 ensureFileTexturesReady();
5004 if (!device || !surface || !swapchainConfigured) return;
5005 pumpReadback();
5006 rebuildSwapchainIfNeeded();
5007 if (!swapchainConfigured) return;
5008 // RenderControl can toggle MSAA without resizing the window. Re-evaluate
5009 // the offscreen sample count every frame, matching the Vulkan backend.
5010 if (sceneColorWidth > 0 && sceneColorHeight > 0)
5011 createSceneColorResources(sceneColorWidth, sceneColorHeight);
5012 const bool aoActive = renderControl_ && renderControl_->isEnabled("ao");
5013
5014 wgpu::TextureView surfaceView;
5015 wgpu::Texture surfaceTex;
5016 if (!acquireSurfaceTexture(surfaceView, surfaceTex)) {
5017 return;
5018 }
5019
5020 auto &uboArena = currentUboArena();
5021 uboArena.reset();
5022 auto &vtxArena = currentVertexArena();
5023 vtxArena.reset();
5024 voxelInstanceArena.used = 0;
5025 voxelAoArena.used = 0;
5026 ensureUboArena(uboArena, 4096);
5027 ensureVertexArena(vtxArena, 4096);
5028 // Match the desktop (Vulkan) flow: the 3D/swapchain pass clears with the
5029 // background set by setBackgroundColor unless the script called clear().
5030 if (!hasPendingClear) clearColor = backgroundColor;
5031 hasPendingClear = false;
5032
5033 wgpu::CommandEncoder encoder = device.CreateCommandEncoder();
5034 // Compute compaction writes the visible-model table and indexed-indirect
5035 // commands consumed by the scene render pass below. Ending the compute
5036 // pass establishes the required WebGPU storage-to-indirect dependency.
5037 recordGpuDrivenCompute(encoder);
5038
5039 // 1. Shadow passes (CSM cascade layers).
5040 if (shadowDepthArray) {
5041 // Every cascade is sampled by receivers, including cascades with no
5042 // caster draw this frame. Clear all layers while shadows are active so
5043 // an empty cascade deterministically means fully lit (depth 1) instead
5044 // of retaining undefined or previous-frame depth.
5045 if (mesh3dShadows.active) {
5046 for (int c = 0; c < ShadowConfig::kCascades; ++c) {
5047 WGPUTextureViewDescriptor lvd{};
5048 lvd.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
5049 lvd.dimension = WGPUTextureViewDimension_2D;
5050 lvd.baseMipLevel = 0;
5051 lvd.mipLevelCount = 1;
5052 lvd.baseArrayLayer = static_cast<uint32_t>(c);
5053 lvd.arrayLayerCount = 1;
5054 wgpu::TextureView layerView = shadowDepthArray->texture.CreateView(
5055 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor*>(&lvd));
5056 WGPURenderPassDepthStencilAttachment ds{};
5057 ds.view = layerView.Get();
5058 ds.depthClearValue = 1.f;
5059 ds.depthLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
5060 ds.depthStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5061 ds.stencilClearValue = 0;
5062 ds.stencilLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Undefined;
5063 ds.stencilStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Undefined;
5064 WGPURenderPassDescriptor rp{};
5065 rp.depthStencilAttachment = &ds;
5066 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass = encoder.BeginRenderPass(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor*>(&rp));
5067 flushShadowPass(pass, c);
5068 pass.End();
5069 }
5070 }
5071 }
5072
5073 // Stage-3 visibility pass consumes the compute-compacted instance table
5074 // before the scene pass resolves material shading.
5075 recordGpuDrivenVisibility(encoder);
5076
5077 // 2. Scene color pass (3D) into the offscreen target.
5078 wgpu::TextureView sceneView;
5079 wgpu::Texture sceneTex;
5080 if (frameHad3DThisFrame) {
5081 if (active3DCanvas) {
5082 // 3D into an offscreen canvas: render the mesh pass into the
5083 // canvas color/depth (RGBA8Unorm, matches the mesh3d pipelines).
5084 OffscreenCanvas *oc = active3DCanvas;
5085 WGPURenderPassColorAttachment colorAtt{};
5086 colorAtt.view = oc->colorView.Get();
5087 colorAtt.depthSlice = WGPU_DEPTH_SLICE_UNDEFINED;
5088 colorAtt.loadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
5089 colorAtt.storeOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5090 colorAtt.clearValue = {clearColor.r, clearColor.g, clearColor.b, 1.f};
5091 WGPURenderPassDepthStencilAttachment ds{};
5092 ds.view = oc->depthView.Get();
5093 ds.depthClearValue = 1.f;
5094 ds.depthLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
5095 ds.depthStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5096 ds.stencilClearValue = 0;
5097 ds.stencilLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Undefined;
5098 ds.stencilStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Undefined;
5099 WGPURenderPassDescriptor rp{};
5100 rp.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
5101 rp.colorAttachments = &colorAtt;
5102 rp.depthStencilAttachment = &ds;
5103 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass =
5104 encoder.BeginRenderPass(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor*>(&rp));
5105 // Voxel draws are not expected on the canvas path (voxel module is
5106 // trimmed from the web build), and its pipeline follows the scene
5107 // sample count which would mismatch the 1x canvas attachment.
5108 flushMesh3D(pass, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm, /*canvasTarget*/ true);
5109 flushGpuDrivenDraws(pass, /*canvasTarget*/ true);
5110 flushPrimitive3D(pass, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm, 1);
5111 pass.End();
5112 oc->clearRequested = false;
5113 // The script draws the canvas texture explicitly (2D path); it is
5114 // not composited into the swapchain.
5115 lastReadbackTex = oc->color;
5116 lastReadbackW = oc->getWidth();
5117 lastReadbackH = oc->getHeight();
5118 } else if (!sceneColorSlots.empty()) {
5119 SceneColorSlot &slot = sceneColorSlots[currentFrameSlot()];
5120 std::vector<Mesh3dDraw> refractiveDraws;
5121 const bool splitSceneColor = mesh3dSceneColorCaptureIndex.has_value() &&
5122 *mesh3dSceneColorCaptureIndex <= mesh3dDraws.size() &&
5123 sceneColorSlots.size() > 1 && slot.sampleCount == 1;
5124 if (splitSceneColor) {
5125 auto split = mesh3dDraws.begin() +
5126 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(*mesh3dSceneColorCaptureIndex);
5127 refractiveDraws.assign(std::make_move_iterator(split),
5128 std::make_move_iterator(mesh3dDraws.end()));
5129 mesh3dDraws.erase(split, mesh3dDraws.end());
5130 }
5131 WGPURenderPassColorAttachment colorAtt{};
5132 colorAtt.view = slot.sampleCount > 1 ? slot.msaaView.Get() : slot.colorView.Get();
5133 colorAtt.resolveTarget = slot.sampleCount > 1 ? slot.colorView.Get() : nullptr;
5134 colorAtt.depthSlice = WGPU_DEPTH_SLICE_UNDEFINED;
5135 colorAtt.loadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
5136 // When resolving to a single-sample target, the multisampled
5137 // attachment must be discarded (WebGPU spec).
5138 colorAtt.storeOp =
5139 slot.sampleCount > 1 ? WGPUStoreOp_Discard : WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5140 colorAtt.clearValue = {clearColor.r, clearColor.g, clearColor.b, 1.f};
5141 WGPURenderPassDepthStencilAttachment ds{};
5142 ds.view = slot.depthView.Get();
5143 ds.depthClearValue = 1.f;
5144 ds.depthLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
5145 ds.depthStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5146 ds.stencilClearValue = 0;
5147 ds.stencilLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Undefined;
5148 ds.stencilStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Undefined;
5149 WGPURenderPassDescriptor rp{};
5150 rp.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
5151 rp.colorAttachments = &colorAtt;
5152 rp.depthStencilAttachment = &ds;
5153 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass =
5154 encoder.BeginRenderPass(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor*>(&rp));
5155 flushVoxelDraws(pass, sceneColorFormat);
5156 flushGpuDrivenResolve(pass);
5157 flushMesh3D(pass, sceneColorFormat);
5158 flushGpuDrivenDraws(pass, /*canvasTarget*/ false);
5159 flushPrimitive3D(pass, sceneColorFormat, slot.sampleCount);
5160 pass.End();
5161 if (splitSceneColor) {
5162 const uint32_t snapshotIndex =
5163 (currentFrameSlot() + 1u) % static_cast<uint32_t>(sceneColorSlots.size());
5164 SceneColorSlot &snapshot = sceneColorSlots[snapshotIndex];
5165 WGPUTexelCopyTextureInfo source{};
5166 source.texture = slot.color.Get();
5167 source.mipLevel = 0;
5168 source.origin = {0, 0, 0};
5169 source.aspect = WGPUTextureAspect_All;
5170 WGPUTexelCopyTextureInfo destination{};
5171 destination.texture = snapshot.color.Get();
5172 destination.mipLevel = 0;
5173 destination.origin = {0, 0, 0};
5174 destination.aspect = WGPUTextureAspect_All;
5175 WGPUExtent3D extent{static_cast<uint32_t>(sceneColorWidth),
5176 static_cast<uint32_t>(sceneColorHeight), 1};
5177 encoder.CopyTextureToTexture(
5178 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo *>(&source),
5179 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo *>(&destination),
5180 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::Extent3D *>(&extent));
5181
5182 lastPresentSlot = snapshotIndex;
5183 sceneColorHistoryValid = true;
5184 mesh3dDraws = std::move(refractiveDraws);
5185 colorAtt.resolveTarget = nullptr;
5186 colorAtt.loadOp = WGPULoadOp_Load;
5187 colorAtt.storeOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5188 ds.depthLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Load;
5189 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder transparentPass = encoder.BeginRenderPass(
5190 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor *>(&rp));
5191 flushMesh3D(transparentPass, sceneColorFormat);
5192 transparentPass.End();
5193 }
5194 mesh3dSceneColorCaptureIndex.reset();
5195 lastPresentSlot = currentFrameSlot();
5196 sceneColorHistoryValid = true;
5197 lastReadbackTex = slot.color;
5198 lastReadbackW = sceneColorWidth;
5199 lastReadbackH = sceneColorHeight;
5200 sceneView = slot.colorView;
5201 sceneTex = slot.color;
5202 }
5203 }
5204
5205 // 3. GBuffer pass.
5206 if (gbufferPassPending && !gbufferSlots.empty()) {
5207 lastGbufferSlot = currentFrameSlot();
5208 GbufferSlot &slot = gbufferSlots[lastGbufferSlot];
5209 WGPURenderPassColorAttachment colorAtts[3]{};
5210 for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
5211 colorAtts[i].depthSlice = WGPU_DEPTH_SLICE_UNDEFINED;
5212 colorAtts[i].loadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
5213 colorAtts[i].storeOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5214 colorAtts[i].clearValue = {0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 1.f};
5215 }
5216 colorAtts[0].view = slot.normalView.Get();
5217 colorAtts[1].view = slot.depthColorView.Get();
5218 colorAtts[2].view = slot.albedoView.Get();
5219 WGPURenderPassDepthStencilAttachment ds{};
5220 ds.view = slot.depthView.Get();
5221 ds.depthClearValue = 1.f;
5222 ds.depthLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
5223 ds.depthStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5224 ds.stencilClearValue = 0;
5225 ds.stencilLoadOp = WGPULoadOp_Undefined;
5226 ds.stencilStoreOp = WGPUStoreOp_Undefined;
5227 WGPURenderPassDescriptor rp{};
5228 rp.colorAttachmentCount = 3;
5229 rp.colorAttachments = colorAtts;
5230 rp.depthStencilAttachment = &ds;
5231 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass = encoder.BeginRenderPass(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor*>(&rp));
5232 flushGbufferPass(pass);
5233 pass.End();
5234
5235 // 3b. SSAO pass: derive a screen-space occlusion texture from the
5236 // G-buffer linear depth; the forward mesh pass samples the previous
5237 // slot (one frame of latency).
5238 if (aoActive) {
5239 ensureAOResources(sceneColorWidth, sceneColorHeight);
5240 if (aoPipeline && aoTex[0]) {
5241 pushValidationScope();
5242 GbufferSlot &gslot = gbufferSlots[currentFrameSlot()];
5243 struct AOUbo {
5244 glm::vec4 params; // radius, power, nearZ, farZ
5245 float intensity;
5246 float invScale; // AO target size / depth size
5247 float pad;
5248 } aou;
5249 // Near/far are passed so the shader can linearize the
5250 // hardware depth into world units for the occlusion delta.
5251 aou.params = glm::vec4(0.05f, 1.1f, mesh3dNear, mesh3dFar);
5252 aou.intensity = 1.0f;
5253 aou.invScale = 0.5f;
5254 aou.pad = 0.f;
5255 queue.WriteBuffer(aoUbo, 0, &aou, sizeof(aou));
5256 wgpu::BindGroup aoBg = makeAOBindGroup(gslot.depthView);
5257
5258 WGPURenderPassColorAttachment colorAtt{};
5259 colorAtt.view = aoView[aoWriteIndex].Get();
5260 colorAtt.depthSlice = WGPU_DEPTH_SLICE_UNDEFINED;
5261 colorAtt.loadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
5262 colorAtt.storeOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5263 colorAtt.clearValue = {1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f};
5264 WGPURenderPassDescriptor rp{};
5265 rp.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
5266 rp.colorAttachments = &colorAtt;
5267 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder apass =
5268 encoder.BeginRenderPass(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor*>(&rp));
5269 apass.SetPipeline(aoPipeline);
5270 apass.SetBindGroup(0, aoBg, 0, nullptr);
5271 apass.SetVertexBuffer(0, fullscreenQuadVb, 0, 4 * 32);
5272 apass.SetIndexBuffer(fullscreenQuadIb, wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32, 0, 24);
5273 apass.DrawIndexed(6, 1, 0, 0, 0);
5274 apass.End();
5275 popValidationScope();
5276 aoWriteIndex ^= 1;
5277 }
5278 }
5279 }
5280
5281 // 3c. Screen-space decals consume the freshly written GBuffer depth and
5282 // world normal, then write three transparent layer attachments.
5283 if (decalPassPending && !decalSlots.empty() && !gbufferSlots.empty()) {
5284 lastDecalSlot = currentFrameSlot();
5285 DecalSlot &slot = decalSlots[lastDecalSlot];
5286 WGPURenderPassColorAttachment colorAtts[3]{};
5287 for (auto &attachment : colorAtts) {
5288 attachment.depthSlice = WGPU_DEPTH_SLICE_UNDEFINED;
5289 attachment.loadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
5290 attachment.storeOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5291 attachment.clearValue = {0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
5292 }
5293 colorAtts[0].view = slot.albedoView.Get();
5294 colorAtts[1].view = slot.normalView.Get();
5295 colorAtts[2].view = slot.paramsView.Get();
5296 WGPURenderPassDescriptor rp{};
5297 rp.colorAttachmentCount = 3;
5298 rp.colorAttachments = colorAtts;
5299 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass =
5300 encoder.BeginRenderPass(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor *>(&rp));
5301 flushDecalPass(pass);
5302 pass.End();
5303 }
5304
5305 // 4. Active canvas: flush 2D batches into the offscreen target instead.
5306 if (activeCanvas) {
5307 auto *oc = static_cast<OffscreenCanvas *>(activeCanvas);
5308 flush2DToCanvas(oc);
5309 }
5310
5311 // 5. Swapchain pass: composite scene color, draw 2D, run the overlay.
5312 {
5313 WGPURenderPassColorAttachment colorAtt{};
5314 colorAtt.view = surfaceView.Get();
5315 colorAtt.depthSlice = WGPU_DEPTH_SLICE_UNDEFINED;
5316 colorAtt.loadOp = WGPULoadOp_Clear;
5317 colorAtt.storeOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5318 colorAtt.clearValue = {clearColor.r, clearColor.g, clearColor.b, 1.f};
5319 WGPURenderPassDescriptor rp{};
5320 rp.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
5321 rp.colorAttachments = &colorAtt;
5322 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass = encoder.BeginRenderPass(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor*>(&rp));
5323
5324 if (sceneView && !sceneColorComposited) {
5325 if (!fullscreenQuadReady) {
5326 // Textured vertex: pos(2) + color(4) + uv(2) = 32 bytes.
5327 float verts[32] = {
5328 -1.f, -1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.f, 0.f,
5329 1.f, -1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.f,
5330 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f,
5331 -1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.f, 1.f,
5332 };
5333 uint32_t indices[6] = {0, 1, 2, 2, 3, 0};
5334 WGPUBufferDescriptor vbd{};
5335 vbd.label = sv("eve_fullscreen_vb");
5336 vbd.size = sizeof(verts);
5337 vbd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Vertex;
5338 fullscreenQuadVb = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&vbd));
5339 queue.WriteBuffer(fullscreenQuadVb, 0, verts, sizeof(verts));
5340 WGPUBufferDescriptor ibd{};
5341 ibd.label = sv("eve_fullscreen_ib");
5342 ibd.size = sizeof(indices);
5343 ibd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_Index;
5344 fullscreenQuadIb = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&ibd));
5345 queue.WriteBuffer(fullscreenQuadIb, 0, indices, sizeof(indices));
5346 fullscreenQuadReady = true;
5347 }
5348
5349 GpuTexture sceneGpu;
5350 sceneGpu.texture = sceneTex;
5351 sceneGpu.view = sceneView;
5352 sceneGpu.sampler = createLinearSampler(device);
5353 wgpu::BindGroup bg = makeTex2DBindGroup(&sceneGpu, nullptr);
5354 uint32_t offsets[1] = {0};
5355 pass.SetPipeline(get2DTexturedPipeline(BlendMode::Alpha, false));
5356 pass.SetBindGroup(0, bg, 1, offsets);
5357 pass.SetVertexBuffer(0, fullscreenQuadVb, 0, 4 * 32);
5358 pass.SetIndexBuffer(fullscreenQuadIb, wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32, 0, 24);
5359 pass.DrawIndexed(6, 1, 0, 0, 0);
5360 }
5361
5362 if (!activeCanvas) {
5363 flush2D(pass, pixelW > 0 ? pixelW : logicalW, pixelH > 0 ? pixelH : logicalH,
5364 surfaceFormat);
5365 }
5366
5367 if (presentOverlayFn_ && presentOverlayFn_(presentOverlayUser_, nullptr)) {
5368 WGPURenderPassEncoder cPass = pass.Get();
5369 presentOverlayFn_(presentOverlayUser_, &cPass);
5370 }
5371 pass.End();
5372 }
5373
5374 wgpu::CommandBuffer cmd = encoder.Finish();
5375 queue.Submit(1, &cmd);
5376 // emdawnwebgpu implements the GPU on the JS main thread: queued commands
5377 // (draws, writes) only execute when ProcessEvents drives the work queue.
5378 // Without this, render-pass draws are silently never executed (only the
5379 // swapchain clear, handled by the browser present, is visible).
5380#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
5381 if (instance) instance.ProcessEvents();
5382#endif
5383 // emdawnwebgpu does not implement wgpuSurfacePresent (it aborts); the
5384 // browser presents the canvas automatically once the command buffer is
5385 // submitted from within a requestAnimationFrame callback. On Emscripten
5386 // the engine frame is driven by emscripten_set_main_loop (rAF), so the
5387 // Squirrel main loop no longer blocks and no sleep is needed here.
5388#if !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__)
5389 surface.Present();
5390#endif
5391
5392 frameIndex++;
5393 frame3DStarted = false;
5394 frameHad3DThisFrame = false;
5395 frameHad3D = false;
5396 sceneColorPassOpen = false;
5397 active3DCanvas = nullptr;
5398 gbufferPassPending = false;
5399}

5405Canvas *Graphics::newCanvas(int width, int height) {
5406 auto *c = new OffscreenCanvas(this, width, height);
5407 ownedCanvases.push_back(std::unique_ptr<eve::graphics::Canvas>(c));
5408 return c;
5409}
5410
5411Canvas *Graphics::newHDRCanvas(int width, int height) {
5412 auto *c = new OffscreenCanvas(this, width, height, true);
5413 ownedCanvases.push_back(std::unique_ptr<eve::graphics::Canvas>(c));
5414 return c;

5416
5417void Graphics::setCanvas(Canvas *canvas) {
5418 if (activeCanvas && canvas != activeCanvas) {
5419 flush2DToCanvas(static_cast<OffscreenCanvas *>(activeCanvas));
5420 }
5421 activeCanvas = canvas;
5422}
5423
5424bool Graphics::isCanvasActive() const { return activeCanvas != nullptr; }
5425Canvas *Graphics::getCanvas() const { return activeCanvas; }
5426
5427void Graphics::flush2DToCanvas(OffscreenCanvas *canvas) {
5428 if (!canvas || !canvas->getTexture()) return;
5429 auto &uboArena = currentUboArena();
5430 uboArena.reset();
5431 auto &vtxArena = currentVertexArena();
5432 vtxArena.reset();
5433
5434 wgpu::CommandEncoder enc = device.CreateCommandEncoder();
5435 WGPURenderPassColorAttachment ca{};
5436 ca.view = canvas->colorView.Get();
5437 ca.depthSlice = WGPU_DEPTH_SLICE_UNDEFINED;
5438 ca.loadOp = canvas->clearRequested ? WGPULoadOp_Clear : WGPULoadOp_Load;
5439 ca.storeOp = WGPUStoreOp_Store;
5440 ca.clearValue = {canvas->clearColor.r, canvas->clearColor.g, canvas->clearColor.b,
5441 canvas->clearColor.a};
5442 WGPURenderPassDescriptor rp{};
5443 rp.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
5444 rp.colorAttachments = &ca;
5445 wgpu::RenderPassEncoder pass = enc.BeginRenderPass(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor*>(&rp));
5446 flush2D(pass, canvas->getWidth(), canvas->getHeight(),
5447 canvas->isHDR() ? WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float
5448 : WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm);
5449 pass.End();
5450 wgpu::CommandBuffer cmd = enc.Finish();
5451 queue.Submit(1, &cmd);
5452 canvas->clearRequested = false;
5453}
5454
5455Texture *Graphics::getTexture() {
5456 if (activeCanvas) return activeCanvas->getTexture();
5457 return sceneColorTexture;
5458}

5460void Graphics::draw(eve::graphics::Graphics *gfx, const glm::mat4 &matrix) const {
5461 (void)gfx;
5462 (void)matrix;
5463}
5464
5465void Graphics::draw(Canvas *C, const glm::mat4 &matrix) const {
5466 (void)C;
5467 (void)matrix;
5468}
5469
5470void Graphics::clear(std::optional<Color> color, std::optional<int> /*stencil*/,
5471 std::optional<double> /*depth*/) {
5472 if (frameHad3D && activeCanvas == nullptr) return;
5473 clearColor = color.value_or(backgroundColor);
5474 hasPendingClear = true;
5475 clear2DBatches();
5476 if (auto *canvas = dynamic_cast<OffscreenCanvas *>(activeCanvas)) {
5477 canvas->clear(clearColor, std::nullopt, std::nullopt);
5478 }
5479}
5480
5481Color Graphics::getPixel(int x, int y) {
5482 if (activeCanvas) return getPixelImpl(static_cast<OffscreenCanvas *>(activeCanvas), x, y);
5483 if (!sceneColorSlots.empty()) {
5484 return getPixelImpl(nullptr, x, y);
5485 }
5486 return clearColor;
5487}
5488
5489image::ImageData *Graphics::newImageData() {
5490 if (activeCanvas) return newImageDataImpl(static_cast<OffscreenCanvas *>(activeCanvas));
5491 if (!sceneColorSlots.empty()) return newImageDataImpl(nullptr);
5492 return new image::ImageData(1, 1, "RGBA8");
5493}

5495// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
5496// Readback
5497// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
5498
5499namespace {
5500
5501bool copyTextureToCpu(wgpu::Instance &instance, wgpu::Device &device, wgpu::Queue &queue,
5502 wgpu::Texture src, int width, int height, std::vector<uint8_t> &outRgba,
5503 int bytesPerPixel) {
5504 if (!src) return false;
5505 uint64_t bytesPerRow = static_cast<uint64_t>(width) * bytesPerPixel;
5506 bytesPerRow = (bytesPerRow + 255) / 256 * 256; // copy alignment 256
5507 uint64_t size = bytesPerRow * height;
5508
5509 WGPUBufferDescriptor bd{};
5510 bd.label = sv("eve_readback");
5511 bd.size = size;
5512 bd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_MapRead;
5513 bd.mappedAtCreation = false;
5514 wgpu::Buffer dst = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&bd));
5515
5516 wgpu::CommandEncoder enc = device.CreateCommandEncoder();
5517 WGPUTexelCopyTextureInfo from{};
5518 from.texture = src.Get();
5519 from.mipLevel = 0;
5520 from.aspect = WGPUTextureAspect_All;
5521 from.origin = {0, 0, 0};
5522 WGPUTexelCopyBufferInfo to{};
5523 to.buffer = dst.Get();
5524 to.layout.offset = 0;
5525 to.layout.bytesPerRow = static_cast<uint32_t>(bytesPerRow);
5526 to.layout.rowsPerImage = static_cast<uint32_t>(height);
5527 WGPUExtent3D extent{static_cast<uint32_t>(width), static_cast<uint32_t>(height), 1};
5528 enc.CopyTextureToBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo*>(&from),
5529 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyBufferInfo*>(&to),
5530 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::Extent3D*>(&extent));
5531 wgpu::CommandBuffer cmd = enc.Finish();
5532 queue.Submit(1, &cmd);
5533
5534 struct MapState {
5535 bool done = false;
5536 bool success = false;
5537 WGPUMapAsyncStatus status = WGPUMapAsyncStatus_Force32;
5538 } map;
5539 WGPUBufferMapCallbackInfo cbInfo{};
5540#if defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__)
5541 cbInfo.mode = WGPUCallbackMode_AllowProcessEvents;
5542#else
5543 cbInfo.mode = WGPUCallbackMode_WaitAnyOnly;
5544#endif
5545 cbInfo.callback = [](WGPUMapAsyncStatus status, WGPUStringView /*message*/, void* userdata1, void* /*userdata2*/) {
5546 auto* state = static_cast<MapState*>(userdata1);
5547 state->status = status;
5548 state->success = status == WGPUMapAsyncStatus_Success;
5549 state->done = true;
5550 };
5551 cbInfo.userdata1 = &map;
5552 WGPUFuture future = wgpuBufferMapAsync(dst.Get(), WGPUMapMode_Read, 0, size, cbInfo);
5553
5554#if defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__)
5555 int guard = 0;
5556 while (!map.done && guard < 2000) {
5557 emscripten_sleep(0);
5558 wgpuInstanceProcessEvents(instance.Get());
5559 ++guard;
5560 }
5561#else
5562 WGPUFutureWaitInfo waitInfo{};
5563 waitInfo.future = future;
5564 (void)wgpuInstanceWaitAny(instance.Get(), 1, &waitInfo, UINT64_MAX);
5565#endif
5566 if (!map.success) {
5567 std::fprintf(stderr, "[webgpu] texture readback map failed: status=%d done=%d\n", int(map.status),
5568 map.done ? 1 : 0);
5569 return false;
5570 }
5571
5572 const uint8_t* data = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(dst.GetConstMappedRange(0, size));
5573 if (!data) return false;
5574 const size_t tightRowBytes = static_cast<size_t>(width) * bytesPerPixel;
5575 outRgba.resize(tightRowBytes * height);
5576 for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y)
5577 std::memcpy(outRgba.data() + size_t(y) * tightRowBytes,
5578 data + size_t(y) * bytesPerRow, tightRowBytes);
5579 dst.Unmap();
5580 return true;
5581}
5582
5583float decodeHalf(uint16_t value) {
5584 const uint32_t sign = uint32_t(value & 0x8000u) << 16u;
5585 uint32_t exponent = (value >> 10u) & 0x1fu;
5586 uint32_t mantissa = value & 0x03ffu;
5587 uint32_t bits = 0;
5588 if (exponent == 0) {
5589 if (mantissa == 0) {
5590 bits = sign;
5591 } else {
5592 exponent = 1;
5593 while ((mantissa & 0x0400u) == 0) {
5594 mantissa <<= 1u;
5595 --exponent;
5596 }
5597 mantissa &= 0x03ffu;
5598 bits = sign | ((exponent + 112u) << 23u) | (mantissa << 13u);
5599 }
5600 } else if (exponent == 31u) {
5601 bits = sign | 0x7f800000u | (mantissa << 13u);
5602 } else {
5603 bits = sign | ((exponent + 112u) << 23u) | (mantissa << 13u);
5604 }
5605 float result = 0.f;
5606 std::memcpy(&result, &bits, sizeof(result));
5607 return result;
5608}
5609
5610float hdrToDisplay(float value) {
5611 const float linear = std::max(value, 0.f);
5612 const float mapped = std::clamp((linear * (2.51f * linear + 0.03f)) /
5613 (linear * (2.43f * linear + 0.59f) + 0.14f),
5614 0.f, 1.f);
5615 return mapped <= 0.0031308f ? mapped * 12.92f
5616 : 1.055f * std::pow(mapped, 1.f / 2.4f) - 0.055f;
5617}
5618
5619Color hdrPixelToColor(const uint8_t *pixel) {
5620 uint16_t channels[4]{};
5621 std::memcpy(channels, pixel, sizeof(channels));
5622 return Color(hdrToDisplay(decodeHalf(channels[0])), hdrToDisplay(decodeHalf(channels[1])),
5623 hdrToDisplay(decodeHalf(channels[2])),
5624 std::clamp(decodeHalf(channels[3]), 0.f, 1.f));
5625}
5626
5627} // namespace
5628
5629Color Graphics::getPixelImpl(OffscreenCanvas* canvas, int x, int y) {
5630 int w = canvas ? canvas->getWidth() : (sceneColorWidth > 0 ? sceneColorWidth : 1);
5631 int h = canvas ? canvas->getHeight() : (sceneColorHeight > 0 ? sceneColorHeight : 1);
5632 if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= w || y >= h) return Color(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f);
5633 std::vector<uint8_t> rgba;
5634 wgpu::Texture src = canvas ? canvas->color
5635 : (sceneColorSlots.empty() ? nullptr
5636 : sceneColorSlots[lastPresentSlot].color);
5637 const bool hdrScene = canvas == nullptr && sceneColorFormat == WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float;
5638 if (!src || !copyTextureToCpu(instance, device, queue, src, w, h, rgba,
5639 hdrScene ? 8 : 4))
5640 return clearColor;
5641 if (hdrScene) return hdrPixelToColor(rgba.data() + (size_t(y) * w + x) * 8);
5642 const uint8_t *p = rgba.data() + (size_t(y) * w + x) * 4;
5643 return Color(p[0] / 255.f, p[1] / 255.f, p[2] / 255.f, p[3] / 255.f);
5644}
5645
5646image::ImageData *Graphics::newImageDataImpl(OffscreenCanvas *canvas) {
5647 int w = canvas ? canvas->getWidth() : (sceneColorWidth > 0 ? sceneColorWidth : 1);
5648 int h = canvas ? canvas->getHeight() : (sceneColorHeight > 0 ? sceneColorHeight : 1);
5649 auto *img = new image::ImageData(w, h, "RGBA8");
5650 std::vector<uint8_t> rgba;
5651 wgpu::Texture src = canvas ? canvas->color
5652 : (sceneColorSlots.empty() ? nullptr
5653 : sceneColorSlots[lastPresentSlot].color);
5654 const bool hdrScene = canvas == nullptr && sceneColorFormat == WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float;
5655 if (src && copyTextureToCpu(instance, device, queue, src, w, h, rgba,
5656 hdrScene ? 8 : 4)) {
5657 if (!hdrScene) {
5658 std::memcpy(img->getData(), rgba.data(), rgba.size());
5659 } else {
5660 auto *dst = static_cast<uint8_t *>(img->getData());
5661 for (size_t pixel = 0; pixel < size_t(w) * h; ++pixel) {
5662 const Color color = hdrPixelToColor(rgba.data() + pixel * 8);
5663 dst[pixel * 4 + 0] = uint8_t(std::clamp(color.r * 255.f, 0.f, 255.f));
5664 dst[pixel * 4 + 1] = uint8_t(std::clamp(color.g * 255.f, 0.f, 255.f));
5665 dst[pixel * 4 + 2] = uint8_t(std::clamp(color.b * 255.f, 0.f, 255.f));
5666 dst[pixel * 4 + 3] = uint8_t(std::clamp(color.a * 255.f, 0.f, 255.f));
5667 }
5668 }
5669 }
5670 return img;
5671}
5672
5673image::ImageData *Graphics::newHDRImageDataImpl(OffscreenCanvas *canvas) {
5674 if (!canvas || !canvas->hdr) return nullptr;
5675 const int w = canvas->getWidth();
5676 const int h = canvas->getHeight();
5677 std::vector<uint8_t> rgba16f;
5678 if (!copyTextureToCpu(instance, device, queue, canvas->color, w, h, rgba16f, 8)) return nullptr;
5679 auto *img = new image::ImageData(w, h, "RGBA16F");
5680 std::memcpy(img->getData(), rgba16f.data(), rgba16f.size());
5681 return img;
5682}

5684image::ImageData *Graphics::readGBufferToImageData(const std::string &attachment) {
5685 submitPendingDeferredPasses();
5686 if (!device || gbufferSlots.empty() || gbufferWidth <= 0 || gbufferHeight <= 0) return nullptr;
5687 GbufferSlot &slot = gbufferSlots[std::min<size_t>(lastGbufferSlot, gbufferSlots.size() - 1)];
5688 wgpu::Texture src;
5689 if (attachment == "depth")
5690 src = slot.depthColor;
5691 else if (attachment == "normal")
5692 src = slot.normal;
5693 else if (attachment == "albedo")
5694 src = slot.albedo;
5695 else
5696 return nullptr;
5697
5698 std::vector<uint8_t> rgba;
5699 if (!copyTextureToCpu(instance, device, queue, src, gbufferWidth, gbufferHeight, rgba))
5700 return nullptr;
5701 auto *image = new image::ImageData(gbufferWidth, gbufferHeight, "RGBA8");
5702 std::memcpy(image->getData(), rgba.data(), rgba.size());
5703 return image;
5704}

5706image::ImageData *Graphics::readDecalLayerToImageData(const std::string &attachment) {
5707 submitPendingDeferredPasses();
5708 if (!device || decalSlots.empty() || decalWidth <= 0 || decalHeight <= 0) return nullptr;
5709 DecalSlot &slot = decalSlots[std::min<size_t>(lastDecalSlot, decalSlots.size() - 1)];
5710 wgpu::Texture src;
5711 if (attachment == "albedo")
5712 src = slot.albedo;
5713 else if (attachment == "normal")
5714 src = slot.normal;
5715 else if (attachment == "params")
5716 src = slot.params;
5717 else
5718 return nullptr;
5719 std::vector<uint8_t> rgba;
5720 if (!copyTextureToCpu(instance, device, queue, src, decalWidth, decalHeight, rgba))
5721 return nullptr;
5722 auto *image = new image::ImageData(decalWidth, decalHeight, "RGBA8");
5723 std::memcpy(image->getData(), rgba.data(), rgba.size());
5724 return image;
5725}

5730
5731namespace {
5732
5733bool encodeRgbaToPng(const std::string &path, int width, int height,
5734 const std::vector<uint8_t> &rgba) {
5735 try {
5736 image::ImageData img(width, height, "RGBA8");
5737 std::memcpy(img.getData(), rgba.data(), rgba.size());
5738 std::unique_ptr<eve::filesystem::FileData> png(
5739 img.encode(medialoader::FormatHandler::ENCODED_PNG, path.c_str(), false));
5740 if (!png) return false;
5741 std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::binary);
5742 if (!out) return false;
5743 out.write(static_cast<const char *>(png->getData()),
5744 static_cast<std::streamsize>(png->getSize()));
5745 return out.good();
5746 } catch (...) {
5747 return false;
5748 }
5749}
5750
5751} // namespace
5752
5753bool Graphics::beginFrameReadback(const std::string &path) {
5754 // A finished readback can be replaced; only refuse while one is in flight.
5755 if ((pendingReadback_ && !pendingReadback_->done) || !device) return false;
5756 wgpu::Texture src = lastReadbackTex;
5757 int w = lastReadbackW;
5758 int h = lastReadbackH;
5759 if (!src || w <= 0 || h <= 0) {
5760 // Fall back to the scene color slot before anything was rendered.
5761 if (sceneColorSlots.empty()) return false;
5762 const uint32_t slot = lastPresentSlot;
5763 if (slot >= sceneColorSlots.size()) return false;
5764 src = sceneColorSlots[slot].color;
5765 w = sceneColorWidth;
5766 h = sceneColorHeight;
5767 if (!src || w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;
5768 }
5769
5770 uint64_t bytesPerRow = static_cast<uint64_t>(w * 4);
5771 bytesPerRow = (bytesPerRow + 255) / 256 * 256;
5772 const uint64_t size = bytesPerRow * static_cast<uint64_t>(h);
5773
5774 WGPUBufferDescriptor bd{};
5775 bd.label = sv("eve_readback");
5776 bd.size = size;
5777 bd.usage = WGPUBufferUsage_CopyDst | WGPUBufferUsage_MapRead;
5778 bd.mappedAtCreation = false;
5779 wgpu::Buffer dst = device.CreateBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::BufferDescriptor*>(&bd));
5780 if (!dst) return false;
5781
5782 // Copy the resolved scene color into the readback buffer, then map
5783 // asynchronously (two-phase: the pump waits for the map callback on the
5784 // browser event loop without ASYNCIFY sleeps).
5785 wgpu::CommandEncoder enc = device.CreateCommandEncoder();
5786 WGPUTexelCopyTextureInfo from{};
5787 from.texture = src.Get();
5788 from.mipLevel = 0;
5789 from.aspect = WGPUTextureAspect_All;
5790 from.origin = {0, 0, 0};
5791 WGPUTexelCopyBufferInfo to{};
5792 to.buffer = dst.Get();
5793 to.layout.offset = 0;
5794 to.layout.bytesPerRow = static_cast<uint32_t>(bytesPerRow);
5795 to.layout.rowsPerImage = static_cast<uint32_t>(h);
5796 WGPUExtent3D extent{static_cast<uint32_t>(w), static_cast<uint32_t>(h), 1};
5797 enc.CopyTextureToBuffer(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo*>(&from),
5798 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::TexelCopyBufferInfo*>(&to),
5799 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::Extent3D*>(&extent));
5800 wgpu::CommandBuffer cmd = enc.Finish();
5801 queue.Submit(1, &cmd);
5802
5803 auto pr = std::make_unique<PendingReadback>();
5804 pr->path = path;
5805 pr->width = w;
5806 pr->height = h;
5807 pr->bytesPerRow = bytesPerRow;
5808 pr->dst = dst;
5809
5810 WGPUBufferMapCallbackInfo cbInfo{};
5811 cbInfo.mode = WGPUCallbackMode_AllowProcessEvents;
5812 cbInfo.callback = [](WGPUMapAsyncStatus status, WGPUStringView /*message*/, void *userdata1,
5813 void * /*userdata2*/) {
5814 auto *p = static_cast<PendingReadback *>(userdata1);
5815 p->mapped = (status == WGPUMapAsyncStatus_Success);
5816 };
5817 cbInfo.userdata1 = pr.get();
5818 wgpuBufferMapAsync(dst.Get(), WGPUMapMode_Read, 0, size, cbInfo);
5819
5820 pendingReadback_ = std::move(pr);
5821 return true;
5822}
5823
5824int Graphics::frameReadbackStatus() const {
5825 if (!pendingReadback_) return 0;
5826 if (!pendingReadback_->done) return 1;
5827 return pendingReadback_->ok ? 2 : 3;
5828}
5829
5830void Graphics::pumpReadback() {
5831 if (!pendingReadback_ || pendingReadback_->done) return;
5832 auto &pr = *pendingReadback_;
5833 if (!pr.mapped) {
5834 // The map callback is delivered on the browser event loop between
5835 // frames (emdawnwebgpu callUserCallback), so no ASYNCIFY sleep is
5836 // needed here �?this runs from present() on the main loop.
5837#if defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__)
5838 wgpuInstanceProcessEvents(instance.Get());
5839#endif
5840 return;
5841 }
5842 const uint8_t *data = static_cast<const uint8_t *>(
5843 pr.dst.GetConstMappedRange(0, pr.bytesPerRow * static_cast<uint64_t>(pr.height)));
5844 std::vector<uint8_t> rgba(static_cast<size_t>(pr.width) * pr.height * 4);
5845 if (data) {
5846 for (int y = 0; y < pr.height; ++y)
5847 std::memcpy(rgba.data() + size_t(y) * pr.width * 4,
5848 data + size_t(y) * pr.bytesPerRow, size_t(pr.width) * 4);
5849 }
5850 pr.dst.Unmap();
5851 pr.ok = data && encodeRgbaToPng(pr.path, pr.width, pr.height, rgba);
5852 pr.done = true;
5853}

5855// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
5856// Shader creation
5857// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
5858
5859namespace {
5860
5861wgpu::RenderPipeline buildPipelineFromWgsl(wgpu::Device &dev, wgpu::PipelineLayout layout,
5862 WGPUTextureFormat format, const std::string &vert,
5863 const std::string &frag, bool depth, bool blend,
5864 bool mesh3d, bool hair, bool shadow, bool gbuffer,
5865 uint32_t sampleCount) {
5866 WGPURenderPipelineDescriptor pd{};
5867 pd.label = sv("eve_custom_shader");
5868 pd.layout = layout.Get();
5869
5870 WGPUVertexAttribute attrs[5]{};
5871 WGPUVertexBufferLayout vb{};
5872 if (mesh3d || shadow || gbuffer) {
5873 fillMeshAttributes(attrs);
5874 attrs[0].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x3;
5875 attrs[0].offset = 0;
5876 attrs[0].shaderLocation = 0;
5877 attrs[1].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x3;
5878 attrs[1].offset = 12;
5879 attrs[1].shaderLocation = 1;
5880 attrs[2].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x2;
5881 attrs[2].offset = 24;
5882 attrs[2].shaderLocation = 2;
5883 vb.arrayStride = sizeof(MeshVertex);
5884 vb.stepMode = WGPUVertexStepMode_Vertex;
5885 vb.attributeCount = 5;
5886 vb.attributes = attrs;
5887 } else {
5888 attrs[0].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x2;
5889 attrs[0].offset = 0;
5890 attrs[0].shaderLocation = 0;
5891 attrs[1].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x4;
5892 attrs[1].offset = 8;
5893 attrs[1].shaderLocation = 1;
5894 attrs[2].format = WGPUVertexFormat_Float32x2;
5895 attrs[2].offset = 24;
5896 attrs[2].shaderLocation = 2;
5897 vb.arrayStride = 32;
5898 vb.stepMode = WGPUVertexStepMode_Vertex;
5899 vb.attributeCount = 3;
5900 vb.attributes = attrs;
5901 }
5902 pd.vertex.bufferCount = 1;
5903 pd.vertex.buffers = &vb;
5904
5905 // Keep both modules alive until CreateRenderPipeline has consumed the
5906 // descriptor. Storing only their raw handles in pd and destroying the
5907 // wrappers at the end of these branches leaves dangling handles for Dawn.
5908 wgpu::ShaderModule vertexModule;
5909 wgpu::ShaderModule fragmentModule;
5910 if (!vert.empty()) {
5911 WGPUShaderModuleDescriptor md = mdDesc(vert);
5912 vertexModule = dev.CreateShaderModule(
5913 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor*>(&md));
5914 pd.vertex.module = vertexModule.Get();
5915 pd.vertex.entryPoint = sv("vs_main");
5916 } else {
5917 // Default textured vertex shader.
5918 WGPUShaderModuleDescriptor md = mdDesc(kTexturedVertWgsl);
5919 vertexModule = dev.CreateShaderModule(
5920 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor*>(&md));
5921 pd.vertex.module = vertexModule.Get();
5922 pd.vertex.entryPoint = sv("vs_main");
5923 }
5924
5925 if (!frag.empty()) {
5926 WGPUFragmentState fs{};
5927 WGPUShaderModuleDescriptor md = mdDesc(frag);
5928 fragmentModule = dev.CreateShaderModule(
5929 reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor*>(&md));
5930 fs.module = fragmentModule.Get();
5931 fs.entryPoint = sv("fs_main");
5932 fs.targetCount = 1;
5933 WGPUColorTargetState target{};
5934 target.format = format;
5935 target.writeMask = WGPUColorWriteMask_All;
5936 if (blend) {
5937 static WGPUBlendState bs = alphaBlend();
5938 target.blend = &bs;
5939 }
5940 fs.targets = &target;
5941 pd.fragment = &fs;
5942 } else {
5943 pd.fragment = nullptr;
5944 }
5945
5946 pd.primitive.topology = WGPUPrimitiveTopology_TriangleList;
5947 pd.primitive.frontFace = WGPUFrontFace_CCW;
5948 pd.primitive.cullMode = hair ? WGPUCullMode_None : WGPUCullMode_None;
5949 pd.primitive.stripIndexFormat = WGPUIndexFormat_Undefined;
5950
5951 if (depth && !shadow) {
5952 static WGPUDepthStencilState ds{};
5953 ds.format = WGPUTextureFormat_Depth32Float;
5954 ds.depthWriteEnabled = WGPUOptionalBool_True;
5955 ds.depthCompare = WGPUCompareFunction_Less;
5956 pd.depthStencil = &ds;
5957 }
5958 pd.multisample.count = sampleCount ? sampleCount : 1;
5959 // mask=0 (zero-init) silently discards all fragments; use all-samples.
5960 pd.multisample.mask = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
5961 return dev.CreateRenderPipeline(reinterpret_cast<const wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor*>(&pd));
5962}

5966Shader *Graphics::newShaderFromSpv(const std::vector<uint32_t> &vertSpv,
5967 const std::vector<uint32_t> &fragSpv) {
5968 if (!device) throw Exception("newShaderFromSpv: device not initialized");
5969 // Native Dawn can consume Vulkan SPIR-V directly; the browser build cannot
5970 // (browsers only accept WGSL). The WebGPU backend therefore requires WGSL
5971 // for custom shaders; SPIR-V input is rejected with a clear message.
5972 throw Exception("newShaderFromSpv: SPIR-V custom shaders are not supported on the "
5973 "WebGPU backend (browsers accept WGSL only). Recompile the shader "
5974 "with the WebGPU toolchain (glslc+tint) and use newShaderFromWgsl.");
5975}

5981
5982bool Graphics::releaseShader(Shader *shader) {
5983 if (!shader || !shader->gpuHandle) return false;
5984
5985 auto *gpu = static_cast<GpuShader *>(shader->gpuHandle);
5986 auto gpuIt = std::find_if(ownedGpuShaders.begin(), ownedGpuShaders.end(),
5987 [&](const std::unique_ptr<GpuShader> &g) {
5988 return g.get() == gpu;
5989 });
5990 if (gpuIt == ownedGpuShaders.end()) return false;
5991
5992 auto shIt = std::find_if(ownedShaders.begin(), ownedShaders.end(),
5993 [&](const std::unique_ptr<Shader> &s) {
5994 return s.get() == shader;
5995 });
5996 if (shIt == ownedShaders.end()) return false;
5997
5998 shader->gpuHandle = nullptr;
5999 ownedGpuShaders.erase(gpuIt);
6000 // Transfer the CPU facade to the caller instead of destroying it.
6001 (void)shIt->release();
6002 ownedShaders.erase(shIt);
6003 return true;
6004}

6021Shader *Graphics::newMeshShaderFromWgsl(const std::string &vertWgsl, const std::string &fragWgsl) {
6022 if (!device) throw Exception("newMeshShaderFromWgsl: device not initialized");
6023 if (fragWgsl.empty()) throw Exception("newMeshShaderFromWgsl: empty fragment WGSL");
6024 if (!mesh3dSetLayout) throw Exception("newMeshShaderFromWgsl: mesh3d layout missing");
6025
6026 std::string vert = vertWgsl.empty() ? kMesh3DVertWgsl : vertWgsl;
6027
6028 auto gpu = std::make_unique<GpuShader>();
6029 gpu->isMesh3D = true;
6030 gpu->wgslVert = vert;
6031 gpu->wgslFrag = fragWgsl;
6032 gpu->mesh3dPipeline =
6033 buildPipelineFromWgsl(device, mesh3dPipelineLayout, sceneColorFormat, vert, fragWgsl,
6034 /*depth*/ true, /*blend*/ false, /*mesh3d*/ true, /*hair*/ false,
6035 /*shadow*/ false, /*gbuffer*/ false,
6036 /*sampleCount*/ sceneColorSamples);
6037 // X-ray variant: depth test/write off + alpha blend so occluded silhouettes
6038 // paint over the building (the shader discards visible fragments itself).
6039 gpu->mesh3dXrayPipeline =
6040 buildPipelineFromWgsl(device, mesh3dPipelineLayout, sceneColorFormat, vert, fragWgsl,
6041 /*depth*/ false, /*blend*/ true, /*mesh3d*/ true, /*hair*/ false,
6042 /*shadow*/ false, /*gbuffer*/ false,
6043 /*sampleCount*/ sceneColorSamples);
6044
6045 auto sh = std::make_unique<Shader>();
6046 sh->setKind(Shader::Kind::eMesh3D);
6047 sh->gpuHandle = gpu.get();
6048
6049 Shader *raw = sh.get();
6050 ownedShaders.push_back(std::move(sh));
6051 ownedGpuShaders.push_back(std::move(gpu));
6052 return raw;
6053}
