6061
6062Shader *Graphics::newShaderFromWgsl(const std::string &vertWgsl,
6063 const std::string &fragWgsl) {
6064 if (!device) throw Exception("newShaderFromWgsl: device not initialized");
6065 if (fragWgsl.empty()) throw Exception("newShaderFromWgsl: empty fragment WGSL");
6066 if (!tex2DPipelineLayout) throw Exception("newShaderFromWgsl: 2D pipeline layout missing");
6067
6068 std::string vert = vertWgsl.empty() ? kTexturedVertWgsl : vertWgsl;
6069
6070 auto gpu = std::make_unique<GpuShader>();
6071 gpu->isMesh3D = false;
6072 gpu->wgslVert = vert;
6073 gpu->wgslFrag = fragWgsl;
6074 // 2D custom shader: alpha blend, no depth; one pipeline per target format
6075 // (swapchain surface vs RGBA8Unorm offscreen canvas).
6076 gpu->swapchainPipeline = createPipelineForShader(gpu.get(), wgpu::TextureFormat(surfaceFormat),
6077 /*depth*/ false, /*mesh3d*/ false,
6078 /*hair*/ false, /*shadow*/ false,
6079 /*gbuffer*/ false, tex2DPipelineLayout);
6080 gpu->offscreenPipeline =
6081 createPipelineForShader(gpu.get(), wgpu::TextureFormat::RGBA8Unorm,
6082 /*depth*/ false, /*mesh3d*/ false,
6083 /*hair*/ false, /*shadow*/ false,
6084 /*gbuffer*/ false, tex2DPipelineLayout);
6085 gpu->swapchainOpaquePipeline = buildPipelineFromWgsl(
6086 device, tex2DPipelineLayout, WGPUTextureFormat(surfaceFormat), vert, fragWgsl, false,
6087 false, false, false, false, false, 1u);
6088 gpu->offscreenOpaquePipeline = buildPipelineFromWgsl(
6089 device, tex2DPipelineLayout, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA8Unorm, vert, fragWgsl, false, false,
6090 false, false, false, false, 1u);
6091 gpu->hdrOffscreenPipeline = createPipelineForShader(
6092 gpu.get(), wgpu::TextureFormat::RGBA16Float, false, false, false, false, false,
6093 tex2DPipelineLayout);
6094 gpu->hdrOffscreenOpaquePipeline = buildPipelineFromWgsl(
6095 device, tex2DPipelineLayout, WGPUTextureFormat_RGBA16Float, vert, fragWgsl, false, false,
6096 false, false, false, false, 1u);
6097
6098 auto sh = std::make_unique<Shader>();
6099 sh->setKind(Shader::Kind::eSprite2D);
6100 sh->gpuHandle = gpu.get();
6101
6102 Shader *raw = sh.get();
6103 ownedShaders.push_back(std::move(sh));
6104 ownedGpuShaders.push_back(std::move(gpu));
6105 return raw;
6106}

6108wgpu::RenderPipeline Graphics::createPipelineForShader(GpuShader *gs, wgpu::TextureFormat format,
6109 bool depth, bool mesh3d, bool hair,
6110 bool shadow, bool gbuffer,
6111 wgpu::PipelineLayout layout) {
6112 if (!gs || gs->wgslFrag.empty()) return {};
6113 // Custom 2D/mesh shaders blend only when the caller asks (x-ray / 2D UI);
6114 // opaque meshes and shadow/gbuffer variants keep write-through targets.
6115 const bool blend = !depth;
6116 const uint32_t samples = mesh3d || hair || shadow || gbuffer ? sceneColorSamples : 1u;
6117 return buildPipelineFromWgsl(device, layout, WGPUTextureFormat(format), gs->wgslVert,
6118 gs->wgslFrag, depth, blend, mesh3d, hair, shadow, gbuffer,
6119 samples);
6120}
6121
6122Shader *Graphics::newHairShaderFromSpv(const std::vector<uint32_t> &vertSpv,
6123 const std::vector<uint32_t> &fragSpv) {
6124 (void)vertSpv;
6125 (void)fragSpv;
6126 throw Exception("newHairShaderFromSpv: SPIR-V hair shaders are not supported on WebGPU; "
6127 "use newHairShaderFromWgsl");
6128}
6129
6130Shader *Graphics::newHairShaderFromWgsl(const std::string &vertWgsl,
6131 const std::string &fragWgsl) {
6132 if (!device) throw Exception("newHairShaderFromWgsl: device not initialized");
6133 if (fragWgsl.empty()) throw Exception("newHairShaderFromWgsl: empty fragment WGSL");
6134 auto gpu = std::make_unique<GpuShader>();
6135 gpu->isMesh3D = true;
6136 gpu->isHair3D = true;
6137 gpu->wgslVert = vertWgsl.empty() ? kMesh3DVertWgsl : vertWgsl;
6138 gpu->wgslFrag = fragWgsl;
6139 gpu->mesh3dPipeline = buildPipelineFromWgsl(
6140 device, mesh3dPipelineLayout, sceneColorFormat, gpu->wgslVert, gpu->wgslFrag,
6141 true, true, true, true, false, false, sceneColorSamples);
6142 auto shader = std::make_unique<Shader>();
6143 shader->setKind(Shader::Kind::eMesh3D);
6144 shader->gpuHandle = gpu.get();
6145 Shader *raw = shader.get();
6146 ownedShaders.push_back(std::move(shader));
6147 ownedGpuShaders.push_back(std::move(gpu));
6148 return raw;
6149}

6151} // namespace eve::graphics::webgpu
